tei:div.tei:p: r+sha ge'i('ang8 )1khri95yā994bya05(1shā5/9spyorngu/( pad ma tshe dbang shas+t+ri/
mi ri' bra ba mngar skyar/1smo02a+yo0rdurdu450511lnga3dzi0sa (rngupad ma tshe dbang shas+t+ri/

deb kyi bdag dbang byed po/ pad ma tshe dbang shās+t+ri/༵dro ༵/ṭ+wāṃ khyi/dro /ོṭ+wāṃ ldiṭ+wāṃ ༵༵༵/baṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃX'i5 nga1(2glu1)par skrun byed po/ bod kyi dus bab/shā56115'idzishākhyirdo2shā1—5kau1—0di5—stashāXrdo/1khyidzi 117rngu3)༵rdoṭ+wāṃ5/0stu~Xrnyitrī~X (zlo shāhaṃlngasdushādi~Xtha— —— —deb 'di cha tshang ngam/ cha shas gang tsung bskyar du par 'debs sam/ skad rigs gzhan du bsgyur ba/ de bzhin nyo tshong bed sbyod kyi rigs rtsom pa po'i chog mchan med par rtsa ba nas byed mi 3snag/

dkar chagadapar skran gsal bshad/ stosngon du rūng ba'i gtam/ 71 sbyar byang / sa 11 mazun 'gyur dang len/ yamamachod baji+od/ 541 1/ ka spug bod gzhung slob grwa spro2/ go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 233/ mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig brnyed pa/ 474/ ka sbug 11ba grwa gtor ba/ 697/ rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / 87cu/ zla ba sgrol ma'i nang mi/ sprospro37/ gnyen 'phrad kyi tshor ba/ 133rngu/ skal ldan 11ba grwa nas gsang bros/ kro533/ gangs skyid kyi mtshan tshogs/ spro871༷/ dus 'khor dbang chen/ 22sprobasngo smon/ 246

dpar skrun gsal bshad/bod kyi dus bab gsar khang gis dpar 'grems byas pa'i sku zhabs pad+ma tshe dbang shās+t+ri lags kyi bcos sgrang nga〈zhub kyi grang ngar dang shar gyi drod 'jam/〉〉 zhesapa de'i thad klog mkhan rgyo khrod nas bsam tshul rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis zhig byung yod/ de yang gcig ni bcos sgrang gi byung rim bkod sgrig byed stangs dang brjod bya dkyus gcig tu bsgril ma zu/ pa/ de bzhin sgrang gi 'thor 'degs sogs kyis masnun pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhan cha'i sgor zhig yin/༄gzhan zhig ni sgrang gi brjod bya go bde ba dang / ljod tshig snyan pa/ btsan byol bod mi'i sbyi ༄gis skyo snang tshul gsal bor mngon pa sogs dge mtshan gyi sgor yin/ dang bo bathod mkhan ni sgra rtsal rtsom rig la myong goms sku da mkhan khag cig yin la/ phyi ma brjod mkhan sna sbyi skusnangs kyi blo ga mkhan dkyus ma cachoyin/gang ltar bcos sgrang de dpar skran byas rjes btsan gyol bod mi'i sbyi tsogs nang gi gzhon skyes mang 〉te zhig gis shaṃb de'i thad dang ba dang do snang chen pos theng mol shugs cher byas sku(da pa ma zad/gangs can skyid gathe ngas kyi las khyangs khag gi mdun cog gi steng dang gzhon skyes lho'i am brag gi nang / de bzhin gzhon skyes mang po zhig gi sngas 'gram sogs nas deb 'di rgyun ldan du mthong rgyu yod pas klog mkhan ni rtsom pa po'i dbyang rogs yin zhes pa ltar nga tsos rtsom pa po pad+ma tshe dbang lags la dbyang rogs gang mang zhig byung yod pa mthong la/ de bzhin gnon skyes khag cig gis 'di lta'i deb mang po zhig yod na nga tshos dngos gnas bod

51 si tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/yig yar rgyas kyi kha phyogs thig kyang rnyed nges red ces bzhad mkhan yang byung /'di ltar klog mkhan dkyus ma'i tshur snang 'di dag gis nga tsho dpar skran byed mkhan gyi re ba dang dmigs yul yongs su khengs yod cing / rtsom pa lha'i re ba dang dmigs yul yang khengs yod par yid ches byed bzhin yod/ gong gsal rgyu mtshan 'di dag la brten nas da lam bod kyi dus bab gsar khang gis sku zhabs pad+ma tshe dbang shāwī laṭa kyi bcos sgrang gnyis pa 〈rtemi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/me〉zhes pa 'di bzhin dpar 'grems byes pa yin la/ deb 'di klog pa po'i mig lam du 'ogrim skabs/ bocos sgrung 'di'i nang rtsom po pos dus 'khor dbang chen gyis ‘6chas 'dad pa la chas dang / nar 'dad pa la nar/ gnyen zug 'dad pa gnyen zugagatam 'dod pa la gtam/byin rlabs 'dod pa la byin rlabs bcas yong gi skusnad/mi’ces baji+od yod pa ltar dpe deb 'dis kyang tshig 'dod pa la tshig don 'dod pa la don/ bsngags baji+od byed 'dod pa la bsngags baji+od/ skyon baji+od byed 'dod pa la skyon baji+od sogs gang gis gang 'dod de la de ltar du yong zub pa'i yid ches yod/go skabs 'di dang bsdun nas zhu 'dod pa zhig ni/ bod pa'i sbyi snugs khrod nyo dgos byung na deb gcig kyang nyo mi 'dod pa dang /sbrad na deb brgya yin yang 'khyer 'gro ba'i goms gathis thig yod/'di ni rtsom pa po dang dpar skran byed mkhan mang po zhig gi dka' ngal chags kyi yod/ des na 'di dag la rgyab n+nir gyi tshul du deb re nyo ba'i goms gathis zhig slebs thabs byed rgyu 'di'ang gal che bar mthong ngo //bod kyi dus bab rtsom sgrig pa'i ming 'dzin lhag bsam gyis/phyi lo 2༷༷1phyi zla 1༷tshes 11nyin bris/

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/༈ rtsom pa pos rang re bod mi'i ljang gzhon rigs kyi myu gu rnams rang skad la sbro snang dang 'dun pa/ yid ches dang dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir dang / gzhis lus spun zla rnams kyis byes 'byor ba sdus mi yul lung par mi tshe ji ltar skyel min mkhyen pa'i ched du dmigs te bcos sgrang 'di bzhin sdings cha'i steng du sbyan 'bul zhu ba'i ngal ba bsten zhes rtsom par ༄dam bca' ba'i tshul du ji ltar smras pa bzhin ngos nas kyang 'di nyid klog 'go btsugs ma thag nas rtsom pa po'i mngon 'dod ji bzhin 'grub par yid ches skyes byung / de snga phyogs yongs nas rang re'i sbyi tshogs nang bod skad yar rgyas gtong bar domigs te byis pa'i gna' sgrung nas bka' drung gi gsal bsgrags bar bad yig thag gang mang spel yad pa smra mi dbe|sa kyang / phal che ba dpyis phyin rtogs par bod kyi skad yig gcig pus mi 'azus par nges par du bod kyi rig gzhung gi mang gzhi med thabs med par lta bu rkyang snang / 'on kyang da lam gyi bcos sgrung mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur zhes pa 'di nyid klogo ste don daphyis phyin par rtogs pa la bad kyi skad yig gcig bu'i gnas tshad dgas pa las rig gzhung gi ming gzhi med na'ang 'grigs pa lta bur snang /de ltar 'di nyid 'di yi khyad chos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis btsan byol the da mi'i slob grwa nas thon pa'i bod phrug ji ltar bod yig gi shes tshad dman na'ang 'di nyid tshul bzhin du klog zub par ma zad nang don yang legs par shes thub pa'i yid ches yod/ des na rtsom pa po'i

51 1 1 mi tshe'i blo ba mngar skyur/mngon 'dod ji bzhin 'grub pa'i yid ches skyes byung zhes smras par thal/rtsom rtsal la 'grel baji+od byed skabs rtsom pa po rnams kyis rang gi lhan skyes kyi gzhis ka dang sbyar te sgyu rtsal bzang zhan dang sun sum tsogs min/ gzhan yong gzhung lugs bye brag pa zhig dang sbyar te der gtan la phab zin gyi khyad chas rnams 'dzoms min la gzhi bcol te 'bel gtam sna tshogis pa zhig smra ba'ang rtsom rig gi chos nyid du zad/ cani kyang rtsom rtsal sbyi la khyab pa'i dgos mkho ni rang gi mig snang du gyur pa'i khor yug gi brtan g.yo'i dngos bo rnams la sgo lnga'i dbang po rang gi yul du sim par 'asbyol te de das la dbang po re re nas rang gi bya ba tshul bzhin byas te mthar dbang shes rnams su byung ba ma lus pa nang 'dren byas pas ma tshad yid dbang ngam yid shes kyi kun ltoteg la rdzogs par gses bskru la byas te rtsom pa pos nye sar ngag nas dang / ring sar sor mo'i 'du byed kyi lam nas nag 'a〈snas su bskadad zub pa ni lcasnam rtsal sbyi la khyab ba'i khyad snurmes sam dgos mkho yin na 'di nyid bcos sgrung 'di la rdzogs 'dugade snga deb ther dkar po sku gas su yig skad bsnyan bcos su bkol na stod mnga' ris nas smad a mthe yi bar gyi khro da yig blo ga mkhan tshang mas tshul bzhin besna zub pa'i khyad choso sku da pa dang / de las rdzog ste yul skad bye brag pa bstan bcos su bkol na bka' gdams pa'i beñca bul dbe chos lta bu 'ong rgyur gdon mi za/ de bzhin nye ba'i char yang dngos grub ga snye bas rang gi brtsams chos rgyul du byung

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/ 4ba'i bod skad dang de srung skyob byed phyogs sgor nang yig skad ni bod chol kha gsum gyi skad rigs tsam ma zad/stod la dwags nas zangs dkar/ gar zha/smi ti/khya zhu/uṭa tar bradesha zhes pa'i mnga' sde'i bod rigs kyi kha skad/ de bzhin rta mang dang shar pa/ leb cwa/ 'bras ljongs/ gzhan yang rgya gar shar phyogs kyi mnga' sde a ru ṭ+wāṃcal gyi yul skad/de nas rim pas 'grug lung pa'i skad rigs sogs mang tsam yod pa mtha' dag gi brda sbrod pa'i gzhung lugs thon mi a hūṃ'i bus gtan la phab pa'i gzhung lugs la rag lus kyi yod stabs gong gsal yul lung so so'i skad rigs mtha' dag bod kyi thun sang ma yin pa'i skad rigs kyi khyim sde nang gtogs 'a〈sna gi yod pa red/ ces gsungs pa las kyang yig skad bkol rgyu ji tsam gal chen po yin pa bstan sku da/ gzhan yang slob dbon chen po zam gdong rin po che nas bod yig bed sbyod gtong mkhan gyi gras su bod pa min pa'ang zhin tu mang po yod cing / dber na sog po sogs phyi rgyal mi rigs khag cig chos dang rig gzhung gi cha nas dang /zhub phyogs pa'i mi rigs khag cig nyams zhib kho na'i ched du bed sbyod gtong gi yod na de dag gi ched du'ang yig skad thog bod yig 'bri rgyu zhin tu gal chen po yin pa bstan yod/ cani kyang blo gsar rnams la 'di nyid gal chen yin pa dang yul skad yig thog tu bris na go brda mi 'asgod pa'i dka' ngal ji yod mtshan gzhi dang bcas te gses bklol byas 'dug na dbe mamā'i gyi slad du 'dir lung 'dren bya rgyu yin/de yang ji skad du/bod dge lhun grub 'dzin grwa'i nang du phebs te/ de ring ngas nyin shas gong la slob

5 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/phrug sna 'bri rtsom 'gran bsdur byas pa'i rtsom 'ga' zhig gi nang nas baji+od pa zur 'don byas pa 'ga' zhig gi thog la 'dzin grwa'i nang du bskyar zhib byed 'dod yod/ ngas rtsom 'di snur lta dus skabs re nga rang gis kyang brjod don ma shes pa mang po zhig mthong gi 'dug byas tsang ngas rtsom re re bzhin nang pang steng du brjod pa thung thung sgong tog nang zhing bug la gong ri mtho mo pong po yu/ bug mi la sen shug yu red de/ lho jong mid na sen shug gis mi phan/ zhes 'di ngag dbang dpal mos bris 'dug ngas zhib tshags po byas te klog dus khams skad kyi sgra gdangs ji bzhin bris pa 'dra/ zhes gsungs pa dang ngag dbang dpal yo mgo bo gug ste bsnad sku da pa blo bzang gis mthong ste/ rgan lags/ ngas baji+od pa de bsgyur na 'grigs kyi red pas/zhes dris par rgan lhun grub kyis/yong nga /yong nga /khyed rang yar bzhengs te nang pang gi steng du bris dang / zhes bka' gnang bar blo bzang gis nag pang steng du/sgang tog nang bzhin bod la gangs ri mtho bo mang po yod/ bod mi mang la sems shugs yod red de/ slob sbyong med na sems shugs kyis mi phan/ zhes bris par/rgan lhun grub kyis/ da ga rang red/ khyed rang tshotshang mas dag cha dang baji+od byar do snang yag po byos ang / zhes ngag dbang dpal mo la dmigs bkar gzigs te gsungs/de nas slar yang nag pang gi steng du/a ta mig dmar nang la yong dus gu ris bi ya zas tshar 'dugad/ga gru bid byas/

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/ klo1 smras song /zhes bris te/'di pa sangs sgrol mas bris 'dugartsa bas mo rang gi nang mi'i lo rgyus snying rje po bris 'dug ste/ ngas tshig sbyor 'di mgo tshe'i ma song / zhes gsungs ma tshar gong du stobs 'byor gyis ha ha zhes gad mo shor ba las slob phrug gzhan pa mā ci yang ma sprus/ rgan lhun grub kyis stobs 'byor la gzigs te/ ga re byas song /zhes dris par stobs 'byor gyis/rgan lags/'di skyid rong ba'i skad red/ a ta zer na jo jo red/ gu ri zer na zhi mi red/ bi ya ni tsi tsi la zer ba red/byas tsang tshig sbyor des/ jo jo mig dmar nang la yong dus zhi mis tsi tsi zas tshar 'dugad ga re byed dam lab song /zhes pa'i don red brjod pa dang /slob phrug tshang ma gad mo zhor ba ma zad rgan lhun grub kyang rang dbang med par gad po shor/yang nag pang gi steng du/bu za des i la/i we/be su 'o ma la gdab ste za na zhim po yong / zhes lab pa dang / i gyis khyod za e myong lab par/ bu za des snga za ma myong na'i a cus mi tsho za ba mthong 'dug ces lab/ ces bris/ der dngos grub kyis/rgan lags/de gro mo ba'i skad red/bu des a ma la/a ma lags/sba ji 'o ma la btab nas bzas na zhim po 'dug zer ba red/ ces smras/ zhes sogs yul skad rang gi brtsams chos su bkol na nyes dmigs ji yod mngon sum ra sgod kyi mtshan gzhi 'di dag dngos 'brel nga tsotshang mas go brda 'asdo+od nges shes dgos pa mthong ste ched mngags zur 'don byas/ rgyas pa brtsams sgrung nyid nas mkhyen par mdzod cig/

snu1 1 mi che'i 11 ba mngar skyur/mdor na bcos sgrang 'di la bzhad gad kyi nyams dang skyo ba'i nyams/ chags pa'i nyams dang mdzome+e brtse'i nyams/ kha dan tshig la gnas pa'i yon tan bcas kyi nyams dang ldan pa yin/ gzhan yang tshig sbyor phun sum tshogis zhing / nang don gsal bar brda bkrol byas yod bas ma tshad gsang ba skog gyur gyi gnad rnams zhin tu gab pa'i tshul du bkod de bcos sgrang gril po ma klog na gses bkrol 'ong mi zub pa sogs kyi khyad chos du mas gak+tams 'dug bcos sgrang 'di nyid su yi lag tu thogs kyang klog mgo btsuṭa tshe blo ga mjug skyel ba'i sprod ches yod cing /lhag par ngo bo'i cha nas bcos sgrang gi rnam ba bstan yang don gyi cha nas btsan byol sbyi tsogs kyi me long du'ang gyudro pas na btsan byol nang du 'tshar longs byung ba'i bod mi rnams kyis rang gi lo rgyus dran gso'i ched du klog rgyur yid ches dang /rjes 'byor bod mi rnams kyis de snga rgya gar du bod mi'i sbyi tsogs kyi lo rgyus kyi cha shas thirgu shes pa'i ched du'ang klog gi yod pa'i yid ches yod/ mdor na bcos sgrang 'di ni gzhis byed bod mi tshang mas klog dgos pa'i deb cig tu gyur pa'i re dro dang /rtsom pa po nas 'byung 'gyur yang mu mazud nas bcos sgrang 'di rigs gang mang spel gnang yong ba'i 'bod skul dang bcas te bod kyi dbe rwakhudzod khang gi na ga sangs rgyas bstan dar gyis phyi lesna 2ཿ1zla tshes 17nyin spel//

sbyar byang /de yang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha'i sbyod 'jug tu/ sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir basprod med/ /sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod min te/ /de phyir gzhan don bsam pa'ang bdag la med/ /rang gi yid la bsgom phyir ngas 'di brtsams/ /zhes gsungs pa lhar sngon phyon gyi skyes chen dam pa dang / mkhas pa rnams kyi yul du ma gyur pa'i gsar btod shes bya'i don gyi mdzis sdug dang / tshig sbyor gyi nyams dang ro bcud ldan pa'i ngag rtsal gyi 'gyur khyag rol dbyangs kyi stangs stabs sogs phyi nang gi mkhas pa rnams zugs 'phrog pa'i bajid chags rnam dpyod kyi zlos gar gang yang ma mchis kyang / ljang gzhon rigs kyi myu gu rnams rang skad la sbro snang dang /'dun pa/dang ba bcas 'dren ba'i phyir dang /gzhis lus spun zla rnams kyis byes 'phyor ba tshos mi yul lung par mi tshe ji ltar skyel min mkhyen pa'i ched du dmigs te bcos sgrang rdog sgra mi mnyam pa'i ra skyes kyi gar 'chams 'di bzhin sdengs cha'i steng du sgrun 'bul zhu ba'i ngal ba bsten/'di ni rtsom pa po'i rnam rtog gi sa bon las byung ba'i nye bar bkod pa'i bcos sgrang zhig yin pa las/'di'i nang gi mi sna dang /byung rkyen/gtam brjod/'dod tshul oṃgs dngos 'brel yin par brtsi mi rung /ci ste 'bru don dang /byung rkyen/de bzhin mi sna dag gi lo rgyus rnams 'das gson gang rung yin pa'i gang zag gi lo rgyus

snu1 5 mi che'i zo ba mngar skyur/dang mtshungs cha mchis tshe mtha' gcig tu stes dbang gis byung ba las shes bzhin du bris par rtsa ba nas brtsi mi nyan/ yang sa cha'i ming dang sbyi tshogs kyi gnas babs bcas 'ga' zhig dngos 'brel yin/rtsom pa pos bcos sgrang 'di brtsams pa'i ngal ba dang du len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gong gsal gyi thog ༄tu rang nyid thog mar 'phags yul du 'phyor te bskyed sring 'tshar longs dang / slob sbyong byed sa'i bsti gnas thog ma de ka sbug bod gzhung slob grwa yin pas slob grwa de dang / skabs de'i 'phags bod bal 'bras bzhi'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi bkrin dang / slob grogs rnams kyi mdza' brtse/ las byed rnams kyi byams skyong / khor yug gi mdzes sdug bcas kyi dran gso'i don du'ang yin/de dang phyogs mtshungs snga lo sdon gyis zhub kyi grang ngar dang shar gyi drod 'jam zhes pa'i bcos sgrang zhig bris pa de bzhin bod mi rgan gzhon du ma zhig gis ljags klog gnang oṃd pa ma zad/ 'dris yod 'dris med mang po zhig gis yig ngag gnyis thog nas bskul ma dang /yi rangs gnang bas kyang ngo //sgrung gi rgyab ljongs de 'phags bod bal gsum gyi yul du yin pas mi sna dag gi ngag bajid kyi nang du gnas skabs du mar dbyin gyin bal gsum gyi tha snyad dang /chig brjod kyi bkol sbyod byas pa rnams skabs so sor dgos pa la gzhigs te ṭ+wā+oṃṭ+wāṃ /mchan bkod yod pas klog pa po rnams la dka' tshegs mi 'byung ba'i re ba

mazun 'gyur dang len/bcos sgrang 'di bzhin klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul zub pa'i brgyud rim gyi nang sdu nga'i dga' nye blo dkar du ma zhig gis mthun 'gyur ram 'degs gnang yod pa'i nang nas thog mar bod kyi dus bab kyi rtsom sgrig pa sku zhabs lhag bsam lags kyis sgrang deb 'di bod kyi dus bab nas dpar skran gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba dang ༄/deb 'di'i bkod sgrig dang / jus 'god/༄par du btab pa bcas la gus pas sting thag pa nas bod kyi dus bab kyi las bya tshang mar bcos min zugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ de bzhin bod kyi dus bab kyi rtsom sgrig pa zur pa sku zhabs dge 'dun rab gsal lags kyis ma phyir dag cha zhu dag gnang ba dang / i mekha/ en ḍi/bho li sku si/ phri/ṭi beṭi/ jin jar/ el/ ingaka/(2k+ṣelngakhu 4 201103 ja‘༷dzi06rngu ku1satharngu141'i 1ba0 )gi sbyin bdag lho lha/ ruka (20nekhyiskya sku00smo)dang/ ṭi beṭan/ bro jekaṭi/ kal ca ral/ sar wayiwal/ 6)ngaka/ (11 khyidzi 'ib ji103dzikhu dzudzi1 5181 bya5pag1 5'i1 1sa0 ) gi krisi ṭo phar/ wal ṭar/(dzu'i 3 09khyikhu1 gagalnga1 khu7)gnyis nas lhag bsam bzang pos kun nas bslongs te deb 'di'i dpar skrun gyi mazun 'gyur sbyar gnang ba bcas la rtsam pa pas snyeng thag pa nas rjes su yi rangs dang /zugs rje bla lhag tu che zhes lan brgyar zhu rgyu yin/

spyag1 mi tshe'i zo ba mngar skyur/da༅༅/ /'jig rten 'di yi smag rub sel la snang byed lta bu'i sku mnga' ba//ma rig log pa'i lta ngan bablog phyir seng ge'i sgra las lhag pa'i gsung //skye rgu'i sgo gsum sgrib gnyis sbyong la byams dang snying rje'i thugs ldan pa'i//ma 'dris 'gro ba'i rtsa lag nyid gcig 7skyabs mgon phyag na pad mor 'dud//mtshams sgrin gsar pa'i kha dog dang mtshungs bltas pas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku//dbyed kyi rgyal mo'i rlu dbyangs bzhin du nyan pas mi ngoms snyan pa'i gsung //yangs zhing rgya che'i rgya mtsho dang mnyam bsgoms pas mi ngoms brtse ba'i zugs//rmongs pa'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin pa'i rgyud mangs 'dzin pa de la 'dud//rdo lcags bye ma'i rgyu las ma grub kun rtog glog gi 'asrul la brten//lha bris mkhas pa'i spar gyis ma bris rnam dasad rig pa las grub pa'i//bcos sgrang mi che'i zlos gar ston pa yid la 'thad pa'i gzugs brnyan zhig/mkhas snams mgu ba'i ro bcud dkon yang byis pa dga' ba'i rna rgyan zhig /bal dang srin gyi rgyu las ma grub sna tshogs dus kyi rgyud rim ded//gser dang dngul gyi sbrun la ma brten kun rtog glog gi klad pas btags//sbyin dang la cha'i rtsi yis ma sbyar rnam dbyod ngag gi sgyu rtsal las//byung ba'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga shar 'dra'i chu mig dgu bsgril 'di na spel//

ka sbug bad gzhung slab grwa༄༅༅// //blo bzang gi mi che'i nang brjed par dka' ba'i don rkyen rdo la ri mo bkod pa ltar phra lam mer gsal ba 'ga' zhig byung ba'i nang nas gcig ni/ kho pa ka sbyag bod gzhung slob grwa'i nang du slebs te zla ba drug phyin pa'i rjes su bod dge lhun grub lags kyi 'dzin grwa'i nang du byung / blo bzang 'dzin grwa lnga pa ka pa'i nang du yod pa dang / 'dzin grwa de'i nang du bu nyi shu dang bu mo bco lnga bcas khyon bsdoms slob rgyag sum cu so lnga yod/ bar skabs thig nas kho pa'i 'dzin grwa der tshogs zun dang por dge rgan yong gi med pas 'dzin grwa'i rgan bdag gnyis kyis sgrig lam lta rtog byed khul byas kyang / phru gu mang che bas rgan bdag gi kha la ma nyan par 'ga' zhig gis phan tshun ku re byed pa dang /skad cor rgyag pa/'ga' zhig gis mdun cog sngas la bcug ste gnyid khug pa/'ga' zhig gis rang rang gis lta sbyong ba'i rgya gar slog brnyan gyi sgrang bsnyed pa der 'ga' zhig gis rna ba krong krong byas te nyan sngod pa dang / 'ga' snyene gis sgog bu'i bye'u bzos te phar g.yugs tshur g.yugs byed pa skusnags mdor na tshogs zun skar ma bzhi bcu'i ring la ra lug lhas nang bcug pa

2 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/lta bu zhig las deb klog rtse rang sbyong byed mkhan su yang med/ rgan bdag gnyis kyis las par dbyug pa ring po re thogs te 'dzin grwa'i nang du yar mar rgyu ba dang /skabs re dbyug pa rgya cog steng du thag sgra dang bcas gzhus te/ 6‘skad cor ma rgyag kye ’mi zhes/ baji+od pa tsam las de min 'dzin grwar dge rgan gyi tshab byas te lta skyong byed zub pa'i spobs pa dang sems khyar gyi zhus pa gang yang med/de nyin rgan lhun grub lags tshogs thun dang por blo bzang gi 'dzin grwa'i nang du slebs ma thag rgan bdag phun tshogs kyis ‘‘yar bzhengs ’ri zhes baji+od par slob phrug tshang ma yar langs/ phun tshogs kyis ‘6rgan lags/ bkris bde legs ’ zhes skad shugs chen 〈snas baji+od pa'i rjes su gzhan tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis 6‘bkris bde legs ’ zhes zhus/ rgan lhun grub lags kyis skar ma gnyis tsam gyi ring la thog mar 'dzin grwa'i nag pang nas mgo btsugs te/ rgya cog dang / zhabs kyag rtsig 'dabs kyi gyang sbyar ri mo dang /'dzin grwa'i sgo dang sgeñca khung / de bzhin slob phrug re re bzhin ngo gdong la zugs zhib tshags pos gzigs gnang pa'i rjes su rang nyid kyi phyag tu bsnams pa'i slob deb 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams rgya cog steng gi sa smyug gi thal bar phu rgyag bzhin du rgya cog steng du bzhag rjes ‘6bkris bde legs/ mar bzhugs gnang ’ zhes cung zhal 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas gsungs/ de nas khong gis thog mar rang nyid ngo sbrod cig byed dgos dgongs te/ ‘‘de ring nas bzung nga khyed rang tsho'i 'dzin grwa'i dge rgan dang / bod yig slob tshan gyi dge rgan red/ nga'i ming la lhun

ka sbug ngo da gzhung blo ba grwa 3grub zer gyi yod/ nga'i pha ma nye 'brel tshos gces ming lta bur nga la e el zhes 'bod gnang gi yod ’’ ces baji+od pa dang mnyam du nag pang steng du e dang el chen po zhig bris te/e zer na a 'brug tshang dang /el zer na lhun grub red/ces smras/ de nas slar yang mu mthud de/ ‘‘nga de snga bod rgya 'og tu ma shor gong la dhar ji ling 1saṇaṭi ṅgā+o seb lhaslob grwar phyin pa red/de rjes ldi li gtsug lag slob grwa'i nang mtho rim slob sbyong lo gsum dang / de nas dge rgan 'os sbyong lo gcig byas te da lo 'os sbyong mthar thon ma thag bod gzhung shes rig bka' blon gyis ka sbug tu 'gro dgos zhes bka' phebs pa bzhin 'di gar yong ba yin/ ngas de snga bod du sdod skabs dge rgan zur du bsten te bod yig lo lnga drug cig sbyangs myong ba ma gotogs rgya gar du slebs rjes mu mazud de dmigs bsal bod yig la sbyangs pa byed rgyu ma byung ba sku nga tsang / de tsam gyis bod yig gnas tshad yag po yod pa ma red de/ med pa las drag tsam zhig slob zub kyi red snyam pa'i sems khur blangs te khas len byas te yong ba yin ’’ zhes brjod/ de nas slob phrug tshor gzigs te skar cha 'ga' zhig ring cang ma smras/ gang 'tshams nas 'dzin grwa'i nag pang gi mdun du lag pa gnyis rang nyid kyi gu thung gi sba khyag g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi nang du bcug ste dal bu'i 'gros kyis phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed bzhin pa'i ngang du sbyan gnyis 'dzin grwa'i nag pang la gzigs te/ ‘‘khyed rang tshos phal cher shes gsal ltar zhub phyogs pa'i slob gso rig pa'i lam lugs nang bshad pa bzhin byas na//5 0 go/ṭ+wāṃ~Xdīshā dithabod mi rgan pa tshos rdo rje gling zhes 'bod kyi yod/

4 mi che'i zo ba mngar skyur/thog mar dge rgan dang dge srug phan tshun ngo shes pa byed rgyu de gal chen por brtsi ba red/ gtam gyi dbe la yang / grogs phan tshun ngo sbyod ma byung na/ su yin min mngon shes su la'ang med/ ces zer ba red/ byas tsang ngas khyed tshor nga rang ngo sbrod byas pa yin/ da khyed rang tshos re re bzhin nga la ngo sbrod gnang rogs gnang ’ri zhes gsungs/rgan lhun grub lags kyis de ltar gsungs pa dang blo bzang gis gtsos pa'i slob rgyag mang che ba'i sems kyi nang du sngar rgyun dang mi gcig pa'i tshor ba rtse zing zing dang / bzod mi bde ba/ khyad mtshar po zhig byung / de 'dra yong don ni dus rgyun dge rgan gsar pa su 'dra zhig slebs kyang lam seng slob tshan mgo btsugs te slob khrid byed pa ma gtogs/dge rgan dang slob phrug phan tshun ngo sgod byed sgol gang yang med/ lhag par du skabs de dus rgyun ljan bod gzhung slob grwa khag gi nang du dge rgan gyis mar gang bslab pa dang gsungs pa de ma gtogs/ slob phrug dang dge rgan dbar la phan tshun bsam tshul brje len dang /'brel ba lhug po sku1nga rgyu lta zhogaslob phrug tshor rang gis mi shes pa'i dogs 'asdu'i rigs dge rgan la dogs sel byed pa'i goms gzhis thig med la/dge rgan tsho'i ngos nas kyang de lta'i khor yug cig bskran thabs gnang srol yang phal cher med/ des na de nyin 'aljin grwa'i nang du slob phrur+sha 'ga' zhig gis hang sangs mdog gi rnam 'gyur dang bcas phan tshun phar lta tshur lta byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis rgan lhun grub lags kyis gang gsungs pa de rgya mtshor rdo g.yugs pa'am/ yang na bong bu'i rna mchog tu gser

ka spug the da gzhung slo ba grwa 5blugs pa ltar tshor snang gang yang med par bsnad/ re zung zhig gis mig thur la bkug ste pha zhi bar mya ngan byed pa'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur ltar bstan te bsnad/ de bzhin bod gzhung slob grwa'i bu mo phal che bar dus rgyun du ‘‘zhi bar shog ’’zer ba'i dmod tshig bor ba'i gathis ka ngan lang du sgor ba zhig yod pa'i dbang gis kun slong ngan pa de 'dra gang yang med kyang bu yo mang che bas rgan lags de thi bar sgog ces dmod chig bor ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis mgo bo rang rang gi mdun cog steng du bkug ste deb la lta khul byed bzhin gnas pa'i gnas bab cig blo bzang gis mthong /de 'dra'i pod la rgan lhun grub kyis/‘‘ya/ da khyed rang tsho re re bzhin yar bzhengs te ngo spro da cig 〈snas dang zhes snod gral g.yas 〈snags kyi sne mor bsnad sku1da pa'i rgan bdag phyan tshogs la mdzub mo btsugs/ rgan bdag phyan tshogs kyis rang nyid kyi maho bo lag pa g.yas pas phur rgyur byed bzhin yar langs te/ 6‘nga'i ming la rgyun tshogs zer gyi po da/ nga 'dzin grwa'i rgan bdag dang pho yin/’ zhes baji+od de mar bsnad/ de'i mtshams der dngos grub bsnad sku da pas yar langs te sna khyang phyar sur gtong bzhin du 66nga'i ming la dngos grub yin/ nga 'dzin grwa'i rgan bdag gnyis pa de yin/ yin na'ang kho nga tshos nga la kyag kyag byas te rgan bdag tu bsgos sku nga ’ zhes baji+od pa dang tshang ma ha ha zhes gad mo shor/ de rjes zla ba sgrol ma'i res mosnas slebs/ mos 〈snag mar yar ma langs par dus yun gang 'tsham bsnad/ de nas 〈snad grosnags g.yang 'dzo+oms kyis zla ba sgrol mar yar 'e1ngas zhes

6 mi che'i sdu/ ba mngar skyur/skul 'ded byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan te lag pas phul rgyag gang mang byas pa'i rjes su yar langs tsam zhig byas kyang / kha nas chig gcig kyang ma smras par skra yongs rdzogs mig la bkab ste mya ngan byed pa ltar langs te bsnad par/ rgan lhun grub lags kyis bya mo 'di ngo tsha smin po zhig yin pa 'dra dgongs te/ 66gsungs ma thub na gang yang gnang gi ma red/ khyed rang mar bzhugs gnang ’’ zhes mo'i mgo la phyag gis phur tsam zhig byas te bsngad du bcug pa dang lhan du g.yang 'dzoms la gzigs te/‘6mo'i ming la ga re red mi’ces bka' 'dri gnang /g.yang 'dzoms phran bu zhed snang dang bcas thi bar shog ces skad shugs chung ngu'i ngang dpod bor bzhin du yar langs te/ ‘6zla ba sgrol ma ’’ zhes brjod/ rgan lhun grub kyis ‘6khyed rang gi ming ga re yin ’mi zhes sdus pa'i lan du g.yang 'dzoms kyis rang gi mig rdo gcal du lta bzhin pa'i ngang nas 6‘g.yang 'dzoms ’ zhes smus/rgan lhun grub kyis slar yang ‘‘khyed rang pha yul gang nas yin pas ’mi zhes dris pa'i lan du g.yang 'dzoms kyis 66bod nas yin ’ zhes lab pa dang kho nga tsho tshang ma rang dbang med par gad mo shor/ rgan lhun grub rang nyid kyang gad mosna shor bzhin du slad phyin dri ba 'dir mno bsam zhig gtong rgyu 'dug snyam pa zhig byung /de nas ngag dbang gi bang rim slebs/ rang nyid kyi rkang pa gnyis kyi snyeng du gzugs po mi theg pa ltar dal bu'i sgo nas yar langs te ‘‘rgan lo/ bdag yi ming la ngag dbang zer gyi yod/bdag rang skye sa rdzong kha nas yin ’mizhes brjod par kho'i skad cha'i sgra gdangs kyi rkyen pas slar yang tshang ma gad yo sgor/

ka sbug bod gzhung slob grwa 7de rjes blo bzang yar langs te/ ‘‘rgan lags/ nga'i ming la blo bzang yi rna nga thog mar gzhis ka rtse nas a ne+e lags kyis bal po'i tshong pa zhig la mngags te bal yul du 'byor song / bal yul bod gzhung don gcod khang gis bod phrug gzhan lnga dang mnyam du dha shod zur gsog slob grwar bskyal gnang song /zur gsog slob grwar lo gcig tsam bsnad rjes bod gzhung gis 'di gar btang gnang song / 'di gar slebs nas da lta zla ba drug ma gtogs 'gro gi med/ dngos 'brel byas na nga 'dzin grwa gsum par 'gro mkhan red de/ 'di gar slebs rjes slob grwa'i las khyangs nas bod yig dang / dbyin ji/ ang rdzis bcas kyi tshod rgyugs zhig blangs te nga tsho bu gsum 'dzin grwa lnga par bzhag gnang song / pha ma gnyis ka rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su rgya mis btson 'jug byas te pa lags btson khang du 'das grongs snye+or ba dang / a ma lags de'i mya ngan gyis rang zhi rgyag dgos byung ba red/ nga tsho sbrun mched gnyis la lha skyong byed mkhan a zhe gcig ma gtogs med/a ne+e dang jo jo gnyis da lta'ang rgya 'og tu yod red/ gzhan pa dmigs bsal zhu yag med/zugs rje che gnang ri’ zhes smras te rang gnas su bsnad/ blo bzang gis zhed snang 'tsher snang med par rang nyid kyi ngo sbrod mdor bsdus byas pa des 'dzin grogs gzhan tsho'i snang ngor ji shar baji+od dka' yang rgan lhun grub lags kyi sems nang du blo bzang dus nam yang mi brjed pa'i bag chags brtan po zhig nges par du bskrun zub pa byung / rgan lhun grub lags kyis de nyin blo bzang bskyar du nag pang gi 'khris su skad

8 mi che'i 11 ba mngar skyur/btang ste/ ‘‘khyed rang slob grug gzhan dag tshos blo bzang la mig dpe nges par du lta dgos/ blob spyong byed mkhan zer dus blo bzang nang bzhin dge rgan la zhed snang dang 'tsher snang med par skad cha shod zub pa dang /skad cha gang bshad pa de yang snga phyi gral 'grig po dang don la 'jug po/ chig gsal la skad gsang mthon por shod rgyu de dag kyang slob grwa'i nang du slob tshan gzhan dang mnyam du sbyong brdar byed dgos rgyu'i gras thig red/de 'dra song tsang khyed rang tsho mang po zhig la da lta dbyin ji'i kha skad la ma song na selapha/ koṇaji ḍinas/3 yang na rang gis rang la yid ches zhes pa'i gdeng tshod dang sbobs pa de med pa 'dra/ slob sbyong byed mkhan la 'di nges par du mkho ba'i cha rkyen zhig red/ yang ngas nga rgyal byed dgos red zhu gi med/ zla ba lnga pa dang rgyal ba lnga pa gnyis ma nor ba gnang rogs gnang / gtam gyi dpe la/ nga rgyal gyi be|nga bya la/yon tan gyi chu mi chags/ zhes pa ltar nga rgyal dang rang gis rang la yid ches zhes pa de sanyis gcig pa ma red/ byas tsang khyed rang tshos da nas bzung rang gis rang la yid ches ldan pa'i sems tshor gsar pa zhig bskyed de slob sbyong gnang dgos pa gal chen po red/ mkhyen song ngam ’ zhes blo bzang la phyag cig btang ste ‘‘nga'i 'dzin grwa'i nang du slob phrug khyed rang 'dra ba sha stag yod na slob sbyong slob rgyur dka' ngal rtsa ba nas yong sa ma red/thugs rje che gnang /blo bzang lags/da khyed rang mar bzhugs gnang ’zhes gsungs te blo bzang rang gnas su btang /3byarngu/(—khu0ba( spudzibakhudzi

ka spug bod gzhung slob grwa 9nyin mo de ni blo bzang gi mi tshe'i nang du mi mang po'i dkyil nas yar langs te skad cha bshad pa thog ma de yin par ma zad rang gis rang ngo shes pa dang / rang gis rang la gdeng 'jog dang sbobs pa rnyed pa'ang thog ma de yin/ de nyin thog mar rgan lhun grub lags kyis ‘‘khyed rang tsho re re bzhin nga la ngo sbrod byed dgos ’’ gsungs pa dang blo bzang gi sems la dngangs 'tshab dang / zhed snang / 'tsher snang bcas bsnoms pa'i snying 'dar ba lta bu'i tshor ba mi bde ba zhig skyes pa dang lhan du sems nang du gang shod dgos bsam pa'i don tshan rnams gra sgrig byas te sngod pa'i pod la rang gi bang rim slebs pas gang dran pa rnams thol byung du bshad/ lhag par du de nyin rgan lhun grub lags kyis blo bzang la mig dpe lta dgos zhes rang la bstod bsngags gnang ba des blo bzang la slob sbyong hur thag byed par sems shugs sgor ba'i skul lcag sngar byung ma myong ba zhig kyang thebs/ yang sgos blo bzang gi mi che'i nang du blo bzang lags zhes zhe sa gnang mkhan dang po de yang rgan lhun grub lags yin/blo bzang rang gnas su bsnad zin ma thag 6‘ting ting ’ zhes 'dzin grwa grol brda btang bar rgan lhun grub lags kyis ‘‘de ring de tsam yin/khyed rang tsho slob rgyag lhag ma snu'i ngo sbrod mu mthud de sang nyin dang gnangs nyin bcas la gnang rgyu byas/yang gal te zhal nas gsungs gnang mi zub mkhan tshos so so'i ngo sbrod mdor bsdus re nga la bris te sbrad na yang 'grigs kyi red/ mkhyen song ngam/ byas na bkris bde legs ’’zhes gsungs te 'dzin grwa'i phyi la phebs grabs gnang skabs/
