boko brda 34 'phrod pacirnge 'bakraca/ 'ugribaka༄༅༅/ /dgod bro ba zhig la ka sbyag slob grwa'i gnyer pa yo ni ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ 1lha zhes pas dmigs su bkar te kun slong bcangs min ji ltar yang / dus dran dang gling kha sogs kyi skabs su slob phrug rer skabs re ke swā gcig dang tsha lu ma gnyis re dang / yang skabs rer sgo nga gnyis dang 'o zhang bag leb nar leb ma dbus su gris gtubs shul ser kha ldan pa re sbrod srol yod/ de 'dra'i skabs su bu mo rgan pa phal che bas phan tshun gcig gis gcig la balhas te gad mo shor ba dang / bu 'ga' zhig gis bu mo tshor brnyas bsko lta bur de ring thing tog ga re sprad song zhes sdu ba 'god pa dang /'ga' zhig gis ‘‘eka/ke swā/dwo saṇatru/ du+o aṇaḍa/ eka/'o shang /matalapha/ku thi/swāpha/he ’’zhes zur za dang bcas gzhas gtong srol yod/gong gsal gzhas chig de bod skad du bsgyur na/ ‘‘ngang lag gcig dang tsha lu ma gnyis/ sgo nga gnyis dang 'o shang gcig go don phal cher gsal po red ’’ces zer ba yin/ blo bzang rkang pol rtses par mgo 'khor te bsnad yod pa'i skabs der 12twa0ba1ja'iba'i

24 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/gnyer pa ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ drel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis rtsed thang du yong ste slob phruge/ thug tshad tshang mar ‘6kan dzo ga par 'dug kan dza mthong byung ngam ’’zhes 'dri bzhin rgyugs pa dang / slob phrug gzhan pa sus kyang dri lan 'jal gyi med pa blo bzang gis shes te gnyer pa ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ'i sar dmigs bkar phyin te/ ‘‘gnyer pa lags/ kan cha da gin po lo rtse gin 'dug da lta phal cher nyal khang du log pa 'dra ri’zhes brjod skabs/gnyer pa ṭ+wāṃ nu khong khro langs te gdong dmar por gyur te/ 6‘nga las ka mi tshar ba'i brel ba 'di 'dra yod bzhin du khyed kyis nga la rtsed mo rtses kyin yod pas ’’zhes baji+od bzhin du lag pa g.yas pas blo bzang la 'gram lcag lug ma dran pa gsum bsdud mar gzhus pas blo bzang gi 'gram pa g.yon mar mdzub mo'i par rjes khra lam mer gsal ba zhig bzos te slar yang slob grwa'i tshogs khang phyogs su rgyugs ma 'gros kyis phyin blo bzang ci bya gtol med du gyur te mig chu gtong bzhin langs te bsnad yod skabs 'gyur med yong ste/ ‘‘ga re byas song / ga re byas song / blo bzang ga re byas song ’zhes 'dri bzhin blo bzang gi dpyang pa/ra lag pa 'chang skabs/ blo bzang gis ‘‘ngas kān cha da gig po lo rtses kyin 'dug da lta nyal khang du log pa 'dra lab par khos nga la don med gzhus byung ’’zhes bshad pa dang 'gyur med dang nye 'khris su yod pa'i slob phrug gzhan rnams tshang ma rang dbang med par gad mo shor/ rgyu mtshan ni gnyer pa ra nus bod skad yag po de tsam shes kyi med pa dang / de nyin dgong dro slob grwa'i bya dga' gsol ras sprod pa'i mdzad sgo'i go sgrig byed dgos kyi yod stabs/ sdings cha'i steng du 'phred dar sogs 'dogs par skas 'dzegs dgos kyi yod pas skas 'dzegs ga par 'dug ces

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag lha5'tshol ba las rang nyid kyi bu kun cha 'tshol gyi med kyang / blo bzang gi bsam par gnyer pas kān cha 'tshol gyi 'dug snyam ste bo rdor thebs pa yin/ 'gyur med kyis blo bzang la gnyer pas zhing gi skas 'dzegs 'tshol gyi yod pa'i gsal bshad byas skabs blo bzang rang nyid kyang gled mo shor/chu tshod bcu pa zin pa dang blo bzang gis 'gyur med la 6‘'gyur med/ da nga tsho skal ljan gyi sgrang nyan par 'gro gi min nam ’ zhes smras/ de'i lan du 'gyur med kyis ‘pho rerdo/ 'gro 'gro da phal cher mgo btsugs tshar med 'gro ngas rbad de brjed bzhag ’’ ces baji+od bzhin khong gnyis khang tshan gsum pa'i bar 'khyams yod sa der slebs skabs skal ldan dang lhan du bya gzhan dag bdun tsam zhig sgor lgor byas te bsnad yod pa dang / skal lngan gyis sgrang mgo 'dzugs grabs byed kyi yod pa mthong / khong gnyis khong tsho dang lhan du rdori ma bsnad sngon la bkris kyis 66kye/ khyed rang gnyis sgrung nyan na rjes ma gza' nyi ma'i sgo nga sngar rgyun ltar nga la sbrod dgos red da/ shes song ngam ’zhes baji+od pa'i lan du khong gnyis kyis khas len byed pa'i tshul du mgo bo gug gug byed bzhin gral du bsdad/ skal ldan gyis ṭ+wā+oṃ ṭ+wāṃ/na sgrung ring thung gnyis bshad tshar ba dang nyin gung kha lag ran pas sgrung thun skal ljan ni pho lo nyer gcig tsam la slebs pa'i pho gsar gzugs ring po dang /byad bzhin mthong bde po/ skad sbom po/ rtsed rigs la de tsam mi dga' ba/ dus

26 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/rtag tu lag par deb gcig nges par du 'khyer te 'gro mkhan zhig dang / dmigs bsal gyi rig rtsal lta bur gling ge sar gyi sgrung dang / ro sgrang / de bzhin rgya gar glog brnyan gyi sgrang sogs shod skabs mi sna'i 'grel bzhad rdong / don rkyen gyi bang rim/ yul ljodros kyi bkod pa/ mi sna phan tshun dbar gyi gtam gleng sogs nyan pa pos glog brnyan dngos su bltas pa bzhin yid 'phrog pa dang / gson nyams lngan pa/ nyan pa po rnams kyi rna ba rang 'gul gyis 'gug thub pa zhig yod/ mdor na kho pas sgrang ji 'dra zhig bshad kyang tshang mas a bra'i bru gu gnyid sad pa ltar rna ba krong ༷ji byas te nyan nas snod kyi yod/ skal lngan ni khang tshan gsum pa'i bcu shog dang po'i bcu dpon yin pa ma zad slob grwa sbyi'i rgan bdag kyang yin/ kho pas gza' nyi ma phal che bar rang gi grogs po bkris dang lhan du slob phrug lo na chung ba'i rigs bskong ste sgrung shod kyi yod/ bkris ni skal lngan gyi grogs po tsam ma zad spyan bsal lta bu yin/ des na bkris kyis skol lngan gyi sgrung nyan par yongo mkhan gyi+o slob phrug tshang ma'i sa nas gza'o nyi ma'i sga nga bsdus te skal lngan la sbrad kyi yad pas skabs rer skal lngan la sga nga bcu grangs za rgyu yong gi yod pa dang / yang skabs rer slob phrug 'ga' zhig gis sgo nga rang gis zos te dus thog tu ma sbrad pa byung na bkris kyis de'i steng du chad pa lta bur gza' phyar bu'i thing tog kyang skal lngan la spu+od dgos pa bzo gi yod/ skal lngan gyis slob phrug tsho'i sa nas sgrang gla sgo nga len gyi yod par brten slob rgyag tshos kyang kho par ming 'dogs sgo nga'i rūl po zhes 'bod kyi yod/

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 27bkris kyi pha ma ka sbug tu gtan sdod byed kyi yod pa ma zad khong tshor tā+opa khu nur za khang zhig dang /grong khyer nang du thug pa'i bzo grwa zhig kyang yod/pa phas bzo grwa dang a mas za khang der lta rtog byed kyi yod/ des na bkris la rgyun du slob grwa'i nang lag dngul 'bel po dang / rngan pa bza' rgyu mang po yod pa ma zad skabs 'gar kho pa'i nang nas sprad pa'i rngan pa sbar phi dang / swā phing / ca na/ mog mog sogs slob phrug gzhan la thing tog dang /'o shang /sgo nga /deb chas bcas dang brje len byed kyi yod/ skal ldan dang bkris gnyis khrom la ga dus phyin kyang bkris kyis skal ldan rang gi za khang du khrid de thug pa dang mog mog sogs rin med du sbrod kyi yod pas skal ldan gyis bkris la dga' po byed pa yin/gnas tshul 'di'i rigs slob grwar dar khyab yod pa dge las slob sbyog tshang mas shes kyi yod kyang mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' slob dang / bsam 'char gang yang yong gi med/ yang gnas tshul 'di rigs dar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo gnyis yod/ gcig ni/skabs der slob phrug phal che bar lag dngul dkon po yod pa dang / lhag par du slob phrug rgan gras rnams slob grwa'i kha lag dus gsum sprad pa des grod khog rtsa ba nas 'grangs kyi med pa dang /gnyis pa ni/slob phrug gzhon pa tshos slob phrug rgan par brtsi bkur dang / zhed snang zhe drags byed kyi yod pas blo kha ma rangs pa'i dka' ngal ji yod cang mi saba'i tshul gyis sdug 'khyar te snod pa las dge rgan las byed la zhu srol phal cher med pa 'dra bo yin/ gnas tshul 'di rigs la glo bur du bsam mno btang na slob grwa'i dge las tshos snang chung dang /do

28 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/snang ma byas pa lta bur mngon yang / mno bsam zhib mor gtong skabs gang zag sger gyi rang dbang la do phog ma btang ba gsal po yod/ gang gis she na/ de'i skabs su slob phrug brgya cha dgu bcu tham pa tsam slob grwa nas gang sbrad pa'i zas gos la brten pa ma gtogs lag dngul yong khungs med nga dang / skabs der slob phrug phal che ba'i pha ma spun mched tshang ma bod nas skyabs bcol du 'byor grabs yin par brten/ lag pa ring yang phu thung thung ba'i dpe ltar rang rang gi phru gur lag dngul phran bu bskur 'dod sems nang yod kyang bskutha rgyu'i dngul med pa'i rkyen gyis bya thabs ma byung ba dang / yang pha ma snying che ba 'ga' zhig sis ‘6nga'i phru gu 7rgyal ba rin po che dang / bod gzhung la phul tshar ba yin ’’zhes tha na zla gnyis gung gseng zhu rgyu lta zhogs yig 'brel tsam yang med par phru gu tshos rang gi pha ma sa gnas gang du yod min ya nga mi shes pa mang po yod/ 'di 'dra'i gnas stangs/ thig gi 'og tu lag dngul yong khyangs tso ba nas med pa'i slob phrug tshos gzhung nas sbrad pa'i zhing tog dang sgo nga sogs skabs re dngul dang brjes te rang 'dod kyi rngan pa nyo ba dang / skabs re snyu gu dang 'bri deb/ gyon chas sogs dgos mkho'i rigs dang brje ba/ skabs re grogs po dang grogs mo'i ngo bsu ba dang blo 'gugs thabs su bed spyod gtong ba/skabs re rtse+od mo'i+o rgyal du+o 'dzugaso pa/skabs re sgrung gla dang sgrig chas bkrus pa'i gla la bed spyad gtang ba sags mdar na sga nga dang zhing tog la dngul gyi rin thang yod pa bzo zub pa de ni skabs de'i slob phrug tsho'i rig rtsal yang yin la dpal 'byor gyi gnas snyangs ston pa'i skyo gtam yang yin/

go brda ma 'a11da pa'i 'gram lca ga 29dber na/ nyin gcig 'gyur med grod khog ha cang ltogs byung bas gza' phur bu'i thing tog de skal lngan la sgrung glar spru+od dgos kyi yod kyang de nyin za zhen 'gog ma thub par zos zin pa dang yad langs te bkris dang skal lngan la g.yol thabs kyis 'dzin khang gi nang du khu mim mer 'dzul te bsnad/ 'on kyang bkris kyis kho pa'i rjes ded nas 'dzin khang du slebs pa dang / ‘‘kye/ zhing tog ga par yod/ 'khyer shog ’’ces baji+od/ 'gyur med kyis rang nyid kyi mgo bo lag pa gnyis kas phur phyar byed bzhin du 6‘de ring shing tog rul pa zhig las thob ma song / byas tsang ngas g.yugs bzhag pa yin/ rjes ma sbrod chog ’’ces smras/ der bkris kyis/ ‘6skyag rdzun ma shod kye/ khyed rang gis za ba ngas mthong byung / nga la mig yod ma red bsam gyi 'dug gam ’’zhes baji+od pa dang 'gyur med kyi bsam par rdzun gyi mtha' ma lcags yin kyang brdol zer ba ltar da dzun rkub brdol song snyam ste/ 66dgongs dag de ring nga glen rtags ltoges song / byas tsang zas bzhag pa yin/ rjes su zhing tog gnyis sprad chog mi’ces smras/ 'on kyang bkris kyis rlung langs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas 'gyur med kyi skra gtsug nas lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ ‘‘de ring khyed rang gis zhing tog ma sbyad na ngas las sla par 'ji+og gi min/ shes song ngam zhes lagle pa geyas pas mur rdzog gnyis gsum zhig gzhus/ 'gyur med kyis ‘6med pa la 'khyer shog dang / thi ba la longs she+og zer rgyu yod pa ma red/ngas dgongs dag rjes ma sbrad chog lab tshar ba yin ’’zhes ngu bzhin smras/ der bkris kyis ‘6dgongs pa dag rgyu yod pa ma red kye/ bsam blo sngon nas gtong dgos red/ ltos dang da dung gtam a phas gtong rgyu a mas btang / khyi bdag

30 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/pos 'gog rgyu mgron pos bkag gtam dpe cistan gcig shes pa la dga' rab yin mdog mdog thing tog sbrod rtsis med na sgrung nyan par yong nas ga re byed kyi yin ’’zhes slar yang mur rdzog gnyis gzhus pa'i skabs la skal lngan der slebs pa dang / skal ljan gyis ‘‘bkris / kho la zhing tog sprod rgyu med na/ de'i tshab la snyu gu de 'phrog zhogang la snyu gru zhig dgos kyi 'dug ’’ces baji+od pa dang bkris kyis 'gyur med kyi stod thung sba khug la gzer yod pa'i 'bri snyug de 'phrog ste skal lngan la sprad/'gyur med kyis sems zhin tu skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas 68d+ku la snyu gu gcig las med/ 'di khyer na sang nyin nga la 'dzin grwa'i nang du yi ge 'bri byed med/ yi ge ma bris na rgan lags kyis nyes pa gtong gi red/ sku mkhyen de ma 'khyer rogs gnang ’ zhes zhu ba ji tsam 'then kyang khong gnyis kyis ma nyan pa ra snyu gu 'khyer te 'dzin grwa'i phyi la thon/ 'gyur bed der ngu bzhin bsdad pas gang 'tsham zhig nas blo bzang yong ste byung rkyen shes pa dang / 'gyur med kyi lag pa nas 'jus te sems gso dang bcas ‘jim gzhi nas sgrang nyan tshar ba'i rjes la shing tog mi sbrod pa gang byed/ da yin na yang sas byed kyi rmi red/ nga la snyu gu gnyis yod/ gcig khyed rang la spud chog da sems bral ma byed/ nga gnyis rtsed thang la 'gro rnya’zhes blo bzang gis 'gyur med 'khrid de rtsed thang du rkang pol rtses par bskyod/res gza' zla ba'i tshogs thun dang po'i skabs su blo bzang gi 'dzin grwa'i nang gi

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 31slob phrug phal che ba 'khrungs skar dus dran nyin gsum gyi ring la sbro skyid btang ba dang / rtsed rigs sna tshogs rtses te dgong dro phyi po bsnad pa'i rkyen gyis nyob snang shas che ba'i rnam pa dang bcas 'dzin grwa'i nang du bsnad yod pa'i skabs der bod dge lhun grub lags sngar rgyun las zhal dkar ba dang / rnam rig grung pa༈ na bza' dngos gtsang legs pa dang bcas 'dzin grwa'i nang du phebs te/ 66de ring ngas nyin shas gong la slob phrug tshos 'bri rtsom 'gran bsdur byas pa 'i rtsom 'ba' zhig gi nang nas brjod pa zur 'don byas pa 'ga' zhig gi thog la 'dzin grwa'i nang du bskyar zhib byed 'dod yod/ ngas rtsom 'di tshor lta dus skabs re nga rang sgas kyang baji+od don ma shes pa mad po 'ig mthong gi 'dug byas tsang ngas re re bzhin nag pang steng du 'bri gi yin/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas do snang yas po byos ang ha’zhes gsungs te rgya cog gi steng nas sa smyug rdo las kyang mkhregs po/ nag pang gi ngas su gris brad pa lta bu'i brad shul bza mkhan 'ig blad+ku sa te bajid pa thung ngu ‘‘sgong tog nang zhing bug la gong ri mtho mo mong po yu/ bug mi mong la sen shug yu red de/ lho jong mid na sen shug gi mi phan ’’ zhes bris te/ ‘‘'di ngag dbang dpal mos bris 'dug ngas zhib tshags po byas te klog dus khams skad kyi sgra gdangs ji ba'in bris pa 'dra ’’zhes gsungs pa dang ngag dbang dpal mo mgo bo gug ste bsnad yod pa blo bzang gis mthong ste/ ‘6rgan lags/ ngas baji+od pa de bsgyar na 'grigs kyi red pas ’’ zhes sdus par rgan lhunalagrub kyis 6‘yong nga /yorjo nga / khyed rang yar ba'engs te nag pang gi steng du phris dang rita zhes bka' gnang bas blo bzang gis nag pa nga steng du ‘‘sgang tog nang bzhin bod la gangs ri

32 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/mtho bo mang po yod/ bod mi mang la sems shugs yod red de/ slob sbyong med na sems shugs kyis mi phan ’’ zhes bris par rgan lhun grub kyis ‘‘'o/ de ga rang red/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas dag cha dang baji+od byar do snang yag po byos ang ’zhes ngag dbang dpal mo la dmigs bkar gzigs te gsungs/ de nas slar yang nag pang gi steng du/ 66a ta mig dmar nang la yong dus gu ris bi ya zas tshar 'dug da ga gru bid byas smras song ’’zhes bris te/ 66'di pa sangs sgrol mas bris 'dug rtsa bas mo rang ge nang mi'i lo rgyus snying rje po bris 'dug snye/ngas chig sbyor 'di mgo tshos ma song ri’zhes gsungs ma tshar gong du stobs 'byor gyis ha ha zhes gad mo thor ba las slob phrug gzhan pa tshos ci yang ma smras/ rgan lhun grub kyis stobs 'byor la gzigs te/ ‘‘ga re byas song ’’zhes sdus par stobs 'byor gyis 66rgan lags/ 'di skyid rong ba'i skad red/ a ta zer na jo jo red/ gu ri zer na zhi mi red/ bi ya ni tsi tsi la zer ba red/ byas tsang tshig sbyor des jo jo mig dmar nang la yong dus zhi mis tsi tsi zas tshar 'dug da ga re byed dam lab song ’’zhes pa'i don red ces baji+od pa dang slob phrug tshang ma gad mo thor ba ma zad rgan lhun grub kyang rang dbang med par gad mo shor/slar yang rgan lags kyis/ 66da ngag dbang gis bris pa 'dir gzigs ang ’’zhes nag pang du ‘‘'o ri slob grwa'i sgrig lam dang kru ka yi bas gang dang dga' 'dugabag phye rdzis ni zhag pa nang bzhin yod da ga ’ zhes bris/tshang mas ngag dbang la bltas te gad mo shor/gang 'tsham zhig nas blo bzang gis/ ‘6rgan lags/

go brda ma 'a21da pa'i 'gram lcag 33'di ngas bsgyur ga ’’ zhes dris par rgan lhun grub kyis/ 6‘yong nga / yong nga / khyed rang nga tsho'i skad sgur ba yin da ’’zhes gsungs/ de nas blo bzang gis nag pang steng du ‘‘nga tsho'i ༄slob grwa'i sgrig lam dang slob phrug 'di tsho zhe drags yag po 'dug〈sna zhib brdzis pa nang bzhin yod red ’’ ces bsgyar/ de mtshams rgan lhun grub lags gad mo shor bzhin du ‘6phru gu gcig gime+e sgrung zung thung zhig bris pa de'i nang du 'di ltar bris 'dug lhari ces nag pang gi steng du ‘‘bu za des i la/ i we/be+e su 'o ma la gdab te za na zhim po ong / zhes lab pa dang / i gyis khyo da za e spyong lab pas/ bu za des snga za mā+ong na'i a cus mi tsho za ba ma13nga 'dug ces lab/ rices bris/der dngos grub kyis 66rgan lags/de gro mo ba'i skad red/bu des 55 ma la/ 55 ma lags/ sba ji 'o ma lī btab nas bzas na zhim po 'dugaces brjod pa dang / a mas khyod za myong ngam zhes sdus pa'i lan du bu nges nga za myong ste jo jos mi tsho za ba mthong 'dug ces zer ba red/’’ ces smras/ de rjes slar yang rgan lags kyis ‘‘nga tsho bod la chen po mi dang dkar po rta mang po yod red kyi zhes bris te/ 6‘'di rigs la zhe ṭī li'i skad kyi shan zhugs pa red bsam gyi 'dugang tsho bod la mi chen po dang rta dkar po mang 11 yod red ces thad kar ma bris par chen po mi dang dkar po rta zhes chig sbyor mgo sting slog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med ’’ces nan baji+od gnang ba dang sbrags mu mazud de nag pang du ‘6blab rang bkra this 'khyil na 'od yig ar rdza shes nu mang 'o yo ’’zhes bris te/ 6‘'di 'dra 'bri mkhan de phal cher 55 mdo ba zhig yin pa 'dra/ dngos 'brel byas na/ bla brang bkris 'khyil na bod yig yag po shes mkhan mang po spo+od ’mices 'bri dgos pa

34 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/red/gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gis/ 'jur ta dang / re ḍi o/pa tī ma/spa se sogs lung pa gzhan gyi ming chig mang po zhig bod skad la mu ge shor ba nang bzhin bed spyod byas 'dug pa sa 'di rigs yag po ma red/ bod skad yin na bod skad gtsang ma dang dbyin hin gyi skad yin na de dag shar ma zhig bed sbyod gtong thub pa'i 'bad rtsol byed dgos rgyu de gal chen po red/ de min nya nyung mnyam bsres lta bu'i skad ra ma lug bed sbyod gtong rgyu yod pa ma red/ rang nyid kyis shes kyi med na dge rgan dang slob grogasdo/ gzhan la 'asdu dgos red/ dber na 'di rigs la bod skad du ‘‘lham dang /rlung 'phrin/nang 'jam/lag 'khyer/zhes rang skad du ming tshig yod bzhin du bsre lhad byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ gzhan yang gtam gyi dpe la/ lung tshan re la skad lugs re/ bla ma re la chos lugs re/ zhes pa ltar nga rang tsho lung tshan so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i phal skad 'di rigs kyang snang chung ma byas par nyar tshags dgos rgyu de zhin tu nas gal chen po red/ 'on kyang yig thog tu 'bri skabs bod chol gsum yongs su sus bklags kyang go rtogs zub pa zhig 'bri dgos pa las lung tshan so so'i skad kyi 'gros dang sgra gdangs la sbyar te bris na bod mi gnyis kyi dbar la'ang skad sgyur ba zhig dgos pa yong gi 'dug ga byas tsang 'di tsho'i rigs la do snang nges par byos ang ’lhazhes smras te slob phrug 'ga' shas kyis yag po nyan gyi med pa mkhyen nas de ga rang du brjod mtshams bzhag ste yud tsam zhig gang yang ma gsungs par slob phrug snu'i gdong la lta gin bzhugs pas slob phrug tshang ma grung ril ril byas te nyan rgyu mabesna tshugs pa dang slar yang mu mthud de/ ‘‘phyogs gcig nas khyed rang tsho la zugs khag yod pa ma red/ deng

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 35sang bod gzhung slob grwa tshang ma'i nang du dbus pa dang / gtsang pa/ a mdo ba/'ams pa/ skyed rong ba/ rdzong kha ba/ kong po ba/ gro mo ba/ zhar pa/ mon pa/'grug pa/ 'bras ljongs ba sogs tshang ma gcig tu 'jo+oms yong dus skad ra ma lug lta bu zhig dar khyab 'gro rgyu yin pa de chos nyid red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsam blo btang na khyed rang tsho dopi gnyer yod mkhan tsho la skad rigs mang por 'dris pa bzo rgyu'i go skabs bzang po zhig kyang red/ dper na/ de ring nga rang tshos ‘gu ri ’ zer na zhi mi dang ‘bi ya ’ zer na tsi tsi la zeng gyi mi+od pa de gsar pa shes pa red/ da khyed rang tshos nag pang du bris pa 'di dag mar bshus zhig ’’ces gsungs te slob phrug re re'i sar phyin te ji lhar bshu 'bri byed kyi yod med lta bzhin yar bskyod mar bskyod gnang ste bzhugs/gang 'tsham nas rgan lhun grub lags kyis rang nyid kyi lag 'dogs chu tshod der gzigles tsam byas te tshogs zun grol bar skar ma bcu las med pa shes rjes/‘‘de ring gi rang sbyong gi tshul du khyed rang tshos deng rkesang nga rang tsho'i bod skad kyi nang du hin dhi dang /dbyin ji/de bzhin zhe byā li'i skad kyi tshig sogs 'dres lhad yod pa ji yod kyi ming chig bcu las mi nyung ba re bris te sang nyin bsnam phebs ang de dag kyang so sos bsam blo btang ste gang shes pa de dag 'bri ba ma gtogs sla bcos byas te 'dzin grogs gzhan gyi nang las nas 'dra bshus byas te 'khyer yong na 'grigs kyi ma red/mkhyen song ngam ’’zhes gsungs te de nyin tshogs zun grol/

36 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i zla dkyil tsam la lo 'khor rgyugs spu+od chen mo gtong grabs yod pa 'i skabs su slob phrug phal che bas zhogs pa snga po chu tshod gsum pa bzhi pa tsam la langs te slob grwa'i bar 'khyams dang / nyal khang gi zur g.yas g.yon/gzhan yang slob grwa'i nye 'gram rgya lam zur gyi glog gi ka ba yod tshad kyi 'os/ tu lage pa ra deb bzung ste rang sbyong byed srol yod pa dang / stabs nyes pa zhig la skabs der bod gzhung slob grwa phal che ba'i nang slob phrug tshos sdu ba sdu lan ngag thog tu bzung ste yig rgyugs sprod pa las slob tshan gyi nang don blo la nges pa dang /go rtogs 'char ba'i sgo nas lan 'debs byed mkhan phal cher tung nyung yin/ de 'dra byed pa'i slob sbyong gi lam srol des gang za thub tshad zas pa de skyug tshar ba'i rjes su grod khog stong par lus pa bzhin gang ngag la bzung ba de rnams yig tshad tshar te bdun phrag 'ga' shas kyi rjes su sdu ma tsam yang klad pa'i nang du lhag gi med kyang / skabs der skyon gyi cha der legs bcos byed mkhan su yang med/ de'i skabs su slob phrug rig rtsal rno ba 'ga' zhig gis gang blo 'dzin byas pa de dag gi don dag shes kyi med kyang mtshams sbyor gyi rtags dang / lung 'dren gyi rtags sogs kyang ji ma ji bzhin blo la bzung ste rgyugs sbrod kyi skabs su shog thog tu 'bebs thub kyi yod/blo bzang gis kyang slob phrug byings ltar nyin lhar zhogs pa chu tshod bzhi par langs te sdu ba'i lan khag blo 'dzin dang ngag skyor byed kyi yod/ kho pa rgyun ldan khang tshan gsum pa'i bar 'khyams su yod pa'i glog 'od kyi 'og tu rang sbyong byed kyi yod

go brda ma 'a11da pa'i 'gram lcag 37kyang de nyin slob grwa'i rgyal sgo'i 'gram gyi glog gi ka ba yod sa de'i 'og tu sbyi tshogs rig gnas slob tshan gyi dri lan khag blo 'dzin byed bzhin bsnad/ gang 'tsham zhig nas 'gyur med blo bzang gi sar yong ste/ ‘ blo bzang / khyed rang ga re sbyong gi yod ’’ces dris par blo bzang gis ‘6ngas sbyi tshogs rig gnas sbyong gi yod/khyed rang ’’zhes phar dri ba bkod pa'i lan du 'gyur med kyis ‘‘ngas dbyin ji sbyong gi yod/ yin na'ang dbyin ji shes rgyu de dbe mi srid pa'i khag po 'dug dper na/si yu ṭi/la kaṭa lab dgos pa gang zhig la/pi yu ṭi/la paṭa ma lab par puṭa lab dgos pa dang / el i e ḍi/ la bya ba'i skabs su līḍa dang ming gi skabs su leḍa lab dgos pa sogs dbe mi srid pa'i mgo rnyog po 'dug da lan nga phal cher bīl 1 lus sa red ’ ces smras/ blo bzang gis de'i lan du ‘6khyed rang t+pāl da lus mdog kha po ma red/ khyed rang bīl lus na da/ mtsho mo dang / rdo je /zub bstan/ dbang mo sogs tshang ma bīl lus kyi red ’ ces baji+od pa'i lan du 'gyur med kyis 'khyug tsam mno bsam zhig btang rjes/ ‘‘mtsho mo da sīl lus kyi ma red/ sar mug thān gyis mo phyel lus kyang bīl gtong gi ma red ’ ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis rang nyid kyis sbyong bdar byed bzhin pa'i 'bri deb kha brgyab snye mchan khyang gi 'og tu bcug ste 'gyur med phyogs la mig gis lta bzhin du ‘‘de 'dra zer rgyu yod pa ma red/ sar mu thān gyis mtsho mo la yag po byas pa tsam gyis yig tshad la'ang nye dga' phyogs lhungs kyis drang po byed kyi ma red bsam pa'i dogs pa rtsa ba nas byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ rang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la 13ba'i1 / rgyugs ma 'asdo+od pa/

38 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/de 'dra'i dogs pa byas na las ngan pa gesog gi red/de las so sos yag po sbyang na de yag gi red ’’ces phyus/ 'gyur med kyis de'i lan du/ ‘8khyed rang gis ha go gi ma red/ sar mug thān gyis mtsho mo dang /nor 'dzin gnyis rtag par gza' spen pa genyis par gung gseng zhus te nad+ku la 'khrid 'gro gi mi 'dug gam/ der ma zad gung gseng nam yin la pad shag dang rngan pa sbrod kyi 'dug ’ ces baji+od/ der blo bzang gis ‘6gtam gyi da'e la phra zhib brtag par ma byas na/du ba rlangs par nor nyen yod zer ba bzhin/ dge rgan tshos slob phrug 'ga' shas la dmigs su bkar te yag po byed pa 'di dag byams pa dang / snying rjes kun nas bslangs te pha ma dang spun mched nye 'khris la med mkhan tshor rogs ram dang / gzigs skyong gnang sga yod pa zhig la brtsi dgos pa ma gtogs de'i rgyab tu dmigs yul gzhan zhig med 'gro bsam pa'i dogs pa rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med/ khyed rang de 'dra'i dogs pa byed dgos byung na byas nas byas tshar gyi ma red/dper na/sar pra dhan gyis ye shes sgrol ma dang dkon mchog gnyis dgongs pa zhus te nang la 'khrid kyi yod red/ me ḍam can cal gyis nga dang / blo lngan / don grub bcas dgongs pa zhus te nang la 'khrid gyi yod red/ me ḍam pār wa ti yis sangs rgyas dang / dngos grub gnyis nang la 'khrid kyi yod red/ de bzhin rgan ngag byams lags kyis sgrol ma dang / bu khrid/ skyid 'dzoms bcas dgongs pa zhu gi yod red/ byas na ri 'di tsho tshang ma ma rabs red zer rgyu yin nam/ nga la ni me ḍam can cal gyis rang gi phru gu'i 'du shes bzung ste byams skyong gnang gi 'dug ma gtogs kun slong mi 'gab pa zhig rtsa ba nas mngon gyi med la/ nga rang gis kyang rang gi dge rgan yang yin la a

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 39ma yang yin snyam pa'i gus brtsi dang che mthong zhu gi yod ’rices smus pa'i lan du 'gyur med kyis zur za dang bcas te ‘‘a las/ ngas bshad pa des khyed rang la'ang phog pa 'dra/ dgongs dag 'tshig pa ma za rogs zhes lab/ blo bzang gis 66nga de la 'tshig pa za gi mi 'dug rang nyid la nag gnongs med na 'tshig pa za dgos pa dang phog dgos pa yod pa ma red/ ngas spyir btang gi genas tshul de 'dra red ces bshad pa yin/ da nga rang gnyis kas de las yis tshad sbyang na yag gi red/ mi la byus gtogs byas te sdod rgyu de dus tshod 'phro brlag red ’’ces baji+od de ngeb la lnga bzhin bsnad pas 'gyur med kyis kyad+ku sa thag rgyang tsam zhig tu phyin te dbyin ji blo 'dzin byed kyin bsdad/ chu tshod gcig dang phyed tsam song ba'i rjes su mi 'gyur blo bzang gi 'gram du yong nas 66blo bzang / zhal 'don ma 'tshogs sngon la dus tshod tog tsam 'dug rkang pol rtse ga 'gro gi min pas ’’zhes sdus par blo bzang gis hon 'thor ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te/ ‘6'o rdzi/yig tshad sgo 'gram du slebs grabs yod kyang / khyed rang la da dung rtsed yo rtses rgyu'i snang ba ma gtogs mi 'dug gam/ rgya mi lha sar slebs kyang / sgyid chu'i 'gram du ma cang rtses/ zhes pa ltar khyed rang la dngos gnas snga mo'i sde pa gzhung gi sku drag snu'i dpon nyams zhu dgos red lkugs rtags zhu dgos red/ yang na dal 'dod zhu dgos red/de 'dra'i gathis ka da lta'ang rang chas su 'dug gde 'dra rang da ha cang thal ches pa ma red dam ’’ zhes phar dris skabs mi 'gyur gyis de'i lan du 66ngas ga tshod sbyang yang shes kyi mi 'dug dber na/ tshigs rkang gnyis blo la bzung ba la nyi ma phyed ka 'gor grabs byas song / bla ma mchog dang dbyer med

40 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/pa'i/ sbyang dus/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la gus btud nas/ brjed 'gro gi 'duga'ajam dpal dbyangs la gus btud nas/ sbyang dus/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer ped pa'i/ brjed 'gro gi 'dug de 'du'i skabs su mi shes pa'i sems khral dang dngangs tshabs/ rang gis rang la yid ches brlag pa sogs sems pa skyid po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug de las ma sbyang par snang ba gang zhar byas te bsnad na khe bzang red 'dug sīl lus na 'dzin grwa rang 'jags sdod dgos pa ma gtogs slob grwa nas phyir 'bud ni byed kyi ma red/ lo gnyis gsum zhig gi rjes la dmag mir 'gro dgos bsam gyi 'dug da so so'i rig pa rkub nang 'dzul tshar dus byed yag zhe drags mi 'dug de las mi pho rnang snang ba gang shar dang / rkyang pho rnang rwa kha gang bzang /byas na de yag sa red/ma red pas ’ zhes brjod pa dang blo bzang gad mo shor bzhin du de'i lan du 6‘bsam blo phyogs gcig nas btang na/ khyed rang gis lab pa ltar/ gsher dang bral ba'i sa bon la sbru gu skye ba'i re ba bral ba lha bu zhig yod srid kyang / myu gu rlan gsher dang 'phrad pa bzo mi bzo de nga rang tsho'i lag tu yod pa red/ dper na/ mdang dgong rang nga rang tsho'i slob grwa'i sbyar byang gi steng du chos dge rin po ches rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha'i gsung / goms na sla par mi 'gyur ba'i/dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ zhes bris mi 'dug gam/sbyang nas mi shes pa'i shes bya zhig phal cher yod pa ma red/ rig pa rno zhan gyi dbang gis shes sla los dang dus tshod 'gor yun ring los nges par du yod kyang sbyang nas rtsa ba nas mi shes pa zhig yod mdog kha po ma red/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams mgon 'grub pa la lo bcu gnyis 'gor gyi yod na/ khyed rang

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 41gis chigs rkang gnyis blo 'dzin byed pa la nyi ma phyed ka 'gor ba la hang sangs rgyu yod pa ma red/ thigs pa bsags pa 'i rgya mtsho zhes pa ltar rgan rabs snu'i ngag rgyun du'ang / rang la dgos pa'i yon tan de/ /nyi ma re la tshig re bzung / /gang zhig nyin brgya song ba na/ /tshig brgya ma lus khong du chud/ /ces pa ltar rang nyid kyi rig pas 'arngon tshod dpag tshod kyis sems shugs dang bcas brtson 'grus ma lhod par sbyang na/ de'i tshod kyis gang 'tsham zhig shes rgyu yin pa gdon mi za ba red/ byas tsang sems shugs ma chag par sbyongs ’zhes baji+od de yud tsam zhig gang yang ma smras par mi 'gyur gyi mig la thad kar bltas te gad mo shor ba dang lhan du slar yang mu mthud de ‘6kha dang 'doms la spu skyes tshar nas da dung yang phru gu'i snang ba byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir bod gzhung dang mi mang la dmag mi las kyang shes yon ldan pa'i mi sna'i dgos mkho che ba yod red ces rgan lhun grub lags kyis rtag par bka' slob gnang gi mi 'dug gam/ sa skya legs bshad kyi nang du yang / mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug /bde ba 'dod la mkhas mi srid/ /bde ba chung la chags pa der/ /chen po'i bde ba thob mi srid/ces gsungs pa'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di dag rtag tu sems la nyar nas rjes yong sngon dran gyi bsam blo dang bcas slob sbyong byed dgos pa ma gtogs dal 'dod nyi ma gang 'khyol byas na mi tshe 'phro brlag red/ yin na yang mtha' ma'i thag gcod gang byed de khyed rang la rag lus pa red/ ngas ni grogs po yin pa'i 'du shes kyis bshad pa yin/ rdo rje dril bu bla ma'i phyag tu phyal/ dkrog dang ma dkre ga bla mas thugs bsam bzhes/ ma red pas ’mi zhes mi 'gyur la gtam

42 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/bshad ring po zhig byas zin pa dang lhan du zhogs pa'i zhal 'don gyi tshogs brda btang bas khong gnyis kyang slob phrug dmangs dang mnyam du slob grwa'i tshoms chen gyi nang du 'dzul/mi 'gyur ni/ 'dzin grwa drug pa kha pa'i nang du yod pas blo bzang las 'dzin grwa sacig ṅgas mtho ba yin/ kho pa 'dzin grwa'i nang nas lo rgan pa 'i gras su yod pa ma zad gzugs kyang ring shos de yin/ 'on kyang rig stobs ha cang zhan pa'i dbang gis slob sbyong skyo ba'i gras su yod pa ma zad slob sbyong la don gnyer dang 'dun pa yang mi byed mkhan/ rgyun du rkang pol rtses rgyur ha cang dga' po yod mkhan zhig yin / rkang pol rtses rgyur yang slob grogs gzhan 'ga' zhig nang bzhigi gyi rkang rtsal dang / dbugs thag bang rtsal sogs med kyang gzugs po ring ngo/ yod pa des rkang pol gyi sgo srung ba byed skabs phan thogs phran bu yod pa la brten nas gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos thig yod snyam pa'i rkang pol rtses skabs kho par spobs pa dang nga rgyal zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis yong gi yod/ kho pa gzugs ring po yod pa dang lhan du nam rgyun skad cha shod skabs mgo bo dpung pa g.yas ngos su 'khyog tsam byas te shod mkhan zhig yin stabs slob phrug tshos kho pa'i ming 'dogs la e yar in ḍi ya 14 zhes btags yod/ de ltar 'dogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ e yar in ḍi ya'i khyab bsgrags kyi ri mo zhig la/ rgya gar ba mgo la la thod bcings pa/ gus bsu'i tshul du lag pa gnyis kyis phebs bsu zhu ba'i 14 me1nga1mispu1mi

go brda ma 'phrod pa'i 'gram lcag 43lag brda byed pa dang mnyam du mgo bo g.yas su 'khyog tsam byed pa 'ig yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin/mi 'gyur la dmigs bsal khyad chos thig yod pa ni/ dus rtas tu ngo gdong 'dzum dmul te gnas pa dang / bstan bzhig tsha bo yod pa gang zhig la sems khral rtsa ba nas med pa lta bur sngod mkhan zhig yin/ gung gseng nam yin la yang na rkang pol rtses pa dang yang na gling bu dang sgra snyan btang ste snod pa dang / yang na rgya gar glog brnyan gyi gzhas btang nas dus tshod skyel mkhan zhig yin/ slob phrug byings tshang mas kho pa snang ba sgyid mdog kha po zhe drags mthong gi yod/ 'on kyang de nyin zhogs pa zhal 'don gyi skabs su slob phrug gzhan dag tshang mas kha 'don bskyor te bsnad kyang mi 'gyur gyis kha 'don tshig gcig kyarnga ma bskyor bar blo bzang gis gang bshad pa rnams la bskyar du bsam gzhigs nan tan zhig byed kyin bsngad/ kho pa'i bsatshangapar nga kho las 'dzin grwa mtho ba yin pa ma zad lo yang rgan pa yin pas/lugs mazun byas na ngas kho la phar bslab bya rgyag dgos pa'i 'os 'bab po4ོda kyang / de ring khos nga la tshur bslab bya brgyab dgos byung ba'i rkyen rtsa de ngas nga rang la 'gyur ba ma btang ba'i nyer len red 'dug da nas bzung ngas blo bzang gis bshad pa ltar snying la rus pa bcug ste slob sbyong la hur brtson byas na ma gtogs 'grigs sa ma red/ rang nyid kyis nus pa dang dus tshod ji yod slob sbyong la btang ba'i rjes su da dung grub 'bras ma byung na/ da gzod 'gyod pa med pa red/ nyi ma de ring nas bzung ngas slob sbyong hur thag byed kyi yin snyam pa'i dam bca' zhig byas

44 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/pa dang lhan du blo bzang gis de ring nga'i mig phyes song snyam pa zhig kyang byung /ka spug bod gzhung slob grwa'i slob spyis dge rgan las byed tshos phru gu pha ma med pa dang / nyam thag tshor dmigs bsal lta skyong rogs ram byed dgos pa 'i skul ma byas pa'am/ yang na dge rgan las byed rang ngos nas byams sting la dgongs te ma skul dang blangs kyis gnang ba ji ltar yang dge rgan dang las byed pa tshos phru gu gung gseng du 'gro sa med mkhan dang / pha ma nye 'brel sogs med pa'i dwa phrugagazhan yang pha ma nye 'brel yod kyang lta rtog dang 'brel ba med pa'i slob phrug 'ga' zhig gung gseng skabs su dgongs pa zhus te rang rang gi khyim du 'khrid srol zhig yod pa de ni ka sbrug bod gzhung slob grwa'i dmigs bsal khyad chos zhig yin/ dge rgan 'ga' shas kyis rang rang gi 'dzin grwa'i nang nas slob phrug slob sbyong yag gras bdams te 'khrid pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis slob rgyag tsho gza' 'khor re la brje len byas te 'khrid kyi yod/ 'di 'dra'i skabs su gung gseng du 'khrid pa'i slob phrug tsho la dmigs bsal gyi sems la bde ba 'phar ma zhig dang ngal gso'i rnam pa zhig thob kyi yod pa ma zad 'ga' zhig gis dge rgan 'di dang 'dis da ring nga gung gseng du 'khrid song zhes slob grogs gzhan pa tshor ngom so dang / sbobs pa yang byed kyi yod/ phran bu ya mtshan pa zhig la dge rgan skyes pa tshos slob phrug bu mo gung gseng zhu ba daru / dge rgan bud med tshos slob phrug bu phal che ba 'khrid kyi yod pa 'dis slob phrug byings kyi ngos la phran bu mi mdzes pa zhig yong gi yod kyang / de ni phal cher dge chos lags kyis gsungs pa bzhin

go brda ma 'phyod pa'i 'gram lcag 4) skyes pa'i ngos la bud med dang / bud med kyi ngos la skyes pa mdzis shos su snang gi yod pa'i bcos su med pa 'i 'jig rten gyi rang gzhis sam/ ngar lcags kyi 'then shugs de'i rkyen gyis min ri ma snyam/ sbyir tsha grang gnyis lhan gcig tu mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba yin yang / gcig sdo+os gcig la brten dgos pa dang / thabs shes gnyis zung du ma 'brel na thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob mi zub pa sogs rten 'brel gyi chos nyid kyang los yīn/ gang ltar slob grwa'i khor yug dang / sgrig lam gang gi rkyen las byuru min baji+od dka' yang gtan 'jags slob grwa gzhan dang mi 'dra bar ka sbug slob grwar tha ma 'then mkhan dang slob grwa nas dgoras pa ma zhus par gsang bros byas te 'gro mkhan gyi lo rgyus ha lam med pa lta bu yin/sbyi sems che la rgyal zhen lhag bsam dang //legs nyes 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod mig ldan la//'bras bu'i bcud kyis bzung ba'i dpag bsam thing //slob grwa'i khor yug nang du re re tsam//gzhas dang zhabs bro glu dang zlos gar rkang pol dra pol bsil pol sogs//glog brnyan lta dang sgrang la nyan te rtsed dgar rol ba'i ngang tshul dang //rgyugs sbrod skabs rū ne+e tso bzhin du blo la bzung nas blo brid pa//na so gzhon pa'i kun rtog de dag da lta dran dus 'gyod pa'i yul//

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ da༅༅/ /nyin gcig mi 'gyur khyus khang du gzugs po 'ikhyu bar 'gro ba'i la ma du shog dzar zhig mthong bas yar sgrag dgos snyam pa'i kun slong gang yang med kyang sgog bu de'i steng du bod yig brizlo yod pa'i rkyen gyis yar sgrag ste rtsig gseb tu 'aspre+og dgos bsams te lag pas bsgrags pa dang mnyam sdu de'i steng du bris pa de klog bzhin khrus khang du bskyod/ shog༄ bu de ni thig mang yod pa'i slob phrug tsho'i 'gri deb kyi shog bu zhig yin pa dang / de'i steng du dbu can yinagazugs de tsam legs po med pa zhig brgyud de baji+od bya 'di ltar bris yod/ ‘‘khyed rang gis kha sang dgong mo nga gnyis byed kyin bsngad skusnad pa mthong bas nga gnyis kyi bsam par khyed rang gis lam seng chos dge dgra 'dul lags su zhus yod kyi red bsam byung / 'on kyang da lta zhus yod sa ma red/ rtsa ba nas ma zhu rogs rganang / thugs rjes gzigs/ nga rang da slob grwa nos 'gro dgos byung yang sems khri'akhami 'duga'on kyang mo la 'ahā+o/ོsa'i pha ma gnyen tshan su yang posnad pa ma red/mo'i mi tshe gcig gi mdun lam la bsam blo btang nas gnas tshul de su la yang ma lab par

48 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/gsang bar 'a ngog rogs gnang / khyed kyi bkrin de nga gnyis kyis mi tshe'i nang brjed mi yong / de don bsam blo gtong rogs thugs rjes gzigs/’’zhes pa zhig bris yod pas/ mi 'gyur gyis bskyar du sa cha khug kyog cig tu phyigi te klog skyor yang skyor byas pas gnas tshul hang sang dgos pa dang ༈ rdzab chen po zhig tu mthong ste lam seng khrus khang du ma phyin par chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyi las shag ga la ba der phyin te/ yi ge de chos dge dgra 'dul lags su 'bul bzhin du ‘6rgan lags/ nga khrus khang du 'gro ba'i lam du yi ge 'di rnyed byung / 'di'i nang don gal chen po 'dug pas rgan lags su 'bul bar bcar ba yin ’zhes zhus/chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis yi ge de klog tshar ba dang 'al ras dmar por gyur te/‘‘'di khyed rang la ga ba nas rnyed byung /sus bris pa red/'bri sa de su red ’ces mi 'gyur la sdu ba byas/mi 'gyur phran bu zhed snang gi rnam 'gyur dang bcas/ 66rgan lags/ nga gzugs po 'khyu bar 'gro dus lam nas rnyed byung / sus bris min dang /'bri sa su yin min ngas shes kyi med ’ces zhus/ chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis bskyar du yi ge der klog skyor zhis byas te sbyan gnyis khang pa'i gnam pang la gzigs bzhin rgyun ring tsam zhig bsam blo btang rjes/ 66'o/ da khyed rang phyin na 'grig ga 'on kyang nga tshos 'di 'bri mkhan de su yin min brtsad gcod ma byung bar du khyed rang gis gnas tshul 'di gsang ba dam po nyar dgos/ su gcig la yang bshad na 'grigs kyi ma red da/ shes song ngam ’’zhes sbyan rtsa dmar por gyur te phyag g.yas pas mdzub bad byed bzhin du mi 'gyur la nan baji+od gnang bas mi 'gyur gyis 66lags so/lags so/ri’zhu bzhin du las shag gi phyi la thon te khyus

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 49khang phyogs su shur bskyod byas/ gzugs po 'khru bzhin pa'i mod la mi 'gyur gyi bsam blor/'o rdzi/yi ge de'i baji+od byar bltas na slob grwa'i nang du bu gcig dang bu mo gcig gnyis mi gtsang ba spyod kyin bsnad pa slob phrug gzhan zhig gis mthong bas yi ge de mi gtsang spyod mkhan gyi bya des mthong mkhan de la bris pa 'dra/ 'on kyang mthong mkhan de'i ming yod sa'i shog bu'i mgo de dbral tshar nas mi 'dugamathong mkhan de grung po zhig byung ba 'dra bsam pa dang / gzhan yang kho pa'i bsam blor de ring ngas yi ge de dbral ma bzheg par chos dge la phul ba de nor ba min nam/gal te 'bri mkhan de brtsad chod na kho dang mnyam du bu mo de dang mthong mkhan gyi slob phrug de yang slob grwa nas phyir 'bud byed rgyu yin par gdon mi za/ gal te de ltar byung na ngas mi gsum gyi tshitshe'i mdun lam 'asdo+o brlag tu btang ba red/ da dpe bsags song snyam pa dang / yang bsam blo gzhan zhig la slob grwa'i nang du byed dasgos pa'i slob sbyong ma byas par stod ma longs gong nas smad longs pa 'di 'dra'i bya ba ma rabs byas na slob grwa'i sgrig lam dang 'gal ba red/ sgyig lam dang 'gal na nyes pa gang che gtong dgos red snyam pa yang byung /de zhub dgong dro chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis slob grwa sbyi pa'i bu dang bu mo'i rgan bdag brgyad yod pa yongs rdzogs 'dzin khang zhig gi nang du tshogs bskong gnang ste/ ‘6de ring glo byar thog rgyag tu rgan bdag khyed rang tsho bskong dgos pa 'di gnas tshul dza drag dang gal chen zhig la thug bsnad 'dug da nang zhogs pa nga la slob phrug gcig gis yi ge 'di rnyed byung zhes sbrad byung / yi ge 'di'i nang don ngas

) 0 mi tshe'i blo ba mngar skyur/'grel bshad byed mi dgos par khyed rang tshos re re bzhin klog na shes kyi red/byas tsang dang bo yi ge 'di klog dang zhes yi ge de rgan bdag gcig la sprad/rgan bdag tshang mas rim bzhin yi ge de bklags tshar ba dang / bu mo'i rgan bdag bzhi ni ngo tsha ste gdong bkug nas bsngad/ bu'i rgan bdag bzhi ni hang sangs hon thor ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyi zhal la bltas te da ga re gsung grabs yod dam snyam ste bsnad/gang mtsham zhig nas chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis yi ge der bskyar du gzigs tsam zhig gnang ste/rgya cog gi steng du 'jog bzhin du/ 66khyed rang rgan bdag tsho'i nang nas yi ge 'di sus bris pa shes kyi yod pas/ 'di su'i yig gzugs red ’ ces dris pas rgan bdag tshang mas ngas kyang ha go gi med/ khos kyang ha go gi med ces brjod/ de nas slar yang rgan lags kyis ‘6byas na khyed rang tsho la dogs gzhi yod pa de 'dra med pas ’mizhes dris par tshang mas med ces lan btab/ gang mtshams zhig nas rgan bdag skal ldan gyis ‘6rgan lags/ yi ge 'di su la rnyed pa red/ gcig byas na rnyed mkhan des ha go gi yod 'gro mi zhes baji+od pas chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis 6‘kho la yi ge rnyed pa tsam ma gtogs/ 'bri mkhan dang 'bri yul su yin shes kyi mi 'dug khos shes kyi yod na ngas khyed tsho bskong ste skad cha dri dgos don mi 'dug ga ’’zhes baji+od pa las rnyed mkhan su yin gyi ming 'don ma gnang / de rjes rgan bdag rig 'dzin gyis/ ‘‘rgan lags/ gcig byas na yi ge rnyed byung zer mkhan de ga rang yi ge 'bri yul de min 'grokhos rang nyid kyi zhwa mo phud thabs su rang nyid kyi ming yod sa nas dbral te rgan lags la phul ba yin srid kyi red ces

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 51dogs slong zhig byas pa der chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis 66khyed rang gis lab pa der bsam blo gtong rgyu med pa zhig ma red de/ 'od kyang kho la rnyed pa tsam ma gtogs/ 'bri yul de kho rtsa ba nas yin mdog mi 'dugablo dang ldan na ma smras kyang / rnam 'gyur nyid las bsam pa gobal pos señca ma zos kyang / kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/ sasungs pa ltar khos drang po shod kyin yod pa ngas kho pa'i rnam 'gyur nas shes byung / yin na yang gal po che la nan tan gyi tshul du ngas yang bskyar kho la sdu brtsad byed kyi yin/ de dang phyogs mtshungs khyed rang tsho tshang ma'i ngos nas slob grwa'i sgrig lam gyi 'gan 'khri pa bzhin yi ge 'di 'bri mkhan de brtsad gcod thub pa byed dgos/ mi tshe ri la bsnad nas ri dwags ngo ma shes pa yong gi ma red/ dus rgyun lngan nas spyod pa khrigs khrigs las med pa de tsho'i rigs la do snang yag po byos dang / tshad las brgal ba'i sbyod ngan byas pa la brten nas skyag nongs thig nges par du yosgo gi red/ byas tsang khyed rang tshang mas slob grwa'i bu dang bu mo tshang mar brtag dbyad nan tan byas te bu dang bu mo de gnyis su yin gang myur ha go ba byed shog ang rnya’zhes bka' gnang ste tshogs 'du grol/de'i sang nyin der chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis slob grwa'i bod yig dge rgan tshang ma zur du tshogs bskong zhus te yi ge de'i nang don 'grel bshad dang sbrags bod dge tshang mas yig gzugs de su'i yin min brtsad gcod byed dgos pa'i re skul zhus kyang bod dge tshang mas dus rgyun slob phrug tshang mas yi ge dbya med thog 'bri ba las dbu can 'bri mkhan su yang med pas yig gzugs brtsad chod pa

nyi 2 mi tshe'i bro ba mad+ku ra skyur/dka' ba'i gnas tshul baje+od/ lhag par du bod dge lhun grub kyi bsam par yi ge 'bri mkhan gyi slob rgyag de su yin kyang / gcig nas yi ge de dbu can gyi thog tu bris pa dang / gnyis nas nga dang mo gnyis ba ngod pa ma gtogs bu mo de'i miri 'don ma byas pa dang / gsum nas sding stobs kyang gang 'tsham che na po yod bzo 'dug pas dbe mi srid pa'i grung po zhig byung 'dugami 'di lta bya ma 'od+ku sa par bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du gsang ba'i las 'gul gyi gsang nyul ba phan thogs nges zhig yong bzo 'dug snyam pa las slob phrug des mi sbyod las 'das pa'i khrims 'gal gyi bya ba ngan pa zhig byas pa red bsam pa phal cher ma byung / 'on kyang chos dge dgra 'dul lags ni mi 'gyur gyis yi ge de phul ba nas bzung zugs sems sbro bo rtsa ba nas ma byung / lhag par du thabs shes ji ltar byas kyang yi ge 'bri mi dang 'bri yul brtsad ①ོ da pa dka' ba yod pa shes pas gnas tshul 'di bzhin slob spyi'i snyan la 'khyol na slob spyi dgongs pa 'khyugs pa dang / mi mang gis shes na slob grwar ming chad yong ba / slob phrug tshos ha go na slob grwa'i sgrig lam la gnod skyon yo nga gzhi sogs mang po 'dug snyam ste skabs re yid thang chad pa dang / skabs re skyo ba skye ba/yang skabs re dgod bro ba sogs gnang ste bzhugs/bdun phrag gcig song ba'i rjes su slar yang slob grwa'i rgan bdag tsho bka' 'gug gnang ste skad cha dris pas rgan bdag tshang mas brtsad gcod byed thub ma song la dogs gzhi yod pa de 'du yang mi 'dug ces mgrin gcig tu zhus/chos dge dgra 'dul lags thugs pham po byung ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig bton pa las zhal nas cang

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 53ma gsungs par bzhugs skabs/ rgan bdag skal lngan gyis ‘6rgan lags/gnas tshul 'di'i thad la nga rang sger gyi bsam 'a① ra zhig zhus na 'grigs kyi red dam ’rizhes bka' 'asdu zhus par chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis dang thog gi rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ba med pa'i sgo nas/‘6'o/shod dang /ga re sgo+od rgyu yo da ’rices gsungs/ rgan bdag skal lngan gyis ‘‘rgan lags/ dngos 'brel byas na rgya gar ba'i kha dpe nang bzhin/ kha chung chung / skad cha chen po bshad pa lta bur 'gro gi 'dug ste/ yin na yang nga'i bsam par nga tsho gnas tshul 'di'i thog la thugs khral zhe drags gnang dgos pa mthong gi mi 'dug gcig byas na ni yi ge 'di phru gu gcig gis lag pa sngod ma tshugs pa dang / sems tshogs ma bsags par don med du rkang btsugs nas brdab gsig slong ched du bris pa'ang yin srid kyi red la/ yang gal te gnas tshul 'di dngos 'brel yin pa'i dbang du btang yang nga tshos 'tshab 'tshub dang brel ba byed dgos don mi 'dug gang yin zer na kal te bu de dang bu mo des dngos 'brel 'dod pa spyad yod na bu mo der phal cher gzugs po 'khor rgyu yin pas de mtshams nas snga phyi med par tshang mas shes rtogs yong gi red/ de 'dra byung na de'i skabs dang de'i dus kyi gnas tshul red/ gzhan nga tshos nag khung 'a'isbar g.yugs brgyab nas phan thogs phal cher e yod bsam gyi 'dug mi ces bsgod par brten—chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyi dgongs par yang skal ldan gyis bsnyed pa'i skad cha de dngos gnas red la/lhag par du rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas kyang / gal te bcos su med na ni/ de la mi dga' byas ci phan/ gal te bcos su yod na ni / de la'ang mi dga' byar ci yod/ gsungs pa bzhin brtsad gcod gtong

54 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/dka' ba'i gnad don zhig gi thog la sems khral byas nas bsnad na rang gzhan tshang ma mi skyid pa bzo rgyu las phan thogs mi 'dug snyam ste/ ‘‘da lta skal lngan gyis bshad pa nang bzhin gcig byas na phru gu zhig gis lag pa snod ma tshugs par bris pa yin srid mdog kha po red/ yin na yang brtan cha byed dgos pas khyed rang tsho bu mo'i rgan bdag tshos bu mo rgan pa'i rigs la brtag dpyad nan tan byos/ de min phal cher gang yang byed yag mi 'dug da tshogs 'du grol ba yin ’’zhes gsungs te spyan sa la gzigs bzhin par yar bzhengs te las shag tu shar bskyod gnang /chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis gnad don de'i skor la gsang rgya dam po gnang khul yang gnas tshul de slob phrug snu'i dbus su me 'bar ba ltar khyab pas bdun phrag gnyis tsam gyi ring la slob phrug rgan pa gsum las mang ba zhig 'dzoms na yi ge de'i skor la gnas tshul gleng slong shugs kyis byed pa zhig byung / de'i skabs su slob phrug bu tshos bu mo phran bu grod khog che ba zhig mthong na wa ye khyed rang ngang lag 'thol pa za mkhan de yin sa red da zhes zur za dang 'phya smod byed srol yang yod/de ltar chu tshod kyis nyi ma dang /nyi mas zhagazhag gis bdun phragabadun phrag gis zla ba ded de phyin pas dge rgan dang las byed slob phrug tshang mas rang rang gi 'khur du 'khri ba'i bya sgo rnam gzhag la mgo 'khor te gong gsal yi ge de'i skor brjed pa lta bur gyur ba ma zad/ chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis yi ge de nyar tshags dam don byed khyal gyis rang nyid kyi lcags sgam gyi mthil du yig skogs dkar po zhig gi nang du blugs te nyar yang / lo gcig phyin pa'i rjes su nyin gcig

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ ze5sgam de kha sngog skabs thig la yi ge de mthong bas kho pa'i bsam par da pha la cher yi ge 'di slob phrug sems tshogs ma bsags pa zhig gis bris pa 'dra snyam ste dbral nas gad snyigs lcags snyin gyi nang du blugs/1 caji le'i zla ba bcu pa'i zla mjug tsam la rgya gar gyi dus dran di lnga lī rna zhes pa 'khel bas slob grwa yang nyin gsum gung gseng btang / gung gseng gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ slob grwa'i dge rgan dang las byed phal che ba rgya gar ba dang / ni pā li yin pas dge rgan med na 'dzin grwa yang tshogs thabs bral bas so/di sgru sī'i gung gseng nyin gsum dang stabs bsdun gyis bod dge tshos slob phrug tshang ma slob grwa nas rgyang thag gi lo mi ṭar gsum tsam yod pa'i spang ljongs sgyid po dang / rgya chen po/ gu yangs po yod sa zhig yod pa der sbro skyid la 'khrid rgyu'i go sgrig dang 'char gzhi byas kyang / stabs nyes pa zhig la sbro skyid la 'gro rgyu'i zhogs pa der char pa shugs cher bab pas sbro skyid la go sgrig byas pa'i dmigs bsal gyi kha lag de dag zos te slob grwa rang du snod rgyu las de min bya thabs ma byung /skabs der slob rgyag mang po zhig gi re bar sang nyin char pa chad na slob grwa'i phyi la 'gro rgyu thob yong snyam pa'i re sgug byas kyang re don ma grub/ char pa nyin gcig gnyis kyi rjes su chad rgyu lha bzhag nas nyin lnga'i ring nyin mtshan bstud mar babs/nyin drug pa'i zhogs pa der slob phrug tsho snga po langs te khyus rgyag par 'gro skabs 150148/1

56 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/su/ hang sangs pa dang hon thor ba zhig la slob grwa'i khang pa'i g.yas g.yon dang /rgyab ngos kyi sa gzhi tshasgo mar chu rud brgyab ste 'dam rnyog mtho tshad khru gang chags tsam yod pas slob phrug tsho gsang spyod dang khrus khang du 'gro rgyu'i lam 'gag pa dang /chu rka la yod tshad kyi chu chad de med pa/lhag par du g.yas g.yon ri 'dabs phal che bar sa rud dang yu rud brgyab ste ri ngos ngo ma shes pa lta bur gyur yod pa dang / tā+opa khu na'i nye 'gram gyi grong gseb kyi khang pa du ma zhig chu rud kyis 'khyer yod par ma zad mi mang po zhig la'ang srog skyon byung yod pa slob phrug tshos shes/stabs legs pa zhig la nyin lnga pa'i dgong mo der zhal 'don gyi skabs su chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis ‘‘char zhod che los dang / 'bab rgyun ring los 'di la balhas na yu rud kyi nyen kha chen po yod tsang / da ring nga tshos kha 'don dmigs bsal 'ga' shas skyor dgos 'dug da gin rlung 'phrin gyi nang nas kyang chu rud kyi nyen kha yod pa'i skor rgyang bsrings byas song / byas tsang nga tsho tshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos ’’zhes gsungs te 'byung skyob kyi gsol 'debs 'ga' shas skyor ba des bskyabs pa'am/ yang na tā+opa khu na bhil ḍing de rtsig rmang brtan po dang mkhregs po yod pas rkyen gyis byas pa gang ltar yang slob grwa'i phyi dngos por god chags phran bu byung ba las nang sems can gyi srog la skyon chag rtsa ba nas ma byung /yin na yang skabs der ka spug gi sa khul mang por chu rud kyis rkyen pas mi brgya lhag tsam la srog skyon dang /zhing kha dang khang pa mang por gtor skyon byung ba/mo ṭa'i bgrod lam 'gag par ma zad ṭi si ṭa'i gtsang chu rgyas pa la brten nas ṭi si ṭa'i

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 57zam pa gcig rang yod pa de yang chus 'khyer te ming gi lhag ma tsam/ du byas/ṭi si ṭa'i chu zam de ni/ ka sbug khul du gnas pa 'i mi rnams kyi srog rtsa lta bu yin/gang gis she na/ sgang tog dang / d+dhar ji gling / zhi li gu ri bcas sa phyogs gang du 'gro dgos kyang ṭi si ṭa'i zam pa de ma brgyud par 'gro sa med/ lhag par du ka sbyag khyal gyi bza' bca'i rigs tshang ma zhi li gu ri nas 'or 'dren byed kyi yod pas da cha zam pa chad pas nyin gsum bzhi'i nang du ka spug khul la bza' bca' ches dkon po chags pa ma zad phran bu yod pa rnams kyi rin gle+ong nyis lngab dang gsum lngab tu 'phar/5ra jid dmag sgar yod sar mnga' sde gzhung gis rogs skyor lta bur gnagathog nas 'gru rigs gan ma g.yugs byed 'go tshugs kyang / de das dmag mi dang gzhan yang sa gnas dpon rigs khag la ma gtogs mi mang dkyus mar thob pa'i re ba med/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis ṭi si ṭa'i zam pa gsar bzo byed 'go tshugs kyang dus yun zla ba drug lhag 'gor/ ka sbug slob grwar bdun gnyis kyi ring la 'dzin grwa tshugs ma thub/ gcig nas bgrod lam 'gag par brten dge rgan mang po zhig slob grwar yong ma zub pa dang / gnyis nas slob grwa'i g.yas g.yon du chu rud kyis rkyen pas sa rdo dang / bye ma yod tshad gtsang ma bzo dgos pa'i rkyen gyis yin/ ka sbrug khul du chu rud byung ba'i gnas tshul rgya gar rgyal yongs rlung 'phrin khang

58 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/brgyud rgyang bsrings byas par brten thag ring du gnas pa'i slob phrug tsho'i pha ma nye 'brel mang po zhig la sems 'tshab dang dngangs skrag byung / skabs de dus deng sang nang bzhin kha par gyi mthun rkyen med stabs phru gu dang pha ma nye 'brel tshang ma'i dbar la yig zam brgyud de gnas tshul gsal rtogs bzo ba las thabs shes gzhan med/ sbrags brgyud kyi yi ge ni skabs re dha sa nas ka sbyag bar zla ba gcig lhag 'gor gyi yod/ des na pha ma sems khrel che ba 'ga' zhig gis rad+ku rang gi phru gu bde thang yin min shes ched du tar 'brin gtong mkhan yang du ma byung / yang pha ma nye 'brel du ma zhig gis mo lung gsung brtag zhus te rang rang gi bu phru ga la skyon ① med tshul babs pas blo bde po gnang ste bzhugs mkhan yang byung yod/gang ltar chu rud byung nas bdun phrag gsum gyi rjes su ka sbrug slob grwar skabs re tsam nyin gung kring mog dang lda li sbrod pa las/ de min zhogs pa yang gro thug mog gang /nyin gung yang gro zug mog gang /dgong dro yang gro zug mog gar sbrod pa las zla ba drug tsam gyi ring la zhing tog dang /sgo nga /sha sogs kyi rdzi tsam yang bsnam rgyu ma thob/ gro thug de yang gro chag rnying pa song tsang 'bu brgyab yod pas mog gi nang du blugs skabs steng du 'bu nag chag ger mthong rgyu yod/slob phrug phal che ba grod khog ltogs te thug pa'i steng gi 'bu sel long med par lam seng 'azung ba dang /gal te gtam 'dod che ba re zung gis steng gi 'bu rnams thur mas sel tshar te sgang nas bltas na mog gi mthil skya ther rer mthong thub pa'i thug pa zhig yod/skabs der bu mo 'ga' zhig gis rang gi mdun gyi zug pa de me long gi tshab byas te skro shed pa sogs kyang byed myong yod la/ der ma zad skabs der slob phrug dran rgyu

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 59rgod pa 'ga' zhig gis skabs de'i gnas stangs kyi skor la gzhas chig snyan po dper na/ sku ngo zla ba lha red/ lha yi thug pa chu red/ rgya nag shel sgo mi dgos/zug par balhas na chog ga steng du 'bu yi sprin 'khrigs/ bar la nya med mtsho mo/btung nas 'grangs rgyu med 'di/ zug pa red dam ja red/ ces brtsams yod pa 'di gdangs snyan po zhig dang sbrags slob rgyag tshos gtong gi yod/ka sbrug tu chu log thon te bdun phrag gsum tsam song rjes kyi gza' nyi ma zhig la blo bzang gis zhogs ja 'thung tshar ba'i rjes su rang sbyong zhig byed dgos bsams te rang nyid kyi 'dzin khang yod sa der 'gro skabs 'dzin khang nye 'gram gyi bar 'khyams nyi ma yod sa zhig tu slob phrug bu rgan pa drug nyi ma sro zhing skad cha bshad de bsnad yod pa mthong bas khong tsho dang mnyam du gnas skabs 'khyug tsam nyi ma sros na yag gi red bsams te khong tsho'i sar phyin te bsnad pa dang blo ldan gyis ‘‘yag blo bzang / sngod dang / snod dang / da nyi ma 'dra sros na yag gi red/gzhan zug pa chu nang bzhin de 'thung nas slob sbyong byed dgos byung na khag po 'dugade las dus tshod 'di mgyogs po 'gro rogs byas na/ dgun kha'i gung gseng skabs su nang la slebs ma thag kha labatargyag tshad za dgos bsam gyi 'dug ’’ces brjod/ de la dpal ldan gyis 6‘gtam gyi dpe la/ nga 'di 'dra bzo mkhan a ma dang / ri dkar por gtong mkhan kha ba yin/ zer ba ltar nga tsho kha lag skyo bo 'di 'dra bzas te sngod dgos pa bzo mkhan de sku ngo zla ba kho red/ khos dhar ji gling slob grwa la lta rtog byas pa nang bzhin nga tsho la byed kyi yod ma red/ ngas bltas

60 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/na slob grwa'i las khungs la 'bras dang gro zhib 'dang nges bzhin pa nyo rgyu'i pad shag kyang med pa 'dra/ snying rje/ da ring khe sa gnyer pa kho rang yang sha skam nas bsngad 'dug ’ ces bshad/ de nas 'byor ldan gyis 6‘sku ngo de chu log thon nas bzung nga tsho'i slob grwar thengs gcig kyang lta bskor du ma yong ba de ya mtshan red/slob grwa 'di'i 'gan kho rang la yod red/ nam rgyun zla ba re la thengs gnyis gsum de 'dra yong gi yod red/ da re slob grwar dka' ngal che ba'i skabs su mig mi dgos ltag pa yang mi lta ba 'di dngos 'brel dbe mi srid pa red ri’ces smras/de'i mtshams su nor lngan gyis rang nyid kyi mgo la spyon yod pa'i o mo su lu'i zhwa mo khra khra de phud bzhin du ‘‘da re dngos gnas sku ngo des nga tshor gzigs rtog yag po gnang ma song / da thengs gcig slebs na slob phrug tshang mas ngo rgol byed dgos red/ rgya gar dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab yin tsang slob phrug tshang ma kha bsgril nas ngo rgol byas na/ rgya gar gzhung gis slob spyi'i las 'gan ma 'grub par rtsis te go gnas nas phab kyi red/ gcig byas na nga tshor slob sbyi gsar pa gtan 'jags thig gtong mdog kha po red ’’ces bshad/de'i rgyab gnyer du skal lngan gyis ‘‘a'o/ slob phrug tshang ma rdog rtsa gcig bsgril yong mdog kha po ma red/ gal te slob phrug tshang mas mi gcig sems gcig lta bu'i rdog sgril te kha 'cham na/ ngo rgol gyi 'go khrid ngas byas chog chu log thon pa nas bzung ste ngas slob phrug tshor sgrung ga tshod bzhad kyang sgo nga gcig kyang rag rgyu mi 'dug nga la sgo nga bza' rgyu med pa de yang sku ngo des bzos song ’mi zhes smras ma thag tshig mjug ma bsgril sngon la de'i lan du skyid lngan gyis ‘6da byas na khyed rang sgo nga'i rgyal po ma
