62 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/der mos mazun gtsang ma yod/ nga tsho gro thug rkyang 'azung nas sdod dgos pa 'di chu rud kyis bzos pa ma gtogs sku ngo lags kyis bzos pa ma red/ byas tsang ngo rgol rgyab rgyu'i bsam blo tsam yang gtong rgyu yod pa ma red/ 'di 'dra dge rgan tshos mkhyen na dpe bsags kyi red/ bod nang du rgya mis bod kyi chab srid btson pa tshor gro zug chu nang bzhin 'di 'dra yang sbrod kyi yod pa ma red/ nga tshos dngos gnas byas na ru+o rgol de rgya mi la byed dgos pa red/ nga tsho gnas stangs 'di 'dra bzo mkhan lte ba de rgya mi gung khran red ma gtogs sku ngo zla ba lags ma red/ de 'dra yin tsar 'dre shar sgor bzhag nas glud zhub sgor btang na ma 'grigs pa red/de las rang sbyong byas na yag gi red ces baji+od de 'dzin grwa'i nang du rang sbyong byed par phyin/zla ba gnyis kyi rjes su nyin gcig dgong dro srod rub tsam zhig la sku ngo zla ba lags mo ṭa sdipa gcig btang ste slob grwa'i rgyal sgo 'dzul ma thag tu slob phrug 'ga' zhig gis khang pa'i thog nas mo ṭar rdo gzhu ba dang / khang pa'i bar 'khyams kyi lcags dra'i nye 'khris su yod pa'i me tog 'debs sa'i dzo ma g.yugs pa sogs byas par sku ngo zla ba lags kyi dgongs par slob phrug tshang mas ngo rgol byas pa 'dra dgongs te skad cig de ga rang du mo ṭa kha bskor te ka sbug grong khyer du phebs te rang nyid kyi sger bdag khang pa zhig yod pa de'i nang du bzhugs/ po ṭa'i nang du slob phrug tsho'i ched du sha ki lo brgya lhag tsam zhig bsnams yod pa de sang zhogs der mi zhig brgyud de slob grwar bskyal ba tsam las nyi ma gsum gyi ring la

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig dhed pa/ 63slob grwar phebs ma gnang / nyi ma bzhi pa der zhogs pa lhan 'dzoms kyi thog tu phebs te bka' slob mdor bsdus thig gnang /sku ngo zla ba lags su rdo gzhu mkhan gyi slob phrug su yin dge rgan tshos ngo rtags ma chod pa'am/ yang na snang med du bzhag pa ji ltar yang / khong tshor nyes chad ni gang yang ma byung / bsam yul las 'das pa'i glo bur gyi byung rkyen des dge rgan las byed dang / slob rgyag bsam yod mang po zhig la bsam med byis pa 'ga' zhig gis bsam pa tshogs ma gsag pa dang / lag pa snod tshugs med par mi ngan rjes 'brangs kyis sbyod ngan byas par brten blo pham tshad las 'das pa zhig byung / skabs der chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis zhogs pa zhal 'don gyi skabs zhig la ‘ 7gong sa mchog gis khyed tshor ma 'ongs bod kyi son rtsa zhes dus rtag tu zugs re chen po gnang gi yod kyang /khyed tshos byed stangs la boltas na mo 'ongs bod gsar pa'i 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu lta bzhag ste/ bad kha gtar du gtang mkhan gyi guju khran las sdug pa de 'dra mi chags pa'i nges pa gang yang mi 'dug rang re'i pha mes nas brgyud pa'i goms gathis bzang po rang las rgan pa la gus 'dud dang bkur sti/ rang mnyam la grogs 'dri4kyi brtse ba/ rang las dman pa la byams skyong dang snying rje'i sgo nas lta rgyu phar bzhag ste/ dbyin ji dang hin dī thar thor re shes pa tsam gyis gnam ma gtogs sa mi mthong ba'i spobs pa dang nga rgyal gyis bzi ba/ de bzhin rgya gar mang gcu'i rgyal khab nang gi bslab bya bzang po'i rigs de tsho ma mthong bar ngan pa 'i rigs thams cad shes te/ yar thon can yin mdog gis slob grwar brdab gsig gtong ba dang /las byed la ngo rgol byed pa/gos thung phra bo gyon pa/gdong la dkar

64 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/dmar khra gsum byugs pa/ sred 'phel gyi glog brnyan lta ba/ slob grwa'i sgrig lam bzhig pa sogs byed pa 'di tsho yag rtags gang yang ma red ’ ces thugs pham tshad las 'das pa byuru ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas gsungs gnang /de nas lo 'khor rgyugs sbrod btang rjes slob phrug phal che ba rang rang so so'i pa ma spun nye'i sar zla ba gnyis kyi gung gseng du bskyod 'go tshugs/ de byings slob phrug lhag ma nyis brgya ma zin tsam zhig slob grwar rang 'jags bsnad/ gung gseng zla ba gnyis kyi ring la slob grwar sngod mkhan gyi slob phrug tshor gza' nyi ma dang spen pa gnyis phud pa'i nyin ltar zhogs pa chu tshod gnyis kyi ring 'dzin grwa tshugs dgos pa las de min gung gseng yin/ slob phrug phal che bas dus tshod de rtsed mo rtses te skyel gyi yod/ 'on kyang brtson 'grus dang dozha gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis yig gzugs sbyong ba dang / zhal 'don blo 'acin byed pa sogs byas te dus tshod skyel gyi yod/ skabs der 'bri deb dkon po yod pa'i rkyen gyis slob phrug phal mo che zhig gis thog mar zhwa snyug gis bris te 'bri deb cha tshang khengs pa'i rjes su 'gyig bsub kyis bsub ste slar yang zhwa snug gis thengs gcig 'bri ba dang / de nas snag stug gis 'bri ba bcas mdor na 'bri deb gcig la bed spyod thengs gsum gtong gi yod pas da lta mno bsam zhib mo gtong skabs de'i skabs su skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar gdams pa bzhin zas nor la spyod shes pa dngos 'brel byas 'dug snam pa'ang dran/

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 65bod gzhung gtan 'jags slob grwa yongs su dgun kha zla ba gnyis kyi gung gseng gtong rgyu 'go btsugs na/ nyin lnga drug gi ring la las byed dang / slob phrug tshang ma brel ba che shos kyi dus tshod cig yin/ des rkyen pas slob grwa yongs la brel zing langs pa lta bu zhig yong gi yod/ rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs der phyogs mtha' khag nas slob phrug gung gseng zhu mi du ma zhig slob grwar yong gi yod pas/ dge rgan dang las byed phal che ba'i nang du rang rang gi ngo shes dang / dga' nye blo dkar/ gzhan yang pha yul gcig pa sogs mang dag cig yong gi yod pas khong tshor sne len byed dgos pa dang / slob phrug tsho ni/ 'ga' shas rang gi nang du 'gro rgyu yod pas der rngam ste snod pa dang / 'ga' zhig la gung gseng zhu mkhan med kyang / nye 'brel dang ngo shes tshos gung gseng zhu mi'i lag tu lag rtags rngan pa dang / dngul phran bu re bskur e yod snyam ste re sgug byas te gnas pa/ 'ga' zhig gis rang nyid gung gseng du 'gro sa med kyang / rang rang gi grogs po dang grogs mo gung gseng du 'gro mkhan tsho'i sgam dang / khur rtsa bdag gru brgyab rogs byas te brel bas 'khol ba'in snod pa/gzhan yang pha tshab dang ma tshab tsho ni/rang rang gi mgron po sne len byed pa'i steng du slob phrug gung gseng du 'gro mkhan tsho'i sgrig chas rtsis len rgyu dang / nyal khang gtsang ma nyar rgyu sogs kyi brel ba che sgang yin/ dge rgan tsho la ni/ rgyugs sbrod kyi lan shog zhu dag gtong rgyu dang / slob deb rtsis len rgyu/ yig rgyurgas grub 'bras kyi phyogs bsnoms bzo rgyu/ rang nyid gung gseng du 'gro rgyu'i 'char gzhi 'ding rgyu sogs brel zing chen po yod/

66 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/de'i skabs su slob grwa'i khor yug la do snang byas te bltas tshe ha lam dmag 'khrug chung chung zhig langs pa nang bzhin gyi gnas babs zhig mngon gyi yod/'dzin khang dang nyal khang gang du bltas kyang rgyun ldan gyi bkod pa sgrig po de las lngog ste/ 'dzin ② sa rnams thal zing bal zing dang / bya zhig byiñca tshang thor ba'i rnam pa zhig mngon pa dang / slob grwa'i phyi rol du deb dang / 'gyig shog thog snyigs bcas kyis lung pa khengs te yod pa/ mdor na/ rgya gar lho phyogs ke rā lā 6 mtsho 'gram gyi grong sde bkod legs pa zhig la glo bur thog rgyag tu char rlung shugs ches bcom pa lta bu'i gnas babs zhig yong gi yod/ de ltar yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gcig ni/slob phrug bsam med tshos spyi rdzas la bsam blo ma btang bar rang nyid kyi phor pa'i nang du rang nyid kyis mi gtsang ba btang ba bzhin/ rjes yong sngon dran dang /sbyi sems kyi bsam blo med par bag med byas pa'i rkyen yin/ de yang 'ga' zhig gis gung gseng ma 'gro sngon la/dge rgan las byed kyis ma mthong sar/'jin grwa'i mdun cog dang rkub bkyag dmigs su bkar te gcog pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis nyal khri'i pang leb per bsregs gtong ba/ 'ga' zhig gis rtsa gdan dang nyal kheb dbral ba/'ga' zhig gis nyal khang dang 'dzin khang gi gyang dang /rtsig ngos la so la dang sa smyug gis ri mo sna tshogs 'bri ba sogs byas te sbyi rdzas la bsam gzhigs rtsa ba nas med pa'i rkyen dang / gnyis nas slob—grwa'i 'dzin skyong ngos nas de ltar mi yong ba'irisngon 'gog gi mno bsam dang / 'char sazhi lngan pa'i go sgrig dang stangs 'dzin med pa'i rkyen yang yin srid/da /tshung3/8

mi 'gyur gyis yig chung zhig rnyed pa/ 67de 'dra'i brel zing gi skabs su slob phrug phal che bas rang rang gi nyal khang lce gung gseng du 'gro rgyu'i grabs byed par gyon chas bdag gru rgyag pa dang / 'ga' 'ig gis yu rka la'i 'og tu dug log 'khru ba/ 'ga' zhig gis rang rang gi sgam dang /lag phad/ dpung phad sogs 'khyer te slob grwa'i rgyal sgo'i 'gram du snum 'khor sgugs te sngod pa/ ya ru gal te gung gseng zhu mi tsho'i tsu gu yin na de dang de'i mnyam du mgron po'i tshul du slob grwa'i las byed pa'i las shag nang du bsngad de kha lag zhim po bza' ba sogs byed pa las slob grwa'i rtsed thang gi steng du rtsed mo rtse mkhan che sa nyung nyung yin/ 'on kyang gung gseng du 'gro sa rtsa ba nas med pa'i rigs la slob grwa'i rtsed thang dang thab tshang gnyis las gzhan pa'i re ba bcol sa med/sems kyi ri mo shogo bur 'bebs pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal sna mang yang //bsdus bajid gab saṭa rgyan gyis bcings pa'i snan pa'i ngag ces yangs graṭa pa//chig gi rkang pa sgrig tsam min par don gyi 'bras bu'i bcud ldan pa'i//nyams dang 'gyur bas yongs su gtams pa'i nyer bkod bcos sgrung re re tsam//rnam rtog rgod pa'i 'jig rten 'di na gya gyu'i ri mo rnam par bkra/'ga' res bsam tshad kha nas bton te nga rgyal go 'phang dgung la btegs//'ga' res mi smra'i bahūṃl zhugs 'dzin te snying gtam khog pa'i klong du nyar//gzhan gyi sems kyi tshor ba shes pa'i blo khog yangs pa re re tsam//

ka sbub/ slab ba/ ba/tar ba/༄༅༅/ /de nyin stobs 'byor gyis rang gi grogs po nyi ma dang dngos grub gnyis mon lho ḍi gzhis chags su gung gseng 'gro mkhan yin pa sa khong gnyis snum 'khor bar skyel rdzong byas te/ phran bu sems nang du mi phod pa'i tshor ba mi bde ba zhig dang sbrags slob grwa'i rtsed thang du phyin te/ slob phrug gzhan pa 'ga' zhig dang mnyam du rkang pol rtses te bsnad yod pa'i skabs this la/ 'byor ldan rgyugs yong nas ‘6kye stobs 'byor/ stobs 'byor kye/ khyed rang zan sgong pa lags kyis skad gtong gi 'dug mgyogs po shog dad+ku kye ’zhes skad shugs chen pos skad 'bod byas/ snyobs 'byor gyi bsam par/ yang pa lags des nga la las ka zhig skul rgyu yin pa thag chod bsams nas de'i lan du/ ‘‘ga re kye/ nga mi 'dug lobs dang /ma gzhi nas da ring zan sgong za 'dod mi 'dug ’’ ces lan btab/ 'byor lngan gyis slar yad+ku / ‘6khyod zan sgong za bar zhog lab pa ma red kye / pa lags kyi nang du bal yul nas gung gseng zhu mkhan zhig slebs 'dug des khyed rang gung gseng du khrid rtsis yin pa 'dra/ mgyogs po snye+og dang ’’zhes smras/ stobs 'byor

70 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/gyi bsam pa ra 'byor ldan gyis ku re byas pa red bsam pa las/ mi zhig gis kho pa brtsad gcod byed kyi yod red bsam pa snang ba'i yul du'ang ma byung bar brten da dung snang med byas te rkang pol mu mthud rtse gyin bsnad/ sang mtshams nas 'byor lngan 'u thug ste/ stobs 'byor gyi dpung pa nas bzung ste/ 6‘kye/ stobs 'bu+or/ ngas rtsed mo rtse gi med da/ dkon mchog gsum/ zag sgong pa lags kyis nga khyed rang skad gtong bar btang byung / gal te ma yong na/ ngas yong gi mi 'dug ces lab kyi yin da ’ zhes nan tan gyis bshad par brten stobs 'byor gyis/ ‘6kye/ dngos gnas lab kyi yod pas/ nga yid ches kyi mi 'dug da/ ma gzhi nas pa lags des nga la las ka skul yag yin gyi red/ nga la bal yul la gung gseng zhu mkhan su yang med ’’ ces smras te 'gro mi 'dod bzhin du 'byor lngan gyi mnyam du khaju tshan gnyis pa'i pa lags kyi las zhag phyogs su bskyod/khang tshan gnyis pa'i pha tshab don grub dang / ma tshab dbyangs sgyid lags su slob srug tshos zan sgong pa lags dang a ma lags zhes ming 'dogs btags dgos don ni/ khong gnyis kyis slob phrug dmigs bsal byams po byed dgos sa 'ga' zhig la skabs re zan sgong g.yos te sbrod kyi yod pas slob phrug tshos ming 'dogs de ltar btags pa yin/ skyid rong pa'i skad du zan sgong zhes pa'i sbag btsos 'di g.yo mkhas pa byung na zhim po yang yod la/ lhag par du rgan 'khogs so med pa'i gras la za ma bcud chen zhig kyang yin/ don grub dang dbyangs skyid gnyis kyis gza' nyi ma nam yin la skabs re mog mog dang / skabs re glo ba kha tsha dang grod

ka sbug slob grwa gtor ba/ 7spropa kha tsha/ skabs re kha zas dang bag leb bcas bzos te slob phru ga tshor tshong gi yod la/ bal yul nas gung gseng zhu mi su slebs kyang khong tsho'i nang du gnas tshang byed pa ma zad/ bal yul nas yin pa'i slob phrug phal che ba rang rang gi pha mas khong bza' tsho gnyis la mngags spo+od pa bzhin khong gnyis kyis dmigs bsal rnya skyong gnang gi yod/ phru gu'i pha ma tshos kyang khong gnyis la bal yul nas ja dam dang / tsha dmaka kam pā li/ ja bag chung / dkar yol la sogs pa'i lag rtags sna tshogs bskur gyi yod la/ khong gnyis nas kyang bal yul gyi slob phrug tshor rgyun du dmigs bsal gnang thub kyi med kyang / gung gseng du ma 'gro sngon la nyin gcig tshang mar mog mog gi sī ṭi ‘ston mo zhig gtong gi yod/skabs re zan sgong yang sprod kyi spo+od/de dang phyogs mtshungs a ma dbyangs sgyid lags kyis slob grwa gzhung nas slob phrug tsho'i ched du gnang pa'i khrus jos yi tsi dang / so khru/ so sman/ de bzhin gdong byugs ki rim 1ñca gyi rigs sger gsog byas te/ rang dang 'brel thag nye ba'i slob grug gung gseng du 'gro mkhan gyi nang mi tshor lag rtags kyi tshul du bskur gyi yod/gtam gyi dbe la/ sbre'u la ngom rgyu rkub/ zer ba ltar/ pha tshab ma tshab tshor skabs de dus skog za lko+og gsog byas te gzhan la byas yus shod pa'i rdzas su/ yang na khyus rdzas dang / yang na sgrig chas la sogs pa'irī spyon chas kyi rigs las med kyang / sbyi rdzas sger spyod byed skabs sus kyang shes kyi med pa'i dag snang zhig yong /7dzu7rngu8tsā

72 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/gi yod/ yin na yang / slob phrug tshos las byed pa sus gang byed kyi yod pa ha lam cha tshang shes kyi yod la/ de bzhin sbyi sems dang lhag bsam dar dkar yug gcig gi lam nas zhabs zhu byed mkhan gyi las byed pa'ang su dang su yin pa slob phrug tsho la shes tshor med pa rtsa ba nas min/stobs 'byor dang 'byor lngan gnyis zan sgong pa lags kyi las sh-ig sgo 'gram du slebs pa dang / pa lags kyis ‘‘yag stobs 'byor/ yar shog dang / khyed rang gi ji ci dzi bsod nams dbang mo skyid rong nas bros byol du yong ste/ deng sang bal yul du gzhis chags te bsnad 'dug ji cis nga brgyud de khyed rang la bskur ba'i yi ge 'di red ’’ces yi ge dang dngul sgor lnga bcu tham pa stobs 'byor la sbrod bzhin du slar yang / 66khyed rang da res bal yul la gung gseng zhus te a pho lha 'brug gi mnyam du gtong shog ces bris 'dug ces nye 'khris su bsnad yod pa'i a pho lha 'brug la lta bzhin smras pas/ a pho lha 'abhug gis kyang 6snyered red/khyed rang gi sru mo dad+ku nga tsho khyim mtshes yin/ khyed rang gi lam gron dang dgongs shog tshang ma nga la bskur byung / yig tshang nas dgongs pa yang zhu tshar ba yin/byas tsang khyed rang sang nyin zhogs pa nga tsho'i mnyam du 'gro rtsis gyis zhes baji+od/ gnas tshul de go ba dang stobs 'byor dga' thag chod de yud tsam zhig la dngos 18skyid rong pas sru mo la zer/

ka spug slob grwa gtor ba/ 73'brel yin dang rmi lam yin dbye ba ②ོ da ma thub/ de nas lag tu yod pa'i sru mo'i yi ge dang dngul bskur ba rnams mthong skabs mngon sum yin pa shes te dga' sru+o tshad las 'das pa zhig byung / de nas a ma dbyangs skyid lags kyis ‘‘stobs 'byor/ da khyed rang sang nyin 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig byed du rgyugs/ ji ci la ngas bskur song zhes 'di spu+od ang ’’ zhes tshags shog rnying pa zhig gi nang du bsgril ba'i thum sgril zhig stobs 'byor gyi lag par sbrod bzhin smras/ stobs 'byor gyis a ma dbyangs sgyid kyis sbrad pa 'i thum sgril de len bzhin du ‘6lags so ’’zhes lab ste 'byor lngan la da 'gro mdog mdog gi brda ston phyir mgo g.yugs tsam byas te khong gnyis las zhag gi phyi la thon/phyi la thon ma thag 'byor ldan gyis/ ‘6kye/ ngas gnas tshul snyan los 'khyer 'dug’ ces sdus par stobs 'byor gyis gdong 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur daru bcas te 'byor ldan la lta bzhin du/ ‘‘dngos gnas gnas tshul snyan po 'khyer 'dug nga bal yul la gung gseng 'gro rgyu yong gi red snyam pa'i mi lam yang btang ma myong /da ring khyed rang gis brda lan snyan po 'khyer yong ba der ngas rgya gar ba'i shod srol ltar du/ tu swā re/ mukha me/ gī shakar/ khyod kyi kha la mar dang bu ram blugs/ zhes lab rgyu yin/’’zhes smras/ de'i lan du 'byor ldan gyis/ ‘‘blug rgyu gang yang med pa la/ kha la mar dang bu ram blugs/ lab nas phan thogs yod pa ma red/kye/ ha go song ngam ’ zhes lab pa der stobs 'byor gyis mno bsam zhig btang ste dngos gnas red bsam bzhin du/ ‘‘byas na rngan pa 'di byos ’ zhes 'byor

74 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/ldan gyi lag tu sgor mo lnga lor zhig sbrad pas/ 'byor ldan gyis der lta bzhin du/‘‘'o yag stong pa'i satam snyan las lag steng gi byi ril bzang / zer ba ltar/ kha stong pa'i mar dang bu ram las 'di yag gi red/ thugs rje che/ khyod gung gseng skyid po yong bar shog da dung bal yul nas rngan pa 'khyer shog ang ñca’ zhes god mo shor bzhin du baji+od pas/ stobs 'byor gyis zur za'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas/‘‘gtam gyi dpe la/ ri bo zas te 'grang rgyu med/ rgya mtsho 'thung ste ngom rgyu med/zer ba de khyod ri nga yin pa 'dra/ sha sbrad pas ma chog da dung gri 'khyer shog zer/'on kyang gas byed kyi ma red/ ngas rngan pa 'khyer yong chog da nyal khang la phyin te nga la ca lag bdag sgrug rgyag rogs byos dang zhes smras te khong gnyis nyal khang du phyin te sang nyin gyi 'gro chas sgrig bzhin bsnad/sang zhogs der chu tshod dgu pa tsam la stobs 'byor gyis a pho lha 'abhug dang slob phrug 'ga' shas zhig slob grwa'i rgyal sgo yod sar sgug bsngad yod pa shes te/ rang gi lcags sgam chung ngu zhig yod pa de 'khyer te khong tsho yod sa der phyin/ yud tsam gyi nang du bal yul la gung gseng 'gro mkhan gyi slob phrug bu dang bu mo bsnoms pa'i nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa rnams tshang ma a pho lha 'brug gi g.yas g.yon du 'dzo+oms/gang 'tsham zhig nas sngon tshud nas gla mngags byas pa'i snum 'khor mi grangs sum cu tsam shongs pa 'ig rgya lam steng du slebs/ a pho lha 'brug gis slob phrug tshos 'tshang kha mi rgyag pa'i ched du sngon tshud nas khong tshor lam ston byas yod pa ltar/ snum 'khor gyi nang du ming gzhung bang rim byas te snod du bcug de nas

ka sbug slob grwa gartor ba/ 7〉 snum 'khor gyi kha lo pa dang lag g.yog ne+e swā li dha ju 19 gnyis yod pa/ khong gnyis la yang b.lod mngags ji dgos byas te/ raju nyid kyang snu ma 'khor gyi nang du 'asbyol zin pa'i rjes su phru gu tsho tshang bsher zhig byas te/ snum 'khor gyi kha lo par ne+e byā li'i skad du 6‘dha yi/a bo/gā+o yo/ba ji/hun tsha/’ri da phyin na 'grigs song / zhes smras pas snum 'khor 'gro grabs byas pa dang phyogs gang sa gang nas bā yi/ bā yi/ zhes snum 'khor gyi phyi nang gnyis kar yod pa'i slob phrug tshang rdzusna gal/ga g.yugs byas te yud tsam gyi ring la lung pa skad cor gyis brgyangs te a pho lha 'brug gis stobs 'byor dang bcas pa'i slob phrug rnams/ ka sbyag gi sa zhi li gu ri bar snum 'khor dang / zhi li gu ri nas raka sul bar du me 'khor/ de nas slar yang snum 'khor nang du rgya bal sa mtshams brgyud de nyin mtshan lnga'i nang du bal yul rgyal sa kāṣ+ṭha maṇa ḍūr slebs zub pa byas/ kāṣ+ṭha maṇa ḍūr slebs pa dang a phos mchod rten dang / 'phags pa zhing kun du sdod mkhan gyi phru gu rnams ṭika si 21 gnyis re'i nang du blugs te phyogs so sor btang / de byings rnams jo la khel du snod kyi yod pas rang gi mnyam du khrid de pha ma so sor rtsis sbrad/stobs 'byor jo la khel bzo grwa'i nye 'gram du slebs pa dang / sru mo bsod nams dbang /9lha ju dang dha yi zhes pa bal skad du jo lags sam jo jo la zer/dh+ri༈snyiṭ+wāṃ~X—khyismorngu

76 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/mos rgya gar nas slob zu ga tsho slebs pa shes te bsu bar yong ba dang 'phrad ma thag a pho lnga 'brug sis ‘6bsod nams dbang mo/ khyed rang gi tsha bo stobs 'byor 'di red/ da rtsis bzhes rogs gnang zhes stobs 'byor phyogs la lag brda byed bzhin du smras pas bsod nams dbang mos stobs 'byor gyi gdong dang gzugs por lha yag cig byas te/ mig nas mig chu dbang med gtong bzhin du/86a mo/bu'o/khyod yi 'dra chen po 'tshar 'dugaji ci ngo shes kyi 'dug gas mizhes ba ju+od bzhin stobs 'byor la 'tham ste yud tsam zhig lus/ de nas bsod nams dbang mos stobs 'byor gyi lcags sgam de lag pa g.yas pas 'khyer/ lag pa g.yon pas stobs 'byor gyi lag pa bzung ste rang nyid kyi khang khyim du 'khrid de phyin/khyim du slebs ma thag stobs 'byor la ja mngar mo dkar yol gang dang / sba ji dang mnyam du zhog gog dang sha 'dres ma'i tshal sder ma gang sbrad pas/ de dag stobs 'byor gyis zla ba mang po kha lag ma rag pa bzhin dbugs kyang gtong 'phang med pa ltar bzas/bsod nams dbang mo'i bsam par bod gzhung slob grwa'i nang du nga'i bu 'di la lto grod pa 'grang pa zhig rag gi med pa thag chod snyam pa zhig byung / stobs 'byor gyis kha lag zas tshar ba dang / rang nyid kyi sgam gyi nang nas a ma dbyangs sgyid lags kyis bskur ba'i 'thum sgyil de bton te bsod nams dbang mor ‘‘'di a ma lags kyis bskur song ’’ zhes zer bzhin sbrad/ bsod nams dbang mos 'thum sgril de bsngogs nas lta skabs de'i nang du yi tsi gnyis dang / so khru so sman cha gnyis/spos chag gsum bcas yod pa mthong /

ka sbug slob grwa gtor ba/ 77de nas dgong dro'i chu tshod drug pa tsam zhig la stobs 'byor bu mo bstan 'dzin sgrol ma dang mnyam du rtsed mo rtses te khang pa'i bar 'khyams su bsngad yod pa'i skabs thig la/ mi gzugs stobs chen po dang / sna leb pa gang zhig la/ gdong sgor tsam pe da pa zhig slebs pas bstan khadzin sgrol mas rtsed mo rtse 'phro bzhag ste lam seng ‘6pa lags/’’ zhes mi de yi phang par 'tham/ stobs 'byor gyi bsam par sru mo lags kyi khyo ga de 'di yin pa red snyam ste lam seng yar langs te/ ‘‘a gu lags/ bkris bde legs/’’ zhes zhus/ bstan pas kyang stobs 'byor yin pa shes te/ 6‘yag stobs 'byor/ bkris bde legs/ khyed rang ga dus slebs pas ’zhes dris pa der stobs 'byor gyis lan ma brgyab sngon la bsod nams dbang mo khang pa'i phyi la yong ste/ 66bu khong tsho da gin chu tshod bzhi pa la slebs song ’’ zhes smras/ bstan pas ‘‘a las ’’ zhes baji+od pa dang mu mthud de stobs 'byor la 66lam la dka' las ma byung ngam/’’ zhes dris pa'i lan du stobs 'byor gyis/‘6lags/ ma byung /’ zhes lab/ de rjes tshang ma nang du 'asbyol te lhod lhod byas te bsnad/stobs 'byor bal yul du gung gseng sdod pa'i ring la/ bstan pa dang bsod nams dbang mo gnyis kyis rang nyid kyi sha khrag las mched pa'i phru gu ltar kho par byams skyong dang lta rtog byas par brten skyid po zhe drags byung bas slob grwar phyir log kyang byed 'dod de tsam ma byung /zla ba gnyis kyi ring la skabs re bu mo bstan 'dzin sgrol mar kha rogs mig rogs byed rgyu dang / skabs re nang du gad phyis dang lto snod 'khru

78 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/rgyu tsam las de min las ka med stabs/ stobs 'byor gyis dus tshod phal che ba slob grogs gzhan dag dang mnyam du bal yul rgyal sa dang / mchod rten/'phags pa shing kun sogs phyogs gang sar khyi bzhin myul ba dang / glog brnyan lta ba bcas byas te dus snadi bskyal/ khos rang nyid slob phrug cig yin pa'i cha nas deb klog rgyu dang ༈ yi ge 'bri rgyu'i bya ba na gcig kyang ma byas pas bstan pa dang bsod nams dbang mo gnyis la bu 'dis slob grwar sdod ring la'ang slob sbyong la do snang byed kyi e yod snyam pa'i dogs pa zhig byung / don 'di la dgongs te/ skyes chen dam pa zhig sgas/ phyi rol yul la mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ /grong dang grong khyer srang mdor rab rgyu ba'i//bag med spyod pa'i gnas rnams mtshon byed pa'i//grags pa nyams gzhi'i gnas kun brtson pas spongs/ zhes gsungs pa'ang gdams ngag ya nga dag tu mthong ngo /bstan pa dang bsod nams dbang mo bza' tsho gnyis ka jo la khel bod gzhung rum gdan bzo grwa'i nang du las ka byed kyi yod/ bstan pa bzo grwa'i 'gan 'dzin yin pa dang /bsod nams dbang mo rum 'thag gi dge rgan yin/nyin gcig dgong dro'i kha lag za zin pa'i rjes su bu mo bstan 'dzin sgrol ma gnyid nyal/ stobs 'byor gyis lto snod rnams 'khru bzhin pa'i skabs thig la bsod nams dbang mos ‘‘da nga rang gnyis bzo grwa nas dgongs pa zhus te sger gyi rum gdan bzo grwa zhig btsugs na yag gi ma red pas/ zla ba'i gla cha phran bu 'di 'dra zhig la brten nas mi tshe 'khyol thabs yod pa ma red ’’ ces bstan pa la smras/ bstan pas shes bya

ka sbug slob grwa gtor ba/ 79tshags zhog cig klog gin bsngad yod pa de ga ler rgya cog si steng du bzhag ste 5gas ring zhig 'then pa'i je sa su/ ‘6spyir rang nyid gcig pu'i mi tshe dang sger gyi dpapa 'byor yar rgyas kyi gnas stangs la bsam blo btang na khyed rang gis lab ba de dngos gnas red/ yig na yang / da lta'i char bod gzhung gis nga la yid ches blos 'gel gnang ste bzo grwa'i 'gan khur de nga'i dpyang pa'i steng du 'a ngog pa gnang lo da pas/ lam seng dgongs pa zhu stangs shes kyi ma red la/ lar nas spyi sems lhangs te sger sems kho na bcangs pa yin na/ las rgyu 'bras dang tshe 'di phyi la 'gro gi ma red ’ ces brjod/ de'i lan du bsod nams dbang mos ‘6khyed rang gis ga dus yin kyang las rgyu 'bras dang tshe 'di phyi sogs bshad sdod kyi 'dug da ring sang gi dus tshod 'dir las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag gzhan la ston mkhan gyi chos pa tshos kyang las 'bras la brtsi srung byed kyi med dus/nga tsho gcig pus las 'bras la brtsi srung byed rgyu dang sbyi sems bcangs rgyu'i ce kā lha len dgos pa gang yin nam/ da lta bar du las rgyu 'bras dang / sems shugs/ lhag bsam/ gzhung sems sogs bshad nas bsngad tsang rjes lus thebs pa red/ da dung yang de ltar bshad nas bsnad na rjes lus thebs rgyu nyag cig red/gtam gyi dpe la/mis gang zer la ma nyan/ gang byed la ltos/ lab pa nang bzhin grong rogs khyim mtshes tsho la ltos dang / tshang mas sger gyi bzo grwa 'dzugs sar bzo grwa btsugs/tshong khang bzung sar tshong khang bzung bas lo gcig lo gnyis kyi nang du phyug po ga 'dra chags 22dzu0bsgyunga'i0( rgya gar gyi skad du 'bogs ma la zer/

80 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/'dug snga mo dpal 'byor nga tsho las skyo ba de tshos deng sang khang pa rgyal khang nang bzhin gyi nang du bsnad de/ nang mi tshang ma phyi rgyal nas bzos pa'i mo ṭa 'od gril gril gyi nang du ñcar ldir khyer re 'gro ba dang / khyo gas ro leka si chu tshod 'dogs pa dang / skye dman gyis mjing par gser dang / byi ru/ gzi/ g.yu/ mu tig la sogs pa'i rgyan cha ki lo nyi shu tsam btags te ngom so ga 'dra byed kyi 'dug ngas shes pa la khong tsho phal che ba snga mo gzhung gi bzo grwa'i nang du las ka byas pa zha stag red/rang nyid la bzo grwa'i 'gan yod dus tshang mas gzhung sems dang / sems shugs/lhag bsam sogs kyi skad cha snyan po shod myong mkhan rkyang rkyang red/ 'on kyang deng sang sger phyug po chags tshar dus gzhung sems dang / sems shugs kyi skad cha gleng mkhan su yang mi 'dug ga da dung de las ldog ste bod mi phan tshun 'gran zla dang /phrag dog ② gas snang che ru ga tshod 'gro gi 'dug tha na pha ma gcig gi spun mched dbar la'ang phyi rgyal tshong shag gi don la rtsod pa ga tshod rgyag gi yod pa tshang mas ha go don gsal red/ gnyen spun phan tshun khang pa yag nyes dang mo ṭa bzang zhan gyi dbar la'ang chags sngang ga tshod byed kyi 'dug gang ltar deng sang gi bod pa'i sbyi tshogs nang du spyi sems dang / sems shugs / lhag bsam zhes bzhad de sger 'tsho ma zin nas sngod mkhan tsho 'jon thang med pa'i gras la brtsi gi yod pa mngon gsal dod po red ’mi ces smras/ bstan pas rgya cog gi steng nas g.yang khri las byas pa'i sna ru bzo bkod legs pa de yar blangs te/ sna tha sen mo gang shur sgro dang bcas 'then pa'i rjes su/ ‘6de tsho rang da sa skya legs bshad las/ blun po'i drung du mkhas pa bas/ /spre'u 'dzin pa ngo mtshar che/ /sprel 'dzin zas dang nor gyis

ka sbug slob grwa gtor ba/ 81mchod/ /mkhas pa lag pa stong par 'gro/ zhes gsungs gnang yod pa red/ da yin na yang phyogs gcig nas bsam mno btang na/ khyed rang gis bshad pa de tsho tshang ma bden pa red/ deng sang gi dus tshod 'dir che sa nas rgyal khab gcig yin kyang rung / chung sa nas mi tshang sler zhig yin kyang rung / yar rgyas kyi tshad bzung sa de dpal 'byor yod med la byed srol yod pa red/ dper na/stobs chen rgyal khab a mi ri ka zhes 'dzam gling la skad grags yo da pa de dpal 'byor yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red la/ mi tshang sger zhig la cha mtshon na/ bal yul nang du gnya' nang bu nyi ma zhes tshang mas ngo shes pa de yang dpal 'byor gyi stobs las byung ba red/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsam blo btang na/ dpal 'byor chen po yod pa tsam gyis mi la bde ba yod pa'i khyab pa med/ 7gong sa mchog gis dus rgyun du bka' gnang gi yod pa bzhin/ sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa mnyam pa red/ byas dus mi tshang ma'i bsgrub bya'i dmigs yul de bde skyid re+od/bde skyid ces pa 'di lus bde ba tsam ma zad sems skyid pa'ang 'dzams dgas/zas nor longs spyod rnam sras kyi bu ltar yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi der bde skyid 'dzoms yod red pas zer na/red zer rgyu de zhe drags khag po red/dbe+er na/phyug po 'ga' shas rgas pa ma shes par rgas 'gro ba mthong gi 'dug ga de skyid po med pa'i rtags mtshan gcig red/ gzhan yang nga tshos bltas na khang pa dang / mo ṭa/ de bzhin gang 'dod za rgyu dang gang legs kyi rgyan cha 'dogs rgyu yod mkhan tsho sgyid mdog kha po mthong gi 'dug ga go kyang nga tshos bong tsho'i phyi 'i 'ja' tshon de mthong ba ma gtogs/ nang gi rlung 'tshub de mthong si yod pa ma red/ phyi mdzes mo rma bya'i

82 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/sgro mdangs de mthong ba ma gtogs/ nang mi gtsang dug gi kha rlangs de tshor gyi yod pa ma red/ don 'di 'dra la dgongs te rgyal sras thogs med bzang pos kyang /gsog pa'i tshe na nyon mongs brgya yi rten/ /rnyed nas spyad par 'dod tshe ser sna'i gzhi//gel te gzhazha gyis 'phrog na smre ngag rgyu//rnyed nas phan pa med pa nor gyis ci/zhes gsungs pa ltar red/ lar nas mi gzhan gyis byas rjes su 'brangs pa tsam gyis rang si mngon 'dod sgrub thub pa'i nges pa'ang gang yang med/gtam gyi dpe la/mi yi la da zlos sprel gyis byas/ sprel gyi mjug ma mes 'chig zer ba ltar mes mi 'chil pa 'i nges pa yo da pa ma red/ ma gzhi nas gzhung bi las ka nas dgongs pa zhus te sle ra gyi bzo grwa zhig btsugs pa'i dbang du btang yang / tshong la ma rtsa dgos pa ma zad rum gdan gyi tshong la rum gdan phyir tshong byed sa'i phyi rgyal gyi tshor thag kyang dgos mkho yod pas de tsho ga nas yong gi red ’lhaces baji+od/ bstan pas de lngar dris par brten bsod nams dbang mo grung gyil hril chages pa dang /rnam 'gyur yang 'dzum zer dod du phyin pa lta bu byas te ‘‘nga rang tsho sger gyi bzo grwa btsugs na ma rtsa sa tshod dgos kyang a bo dngos grub kyis gtong ①ོ ga zer gyi 'dus tshong shago ni da yod khyed rang gis ngo shes pa'i phyi rgyal tshong pa tsho la 'brel ba byas na 'grigs kyi red pa ’’zhes lab/ bstan pas de'i lan du ‘6da spo+od phyi rgyal tshoju pa de tsho gezhung gi tshong shag red/ de 'dra byas pas la ga nas dag mi la yang ngo tsha dgos pa red ’’ces baji+od/ der bsod nams dbang mos ‘6da lta bar du gzhung gi bzo grwa nas dgongs pa zhus te sger gyi bzo grwa 'dzugs mkhan tshang mas gzhung gi tshong sh-ig dang 'brel ba byas nas chu+o ga sa la nga tshos de 'du byed mi

ka sbug slob grwa gtor ba/ 83chog pa'i khrims gang yang yod kyi ma red/ da bsam blo mang po ma btang bar dgongs pa zhu rgyu'i gra sgrig mgyosas po byos/ dus tshod ring po 'gor na a pho dngos grub kyis ma rtsa de gal te mi gzhan la g.yar tshar na/ de dus kha gdang nas snod rgyu las lhag yod pa ma red/ da lta go skabs bzang po yod dus gle+o skabs bzung shes pa byed dbos ’’ zhes tha chig lta bur smras/ der bstan pas bsam blo yud tsam btang ba'i rjes su / 86yagabyas na/khyed rang gis 'dod nga/ yod pa ba'in byas gyi+o ga’’ ces lan 'debs byas rjes nyal bar phyin/ nyal sa'i nang du bstan pa'i bsam/ blor/ lha 'dre b.la' thang gi nang du gu ru rin po ches/ bud med 'khor ba'i gzhi ma yin/ ngan song gosum gyi sa bon yin/ thar pa ra 'gro ba'i sgo gegs yin/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rgyu rkyen yin/ gsungs pa de de 'dra'i bderme pa la ang /bsam nga dang mnyam du gang zag su rung bud med kyi kha dbang 'og tu tshud tshar na bya thabs gzhan med pa'ang thes bzhin du gnyid du song /de nas dus yun mi ring ba 'ig gi rjes su nyin gcig bstan pas las khyangs su song ste/ bsam blo'i nang du lho phyogs kyi gdan sa mar khya 'khyil ba lta bu'i bslab pa slob genyer byed sa'i bsti gnas/ zas gos la sems khral med sa/mdo rgyud la sbyangs pa byed sa/ bslab gsum la nyams len byed sa/ rnga sbub kyi sgra dbyangs thos sa/ 'gyed mang ja'i char pa 'bab sa/ mkhan rlo ba ngapon gyi chos sgra sgrog sa/ mched grwa tshogs kyi ngur brgya tshogs sa de lta bu'i srid na rnyed par dka' ba'i gdan sa 'bras spungs zhes pa de bzhag ste/ las kyi rlung btsan pos 'khrid de skya babasasne

84 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/dgos pa byung ba dang / da cha gzhi nas 'khor ba la nges 'byung phran bu skyes kyang las dbang gis rkyen pas bud med kyi kha dbang du shor nas byed mi 'dod pa'i lus la 'jug dgos pa 'di ci yin nam dran ba'in du dpal 'byor bka' blon gyi mtshan thog la rang nyid bza' 'tsho gnyis bzo grwa'i las khur nas dgongs pa yong ba'i snyan zhu zhig bris te sbrag brgyud du phyal/de dang dus mtshungs su ka sbug bod gzhung slob grwar yang 'gyur ba ha cang chen po zhig thebs/ dgun kha'i gung gseng zla ba gnyis ma rdzogs sngon gyi nyi ma bco lnga tsam zhig la ka sbug slob grwa gtor rgyu dang / da yod slob phrug rnams phal che ba zhim swā dang / de byings rnams ḍal hor dang ma su ri gnyis kyi slob grwar zla bsgril byed rgyu'i gsal bsgrags shig slob grwar yod pa'i dge las slob phrug rnams la byas pa ma zad/ gung gseng du bskyod pa'i slob phrug rnams la'ang rang nyid gong gsal slob grwa gsum gang du 'gro dgos pa'i gsal bsgrags tar 'phrin brgyud de slob grwa'i las khungs nas btang / stobs 'byor la'ang kho pa gung gseng gi dus tshod thim mtshams ḍal hor bod gzhung slob grwar 'gro dgos pa'i tar 'phrin zhig 'byor/ stobs 'byor gyis gnas tshul de thos pa dang kho par sems pa mi skyid pa dang blo mi bde ba zhig byung / rtsa ba'i slob sbyo nga la de tsam gyi do snang med pa dang / slob grwar phyir log bya 'dod med pa'i khar da cha sa cha gsar pa dang / slob phrug ngo mi shes pa/ la/sa byed 'dris pa med sa zhig tu 'gro 'dod ye nas ma byung /stobs 'byor ḍal hor slob grwaru 'gro 'dod med pa de bsod na mas dbang mos

ka spug slob grwa gtor ba/ 85shes kyi yong/ pas/ bstan pa dang go bsdur lhug por byas te stobs 'byor nang du nyar rgyu'i thag gcod byas/ gtam gyi dpe la/ dpon g.yu lhar phebs 'dod med pa dang / lha gnam sde'i lung bstan byung ba gnyis gab mtshungs/ zer ba ltar/stobs 'byor slob grwar 'gro 'dod med pa dang bsod nams dbang mo dang bstan pa gnyis la bzo grwa gsar pa 'dzugs skabs mi cha dgos kyi yod pa gnyis stabs 'grigs pa byung / ka sbrug bod gzhung slob grwa gtor ba'i nyer len la brten nas slob phrug mang po zhig gi mi tshe'i mdun lam la do phog phyin yod/ dper na/ skabs der shim swā dang ḍal hor du yod pa'i ka spug gi slob phrug bu rgan pa 'ga' shas slob grwa nas gsang bros kyis nang du log pa dang / 'ga' shas dang dmag khongs su bskyod pa'ang byung yod la/ bu mo rgan pa du ma zhig gung gseng nas phyir log ma byas par nang du bsnad pa yang byung yod/ gal te slob grwa de gtor med na slob sbyong mu mazud ma zub pa'i gzhon skyes kyi grangs 'bor de tsam gyi mang po yong rgyu dka' mo yin/ slob sbyong mu mazud de byed ma thub pa des gang zag sger gyi mi che'i gnas babs la gnod skyon de tsam byung ba nyung shas yin srid kyang / bod mi'i sbyi tshogs la mi'i zhus shugs kyi dgos mkho'i cha nas gnod skyon byung yod pa ni gdon mi za'o/ ka sbyag bod gzhung slob grwa thor nas do phog dang brdab gsig che shos de sa khul gyi nyin mo'i slob phrug grangs lnga bcu lhag tsam zhig yod pa khong tsho dang / khong tsho'i pha mar byung yod/ de dus khul der bod pa'i slob grwa ka sbrug bod gzhung slob grwa kho na las

86 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/med stabs bod mi rang gi rig gzhung dang / skad yig la dga' zhen yod pa'i pha ma tsho ni ci bya gtol med du gyur/gangs dkar shel gyi mchod rten 'dra ba'i shes yon bsti gnas bod slob cig/zhub phyoges lhang ga la yi yul du sngon med gzhi rtsa tshugs na yang //'phral gyi rkyen mang tsha zer dbang sis gangs ri mar khu bzhin du song //gangs la sanas pa'i seng phrug rnams kyang sran phung bzhin du gling bzhir thor //gtam dang yig rtsis gnas la sbyang pa'i rnam dpyod blo yi bang rtsal dang //gnyen dang nye bas byams kyis bskyangs pa'i drin gyi dkyus kha bstan phyogs dang //lha dang bla mas byin gyis rlabs pa'i ngag gi srab thur 'then phyogs sogs//blo dang rig pa'i geri sa la 'jus pa'i 'do ba rkyang che na ka sbrug dran//

rdo rje dril bya'i dbang /bcu49/ /bstan pa dang bsod nams dbang mo gnyis mi tshe'i nang kha thug stangs ni/hob ste bltas na rgya gar glog brnyan gyi sgrung lta bu zhig yod/ lo drug tsam gyi sngon du bstan pa rgya gar lha phyags 'bras sbrungs klu 'bum khang tshan gyi grwa pa yin pa ma zad/ 'dzin grwa yang dbu ma lo rim gnyis pa'i nang du slebs yod/ kho pa 'dzin grwa'i nang nas dpe cha drag gras zhig yin pa dang / gdan sa'i nang du dge bshes ming don mtshungs pa zhig gtong rgyu'i 'dun pa blo la bcangs te snod mkhan zhig kyang yin/'on kyang stabs nyes pa zhig la/ rgya gar nang du bslab pa slob gnyer byed mkhan gyi gdan sa'i dge 'dun pa tshor de snga bod dang mi 'dra bar 'tsho bar dka' ngal chen po yod pa'i rkyen gyis mkhan po dang / slob dpon/ de bzhin las sne rnams phud pa'i khang tshan so so'i nang nas 'ga' shas kyis dgun kha suwi ṭar tshong rgyag dgos pa dang / 'ga' zhas kyis za khang dang mgron khang 'dzin dgos pa/ 'ga' sgos grong chog la rgyugs te dpal 'byor bsdu 'god byed dgos kyi yod pa bzhin/ klu 'bum khang tshan gyis kyang bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram du za khang zhig

88 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/thog mar lo kha shas ring 'bogs mar blangs/ de nas lo re bzhin tshong khe yab po byung bas mthar za khang yongs rdzogs spus nyo byas/ za khang gi 'dzin skyong lta rtog dang las ka byed par khang tshan gyi grwa pa dkyus ma yongs rdzogs res mos kyis lo gsum rer dbe mtshams bzhag ste 'gro dgos kyi yod/bstan pa yang las rogs grwa pa gzhan bzhi dang bcas mnyam du bal yul du za khang gi 'dzin skyong byed par slebs/ za khang gi ming la klu 'bum za khang zhes btags/ za khang de mi shongs rgya che ba dang / dngos gtsang ba/ lhag par du thug pa dang mog mog zhim po bzo gi yod tsang mi tshang mas 'tshang ga bathig bshig byas te kha lag bza' ru yong gi yod/ za khang gi las byed pa grwa pa lnga'i nang nas bslab pa rgan shos dang / shes rgya che shos de bstan pa yin pas grwa tshang phyag mdzod kyis za khang gi 'gan khur gtso bo de bstan par rtsis sbrad yod/ des na las rogs gzhan tshang mas bsnyan pas gang bshad kyi bkod byus 'og shar skyod byed par ma zad brtsi mthong yang chen po zhu gi yod/ rgya gar nang du dge 'dun pa rnams zhing las dang /tshong las/ ar las/ de bzhin 'grul bskyod sogs byed skabs skya chas gyon rgyu dang / sbag sbag dang rkang gā ri bzhon chog pa'i gnang ba yod pa lta bur brtsi srol yod/ de ni 'dul ba dus dang bsdun khyal yin shas che yang skya bo tsho'i mthong snang la mi mdzes pa 'ig tan tan yong gi yod/ dge 'dun pa gang zag bye brag gcig la cha mtshon na'ang bod mi mchog dman bar ma ji 'dra zhig gi ngos la grwa chas mchod pa dang skya chas gyon pa gnyis la brtsi mthong dang gus zhabs gnam sa bar gyi khyad

rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / 89par yong gi yod/ gang ltar klu 'bum za khang gi las byed dge 'dun pa tshos kyang phar tshur 'gro dgos na jin gyi gos thung zhig dang nyi skyob zhwa mo zhig gyon/ gnam gathis tsha ba'i skabs su ṭi thaṭa — dang grang ba'i skabs su ko ba'am/ yang na bya spu'i jar kiṭa —4re gyon nas sprug sbag bzhon te 'gro srol yod/nyin gcig daphyid ka tsha ba che ba'i sgang zhig la bstan pa las don zhig bi phyir ko paṇa dgon par phyin te dgong dro srod rub ma rub kyi mtshams zhig la nang du phyir log byas/ kho pa sbag sbage btang nas g.yas g.yon gnyis la 'bras zhing dang /ne+e swā li'i grong gseb kyi khang pa tha re tho re yod sa zhig brgyud de yong ba'i skabs zhig la/ lam gyi nye 'gram gyi 'bras sog spungs pa'i phung po chen po du ma yod sa de'i phyogs nas bu mo zhig gis ne+e shā li'i skad du/ ‘‘ba hā 'o/ ba cwa 'o/’’ (nga skyobs dang / nga skyobs dang ) zhes ngu skad dang sbrags skad shugs chen po rgyag bzhin yod pa thos/ lam seng sbag sbag de lam gyi zur zhig tu bkag ste skad rgyag sa der rgyugs phyin/ nye 'gram du slebs pa dang bstan pas bod pa'i bu mo gzhon gzhon zhig la rne pā li pho gsar gnyis kyis zub tshod btang ste btsan g.yem byed rtsis byed kyi yod pa mthong ma thag khong khro langs te/ ni pa li'i skad du/‘‘wa ye/ kya lhar dhe tsha/chor zhus/ ta phe/ ha ru/ la yi/ zha ram/ dha ram/ tsha yi ṭ+wāṃ/25’’trīṭ+wāṃ ༵hā/shādi 25 ༵spra /ོ/ blo// du/wa ye/ga re byed kyi yod/khyed tsho la ngo tsha dang zhe khral re da dam/zhes

90 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/zhes ngar skad 'don bzhin bu mo der ram 'deges byed par rgyugs phyin/ nye 'khris su slebs pa dang rne byā li'i pho gsar gcis gis kha nas gang yang ma brjod par sba khug nas gri chung zhig bton te bstan pa'i mdun la g.yugs/ bstan pas gri de g.yol thabs su gzugs po 'khyog tsam zhig byas2kyang lus rtsal de tsam bde po med pas brla sha g.yon par zug bstan pas lam seng gri de bkog ste phar rgyag rtsis byas pa daju pho gsar gnyis ka bla 'khyer ba lta bur 'jigs snang skyes te bros phyin/ pho gsar gnyis gar song cha med du bros zin mtshams bstan pas thog mar bu mo der ‘‘da gas byed kyi ma red/khong tsho bros tshar song /khyed rang ma ngu ’’zhes baji+od bzhin du sa steng nas yar bslangs/ de nas rang gi brla sha'i rma kha der blta dus khrag shugs che zags kyi yod pa shes te rang gi lag pas rma kha bkab ste bsngad yod pa'i skabs der gzhi nas bu mo des/ ‘‘a mo/jo lags khyed rang la rma chen po bzos yod pa 'dra/ da ga 'dra byed dgos red/ ltas ngan de tsho/ da ring khyed rang med na nga la khong tshos thub tshod btang tshar ba yod/ phyag rogs gnang bar thugs rje che gnang ’’ zhes baji+od de rang nyid kyi skro la dkris pa'i rgya ras khra khra de phud de bstan pa la sbyod bzhin du ‘6'dis dam por bsdams na phal cher khrag chad mi yong ngam ’mi zhes smras/ bstan pas rgya ras de blangs te kha nas gang yang ma baji+od par yud tsam zhig phar lta tshur lta byas pa'i rjes su nye 'khris su yod pa'i shing snong zhig la mdzub mo btsugs te/‘‘zhing snong pha gi'i lo ma kha shas bkog nas 'khyer shog dang ’’ zhes re skul byas/ bu mo des lam seng phyin te lo ma kha shas 'khyer yong ste bstan pa la sbrad/ bstan pas zhing lo de dag rang gi lag pa gnyis

rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / 91kyis snur yag byas te sang 'tsham nas 66da khyed rang nga phyogs la ma lta ang ’’zhes baji+od bzhin du rang gi gos thung de mar phud de/ rma kha der dang po zhing lo de yag thag chod byugs/de nas rgya ras des bsdams sta gos thung yar gyon tshar ba'i rjes su ‘‘da nga gnyis 'gro ’’ zhes bu mo der brda byas te rkang pa 'khyog tsam 'khyog tsam byed bzhin du sbag sbag yod sa der phyin/sbag sbag gi 'khris su slebs pa dang bstan pas ‘‘ma gzhi nas khyed rang gcig bya mtshan la ga par 'gro gi yod/ sngod sa ga par bsdad yod ’ ces bu mo der dris/bu mos/ 6‘nga shing sgrag tu yong ba yin/ bu gcig nga'i khyim mtshes red/ nam rgyun nga gnyis thing sgrag pat+na mnyam du 'gro gi yod/ de ring khos rogs pa gzhan zhig skad btang nas s+dza la thub tshod btong grabs byas song / nga tsho snod sa mchod rten gyi 'gram la yod/ de ring jo lags khyed rang med na da nga dbe bsags tshar song ’’ces blo pham pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas smras/ bstan pas/ ‘‘mi ngo shes la ma shes pa tshang mar yid ches byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ byas na shing ga par yod ’’ ces dris/bu mos/6‘pha gir yod ’’ ces lag brda byas/de nas bstan pas zhing khur chung chung de dang bu mo de gnyis ka rang nyid kyi sbag sprug steng du skyon te bu mo de'i nang bar du bskyal/ bu mo des nang du ma slebs sngon la bstan pa'i ming dang snod yul/ de bzhin las ka ga re byed kyi yod med sogs cha tshang sdus pa ma zad mo rang gi ming dang las ka ga re byed kyi yod med kyang cha tshang bstan pa la bshad pas gzhi nas mo'i ming la bsod nams dbang mo yin pa bstan pas shes/

92 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/de nyin bstan par lam dbar la de tsam gyi na zug dang tsha zug ma byung yang za khang du slebs ma thag gzhi nas rma chen po bzos yod pa shes te/ rogs pa tshos lam seng kho pa sman khang du khrid/ sman khang du nyi ma lnga bsngad pa'i ring la bsod nams dbang mos nyin ltar bstan par zug 'phrad du yong ste nad g.yog byas/ bstan pa drag skyed byung ba'i rjes su yang skabs re bsod nams dbang mo za khang du yong ba dang / yang skabs re bstan pa bsod nams dbang mo'i nang du 'gro ba sogs byas te phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mdza' gcugs kyi skya rengs thog ma de nas shar/yin na yang dus yun zla ba drug tsam gyi ring la phan tshun gnyis kas sems nas bsams pa kha nas 'don ma phod par re dogs dang re sgug gi na so gzhon pa'i kun rtog gi mdza' brtse kho nar lus/ khong gnyis lhan cig tu 'du bar spyi tshogs dang / khor yug gnas babs/ de bzhin gcig tshod gcig gis mi lon pa sogs kyi 'gal rkyen du ma yod la/ lhag par du bstan pa'i bsam blor skabs re rang nyid kyi srog las kyang gces pa'i bslab snom de shor na rtsa ba nas 'grigs kyi ma red snyam pa dang / yang skabs re bsod nams dbang mo'i lang tsho dar la babs pa'i mtshar sduge dang / be tog kha 'bus pa lta bu'i mchu 'dab/ bcu bzhi'i zla ba tshes pa 'dra ba'i zhal ras/ 'o ma las dkar ba dang mar las 'jam pa'i brla sha sogs mthong tshe/ rang dbang med par 'dod lha'i mda' phogs te lus kyi ba spyogazeng yong gi yod pas 'dod pa'i bde bar thengs ga bgasad na a'u tsam min 'gro snyam pa'ang yong gi yod/ de bzhin bsod nams dbang mo la yang nga la bstan pas dga' mdog byed pa 'di pho gsar mo gsar gnyis kyi dbar la yong ba'i brtse ba de yin

rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / 93nam yang na kho pa grwa ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis byams dang snying rje'i rtsis zin pa'i brtse ba de yin dbye 'byed mi shes pa'i dka' ngal zhig yod/de 'dra'i mod la nyin gcig za khang sgo brgyab ste rogs pa sazhan rnams glang ri lung bstan du gnas mjal la bskyod de med pa'i skabs zhig la/ bsod nams dbang mo bstan pa'i las shag tu slebs pas de nyin bstan pas bsod nams dbang mo la 'khyud de 'o zhig skyel grabs byed skabs bsod nams dbang mos/ 6sdo( rdzi/ 'di 'dra a yin nam/ khyed rang grwa pa ma red pas n+ta zhes zur za dang bcas 'dzum gyis smras pa las de min mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur dmigs bsal ma bsnyan/de'i lan du bstan pas/ ‘6a las/grwa pa la 'dod chags yod ma red sus zer gyi 'dug gam lha’ zhes lag pa gnyis kyis bsod nams dbang mo dam por bzung ste dris/ bsod nams dbang mos/ ‘6grwa pa la 'dod chags yod ma red zer gyi bed/gcig byas na skya bo las kyang che ba yod srid kyi red/yin na yang khyed rang grwa pa log na nga la sdig pa yod ma red pas ’’zhes sprus/bstan pas ha ha zhes gad mo shor bzhin du/ ‘6'dod pa'i mi la 'dod pa'i dpal ster ba/ dge ba ma gtogs sdig pa gang nas yong /zer ba de khyed rang gis go ma myong ba 'dra/lar nas sdig pa phran bu yod pa'i dbang du btang yang / zhwa ba gsod mkhan la sdige pa yong ba ma gtogs sha ba la sdig pa sa nas yong / de 'dra byung na las 'bras go ldog ma red pas ñca’ zhes brjod/

94 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/gang 'tsham zhig nas bsod nams dbang mos bzhin 'dzum pa dang sbrages te/6‘byas na 'di'i don du khyed rang gis kha sang nga ne+e swā li'i pho gsar gnyis las/ barmya bas pa/ red dam ’nya zhes dris/ bstan pas/ 66de 'dra rang da ma red/ gtam gyi dpe la/ 1 skya rengs la nas thon pa dang / jo dpa' las phyag mdal skyon pa gnyis/las de dang de gnyis 'phrad le red/ zer ba bzhin red ma gtogs/ de dus ngas khyed rang ngo yang shes kyi med la mthong yang myong yod pa ma red/ las kyi 'brel ba zer ba de 'di 'dra byas te grub kyi yod pa min 'gro ’’ 'es bshad/ der bsod nams dbang mos rang nyid kyi mgo bo phred du g.yug bzhin ‘6 a tsi/ sku rtsed zhus pa yin/ yin na yang dngos gnas bathad na nga khyed rang la dga' gi 'dug ste/ grwa pa slog 'dod rtsa ba nas mi 'dug ’’ ces smras te kha skyengs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas phyi la ragro grabs byas/ bstan pas slar yang bso da nams dbang mo'i lag pa nas 'jus te/ 68khyed rang la ngas mtha' gcig tu u tshugs byed 'dod med/'on kyang ngas khyed rang la gnas tshul gcig gsal po byas te shod 'dod yod/ de sa re red zer na/ khyed rang gis shes gsal ltar nga tsho'i za khang gi nang la dbyin ji mang po yong gi 'dug ga dbyin mo de tsho dmigs bsal grwa pa la dga' po zhe drasas yod pa'ang khyed rang gis shes kyi yod 'gro/ de tsho la phar khu/tshugs rgyab mi dgos par tshur sbyar yong mkhan mang po 'dug byas tsang gal te nga dbyin mo gcig dang 'brel ba byung na/de dus 'gyod pa ma byed ang /gtam gyi dbe la/kha gsal na go bde/ nam langs na 'gro bde/ zer ba bzhin ngas dang po nas gsal po byas te ba ngod rgyu yin/ drang por bsod na khyed rang gi mnyam du ngas mi tshe mnyam skyel byed

rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / 95rtsis yin ’ 'es nan tan gyi tshul du baji+od/bsod nams dbang mos yud tsam ring cang ma sprus par langs te bsnad/ de nas glo bur zhig la bstan pa'i mjing par 'khyud de/ 6‘de 'dra yin na ngas khyed rang gi chang phud de dbyin mo zhig la sprod du 'jug gi min/ da rdo rje dang dril bu'i dbang ga re gnang rgyu yod kyang nga la sanang rogs gnang /'on kyang dbang gral la thog mar zhugs mkhan yin tsang tshe ril dang tshe chang bro ba che tsam bzo rogs gnang ’’ zhes gnyis ka gcig gis gcig la 'tham ste gad mo shor bzhin du nyal khri'i steng du zags/de 'dra'i mod la zla ba genyis phyin pa'i nang du bsod nams dbang mor mngal chags/ bstan pas grwa tshang dang za khang gi las khur nas dgongs pa zhus te/ khong gnyis kyis gnas skabs dha sar gnas spor byas/ dha sa mnyam las bzo grwar lo gnyis las ka byas pa'i rjes su dpal 'byor las khungs kyis bstan pa jo la khel bzo grwa'i 'gan 'dzin dang / bsod nams dbang mo rum 'thag gi dge rgan du bsko mngags gnang ste bal yul du btang ba yin/nyin gcis ka sbrug gi ri mgo gangs kyis g.yogs/ ri gsham smug pas btums/mtho nam mkha'i ngos su sbyin phung lang long g.yo ba dang /slob phrug tsho dgun gyi grang ngar las skyob pa'i thabs gcig kho na gser lngan nyi ma'i drod mdangs sbyin pa'i rta ljang dbang pos sgrin phung gi gseb nas yib 'tshol rtsed bzhin pa'i skabs zhig la/slob phrug mang po zhig 'dzoms te 'tshang ga bathig bathig byas te/ slob grwa'i gsal

96 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/bsgrags sbyar byang gi steng du sbyar ba'i gsal bsgrags shog lhe bcu gnyis yod pa de dag la blta bzhin yod pa blo bzang gis mthong bas/ ga re yod dam snyam ste der lha bar 'gro skabs zhim lā dang / ḍal hor/ ma su ri sogs bod gzhung gtan 'jags slob grwa khag gi nang du slob phrug su dang su gtong rgyu'i tho gzhung yin pa shes te/ tshang mar rim bzhin do snang byas te bklags skabs/ slob phrug phon che ba shim lā dang / de nas ḍal hor dang paca mā ri bcas su gtong gi yod pa las/ ma su rir 'gro mkhan gyi slob phrug gsum las med pa dang / rang nyid kyi ming tho de thim lār 'gro mkhan gyi gras su yod pa shes/ de bzhin sa khyal so sor 'gro mkhan gyi slob phrug sde khag de dag la 'go 'dren byed po'am/ khrid mkhan slob phrug mang nyung la ltos te dge rgan gsum nas gcig gi bar du bsko mngags byas yod pa dang / slob phrug tshang ma nyi ma bcu'i nang tshun du phyogs so sor 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig dgos pa'i bkod khyab kyang gnang yod pa shes/rgyu mtshan dmigs bsal zhig la brten nas blo bzang zhim lār 'gro 'dod rtsa ba nas ma byung / kho pa 'gro 'dod yod sa 'i slob grwa gcig las med pa de ma su ri yin/ slob grwa'i nang du dus rgyun slob phrug phan tshun slob grwa gzhan gyi skor la lab gleng yong lkobs mya risu ri slob sbyong yag po yod pa'i skor go myong pa dang / bzhan yang 7gong sa mchog thog mar rgya gar du chibs sgruro gnang skabs ma su rir bzhugs gdan 'jags gnang ba/de bzhin bad gzhung slab grwa tshang ma'i nang nas snga thos de ma su ri chags yod tsang blo bzang der 'gro 'dod byung / des na blo bzang gi

rdo rje dril bu'i dbang / 97bsam par gal te gnas lugs rgyu mtshan zhus na slob spyis dgongs bzhes gnang mi yong ngam snam ste sang zhogs der slob grwa'i las khungs sgo phyes pa dang slob sbyi'i las khungs/ su bcar/blo bzang gis slob spyi'i las khungs kyi sgo yol de lag pa g.yas pas tos tsam phye bzhin du/ ‘‘sku ngo lags/ nga yar bcar chog pa zhu ’ zhes zhus/sku ngo zla bas dus rgyun nga'i las khungs nang du slob phrug lta zhog las byed pa'ang mang po yong myong med kyang / de ring 'di ga 'dra yin nam snyam pa'i ya mtshan dang thugs dogs kyang phran bu skyes te/ 66yong nga / yar shog dang / ga re yin pas ’’ zhes skad cha dris/sku ngo zla ba ni/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe grangs la slebs pa'i pho dar ma sha lo dkar la dbu skra'i mdog ser shud tsam yod pa/ sku sha 'byor po yang min la skam po'ang min pa/ sku tshad phi ṭi lnga dang in ci drug tsam yod pa/ zhal ras sgor la leb pa/ dbral pa'i steng gi skro rnams phal cher zad de sān je gān dhi lha6nang bzhin ga ril yin pa gang zhig la dus rgyun du sbyan shel gyon te bzhugs mkhan zhig yod/ khong de snga bod rgya 'og tu ma zhor gong nas dhar ji ling du slob sbyong gnang ba song tsang dbyin ji dang /hin di/ zhe pā li'i skad yig bcas mkhyen par ma zad bod yig thar thor 'bri klog thub tsam yod/ blo bzang ga ler las khungs su 'dzul te gus zhabs kyi tshul du mgo bo gug gug byas/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ce sku ngo zla ba lags kyi mdun 26573'iskyadu8baspukhyi1 rgyadagaragyisridablonabyedamyongayod/ ————

98 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/du yod pa'i yig cog gi zur der langs te/ ‘8sku ngo lags/ nga zhim lār 'gro mkhan gyi gras la tho 'dug yin na yang nga der 'gro gi min ’’ ne+es sogs baji+od bzhin pa'i chig thag ma chod sngon la sku ngo zla ba lags phran bu sku rlung bzhengs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te/ ‘‘zhim lār ma 'gro na/ dzā hūṃm la 'gro gi yin pas ’’zhes smras/der blo bzang mgo thom nas ‘6sku ngo lags/ dzā num zer na ga re red ’’ces dris par/ sku ngo zla bas blo bzang la lta bzhin du ‘6ā/ ji num zer na rgya gar gyi skad du dmyal ba la zer ba red lha ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis sku ngos skyag skyag byas pa ma shes tsang / ‘‘sku ngo lags/ nga dmyal bar 'gro dgos pa'i sdig pa 'tshab chen de 'dra da lta gang ji5nga bsags med ’’ ces lan btab/blo bzang gi lan de sku ngo zla ba'i rna bar ma song ba dang / lhag par du nye sngon slob rgyag 'ga' shas kyis kho par ngo rgol gyi tshul du mo ṭar rdo bzhus pa de dag lhang lhang dran gsos te/ ‘6ā/khyed stunyare gras kha bde mdog kha po yod byas/ gnam mgo la gyon/ sgrin pas 55ོga sgrog brgyab/ da lta nas shog sbug rlung tshang gis drin can lag pa rdo rdung byed : sa red pa/ ma gzhi nas sdig pa zer na ga re red/ shes kyi yod pas lha zhes ba ngod༈de'i lan du blo bzang gis/ ‘chosku ngo lags/ sdig pa zer na/ mi dge ba bcu'i las byas na sdig pa red/ gzhan yang sgo gsum gyi byed las la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal lam/ yid du mi 'ong rngu sbyin par byed pa'i rgyu de la sdis pa zer gyi red ces rgan lags kyis gsungs gnang gi 'dugalar nas gtam gyi dbe la/hra zhib brtag par ma byas na/ du ba rlangs par nor nyen yod/ces gsungs pa ltar nga sku ngo lags su ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi gras la rtsa nas med ’’ ces smras/ sku ngo zla ba'i
