130 mi che'i thos ba mngar skyur/khul gyis 'gram gyi zam pa phar bcad tshur bcad dang /skabs re tshong pa tsho'i do bo phar skyel tshur skyel byed kyin bsnad/ ci ma drug phyin pa'i rjes su nyin gcig de sngon bal yul mchod rten du thug pa'i tshong dpon de tshong chas do bo mang po khyer te sa mtshams su slebs pa blo bzang gis ngo shes te gzhan gyis ma tshor bar byas te/‘‘tshong dpon lags/bkris bde legs/nga nye char mchod rten du thug pa'i slob phrug de yin ’’ baji+od pas tshong dpon hon thor te ‘‘ngas khyed rang ni pā li'i ku li red bsam pa ma gtogs ma byung / byas na 'grigs 'dug ngas khyed rang lha rtse bar du do skyel ba yin khyal byas te 'khrid chog sang nyin zhogs pa chu tshod dgu par 'dir 'dzoms pa gyis ang ’’zhes baji+od/sang zhogs der tshong dpon gyis rgya mi'i nyen rtog skor srung ba'i las khyangs su phyin te skor spung ba'i dpon po mtho shos de la chu tshod wes ṭin mazhig rngan pa sbu+od bzhin du ‘‘da re nga la tshong chas mang po yod tsang ne+e pā li'i ku li zhig lha rtse bar du snakhrid chog pa zhu gi yin ’’ zhes zhus pas skor srung ba des chu tshod der lta bzhin du 6di'o/ 'grigs kyi red/ ku li de ga par yod/ khrid shog ’ ces baji+od/ tshong dpon gyis ‘6bha d+dhar/e ta/a ung hūṃs ’zhes blo bzang las khungs su bos pas der slebs / skor srung ba des blo bzang la lta yag cig byas rjes phran bu dogs pa za ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan te/ ‘6ku li 'di ngas da bar du mthong myong mi 'dug ga par sngod kyi 5ོ/da red/’’ces dris par skor srung ba bod pa gcig ji+o5ོda pa des ‘‘ku li 34yagadzi5(stubaspu4ngabya(78po wa

zla ba sgrol ma'i nang mi/ spro31'di nyin mang po nas ngas ngo bo phar tshur dbor 'dren byed pa mthong byung / snying rje/grong gseb pa skyo bo zhig yin pa 'aspri/’’ zhes la na 'debs byas dpon po des ‘6byas na 'grigs kyi red/ 'on kyang ku li 'di'i 'gan khur cha tshang khyed rang gis byed dgos pa red da/ shes song ngam ’’ zhes tshong dpon la smras pas tshong dpon gyis ‘‘lags bka' ba'i shes/yin da yin/ rizhes baji+od de blo bzang sa mtshams nas 'khrid de lha sar 'gro malan gyi snum 'khor gyi nang du tshong chas blugs su bcugasdum 'khor de'i nang du bod mi dang /kha tshar ba/ne+e pā li'i tshong pa bcas nyi shu rtsa grangs zhig yod pa dang mnyam du tshong ngapon dang blo bzang 'grul bzhud byas/'gram nas lha rtse bar du bar bar la rgya mi'i skor srung bas blo bzang la dogs pa byas te kho pa'i ras 'thum de sngos/ gsher byed rtsis thengs 'ga' shas byas kyang tshong dpon gyis de dag la pad zhag sbrad dgos sar pad shag sbrad/ kha snyan po shod dgos sar kha snyan tshig snyan bshad de mtha' ma blo bzang lha rtser slebs thub pa byung /lha rtser tshong dpon gyi nang du nyin gnyis bsngad rjes tshong dpon gyis rang nyid kyi ngo shes pa'i bod mi ṭaka 'khor gtong mkhan zhigo la mngags te blo bzang gzhis ka rtser btang /rnam dkar las kyi bsod nams smin pas ste khrag gangs can ljongs su 'phos//sdun can pha ma'i brtse bar brten te byis ba'i skyed sring byed pa'i skabs//dmar po/'i dpung gi rlung 'tshub g.yos te byams skyong pha ma'i zhu rgyun bcad//shes yon char pa'i brlan la re ste mi yul thang chen 'grim pa'i dus//

132 mi tshe'i gro ba mngar skyur/gnyen dang nye du'i rgyu skar bral ba'i sngo bsangs ka spug slob grwar slebs//grogs dang mjo' mo'i sgrin gyis dben pa'i gtam dang yig rtsis sbyong pa'i dus//pha ma med pa'i dwa phrug gcig la byams skyong sbrang char rtag 'bebs pa'i//sngar med zla ba'i bsil ba 'di ni sgrol ma'i bdud rtsi 'thung dang mnyam//

gnyen 'phrad kyi tshor ba/da༅༄/ /phyed yol gyi chu tshod gsum pa tsam zhig la blo bzang gzhis ka rtser slebs rjes ṭaka 'khor gyi kha lo pa der sgor lnga bcu tham pa zhig sbrad de thugs rje che zhus/ de nas a zhe bsod nams lha mo dang jo jo karma gnyis kyi snod khang brtsad gcod byas te khang pa'i sgo 'gram du slebs pa dang sgo brdungs pas/ a ne+e bsod nams lha mos sgo phye bzhin du 6‘su yin pas/ khyed rang su la zug dgos yod/’ ces dris/blo bzang gis bsod nams lha mo'i gdong la lta yag cig byas te/ nga'i a zhe 'di yin nam min nam snyam pa'i dogs pa dang bcas slar yang 66bsod nams lha mo lags bzhugs sa 'di red pas ’’zhes dris pas bsod nams lha mos 66bsod nams lha mo nga yin/ khyed rang su yin nam ’ baji+od ma thag tu blo bzang gi mig la mig chu rang dbang med par 'khor bzhin du 6‘a ne+e/ nga blo bzang yin/ rgya gar nas zug 'phrad la yong ba yin/mi’zhes baji+od bzhin du ba〈snad nams lha 31ra 'tham pa dang / bsod nams lha 31 ni gnas skabs zhig yid ma che55 par 'di rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin snyam pa'i blo dogs dang mnyam du lo mang

134 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/snying gi dbus su bcangs pa las thug 'phrad ma byung ba'i rang gi bu de de ring glo bur thog rgyag sgo 'gram du slebs pa 'di dkon mchog gis rdzu 'phrul bstan pa min nam bsam pa'i dga' tshor smra ba1snad kyi yul las 'das pa zhig kyang byung /dus yun gang 'tsham zhig gi ring la phan tshurna gcig gis gcig la 'tham ste skad cha shod pa la yang mid pa 'khril ba lja bu'i tshor snang zhig gi 'og tu gnyis ka ngu gin bsdad de nas bsod nams lha mos ga ler blo bzang gi gdong la zhib tshags lta skyor zhig byas te ‘‘bu khyed rang gzugs po chen po tshar ba ma satogs gdong ris la 'gyur ba de tsam phyin mi 'dug ngas nyin mtshan dus drug tu dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i 'bras bu de de ring smin song / skyabs su mchi/ 7rgyal ba rin wa che'i sku tshe khri lor brtan pa dang bod la skyid pa'i nyi ma mgyogs nas myur du 'char bar shog’’ ces smon lam 'debs/ bzhin blo bzang gi lag pa nas bzung ste khyim nang du 'khrid nge ‘‘karma/zla sgron/we/khyed tsho mgyogs po shog dang /ltos dang 'dir su slebs 'dugami’ ces blo bzang gi jo jo karma dang / karma'i bza' zla zla sgron gnyis skad btang / khong gnyis kyis su slebs yod dam snyam nas yong skabs bsod nams lha mos blo bzang la lta bzhin du 68karma/ 'di su red/ ngo shes kyi mi 'dug gam ’’ zhes dris/ karmas blo bzang gi gdong la lta yag cig byas te ‘6ngas ngo shes ma song / su red/ a ne+e ’rizhes baji+od pa dang bsod nams lha mos ‘ā+o rdzi/da so so'i spun yang ngo shes kyi med pa 'dra/'di blo bzang red/da lta rang rgya gar nas slebs pa red/ri’ ces baji+od ma thag blo bzang gis ‘‘jo jo/’’ zhes

gnyen 'phrad kyi thong ba/ smo35karma la 'tham pa sa khong gnyis ka la sems nang dga' tshor baji+od mi thes pa zhig byung /de nas bsod nams lha mos zla sgron dang blo bzang gnyis phan tshun ngo sprod byas zin mtshams tshang ma rkub kyag gi steng du/ bsnad de zla sgron gyis ja blubs bzhin pa'i ngang la karmas ‘‘blo bzang / khyed rang da dung lo shas shig thug 'phrad yong gi red bsam pa nga tsho su gcig gi blo yul la med/ ga 'dra byas te yong bas/ lam gron thabs shes ga 'dra byas pas// sa mtshams nas dka' ngal 'phrad ma byung ngam ’’zhes sdu ba kha shas ma nyam du sdus/ blo bzang gis ja 'azung bzhin pa'i ngang la thog mar bod la yong rgyu'i 'char gzhi bkod pa nas zla ba sgrol mas lam gron thabs shes byas tshul dang / de nas sa mtshams su slebs pa'i skor/ tshong dpon gyis rogs pa byas tshul bcas gnas tshul tshang ma mgo nas mjug bar du bshad pas khong tsho tshang cha/ hang sangs hon thor dgos pa 'ig byung / de nas karma dang blo bzang gnyis skad cha bshad de snod pa'i ring la bsod nams lha mo dang zla sgron gnyis kyis dgong do'i kha lag dmigs bsal ba zhig bzos te sgug nas bsnad yod pa'i skabs su karma dang zla sgron gnyis kyi phru gu gnyis slob grwa nas nang du 'byor/kams rang gi bu tshe ring dang / bu mo skal bzang gnyis blo bzang la ngo sbrod byed bzhin du 6‘tshe ring lo drug dang skal bzang lo lnga red/ khong tsho gnyis nga tsho'i grong khyer nang gi krung yang slob grwa zer ba der 'gro gi yod red/ririces baji+od par glo bzang gis khong gnyis kyi mgo la byug byug cig byas te/ bal yul nas nyos pa'i

136 mi che'i gro ba mngar skyur/phyi rgyal gyi cog le snyi re rngan par sbrad pas khong gnyis dga' thag chod/gang 'tsham zhig nas zla sgron gyis ‘665 zhe lags/zhal lag gra sgrig yin/da zhus ka ’’ zhes dris par bsod nams lha mos ‘‘red red/ da zhal lag zhus dang /snying rje blo bzang sa thag ring po de 'dra nas yong ba red/ ltogs kyi yod 'gro ’mizhes baji+od de khong tsho tshang ma dgong zas za bar rgya cog nar mo de'i mtha' ru sgor sgor byas te 'dzo+oms/ za ma za bzhin pa'i skabs su blo bzang gis khang pa'i nang gi bkod pa der zhib tshags po'i sgo nas bltas pas sbyiraltang pa'i nang gi dngos chas dang / 'dzin chas gang la bltas kyang mi tshang 'byor ba 'bring tsam zhig yin pa'i rtags mtshan gsal po yod kyang /rtsig ldebs su ma'o tse tung dang /rgya nag gi dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gi 'dra par dbyang yod pa las bod mi'i dud khyim zhig yin pa'i cha nas mchod gshetem lta zhog 7gong sa masnumag gi sku par zhig kyang khang pa'i nang du mjal rgyu med par brten sems pa skyo ba dang blo pham bzhin pa'i ngang du 66a ni lags/ nga 'di 'dra byas te gsang ba'i thog rgya gar nas gnyen 'brad la yong ba 'dis khyed rang tsho la dka' rnyog snon ma de 'dra da bzo gi ma red dam mi’zhes dris/ bsod nams lha mos 66gas byed kyi ma red/ thabs shes yod red/sbyir rgya mi gung khran gyis bod par dogs pa chen po zhe drags byed kyi yod red de/bong bu la nyal stangs bco brgyad yod na/ tshong dpon la slong stangs bcu dgu yod red/ de ring sang bod pa yang grung po chags te rnga brdungs stangs la dpag pa'i 'cham rgyag gi yod red/ sbyir btang grong sde'i khrims la nang du 'grul pa gsar spru su slebs kyang deb skyel 'byor tho rgyag dgos kyi sku da red de/ lha sa lta bu sa khyal

gnyen 'phrad kyi thong ba/ 137gzhan la ltos na 'di gar khrims phran bu yang ba yod red/ khyed rang sems khral ma byed/ kam sbyi sde cus kyi las byed pa song tsang thabs shes zhig yod kyi red/ ma red pas/’’zhes karma la lta bzhin brjod/ karmas ‘'do/ khyed rang sems khral ma byed/ ngas sang nyin las khyangs su byin te khams nas grogs po zhig slebs byungazhes 'byor tho bkod na 'grigs kyi red/gal te mi gzhan gyis khyed rang ga pa nas yin zer skad cha dris na/ khams nas tshong don la yong ba yin zhes lab dgos/ de min rgya gar nas yong ba'i skor su gcig la shod rgyu yod pa ma red/ de 'dra'i dam bsgrags thugs che yod pa ma red de/ chu ma yong sngon la rags dang / rkyen ma yong sngon gyi bzlog thabs kyi dpe red/lha’ces smras/ blo bzang gis ‘‘byas na nga zla ba gcig tsam bsnad na 'grigs kyi red pas ’mizhes dris/kams ‘‘zla ba gcig gis mi tshad par da cha gtan du bsnad na 'grigs kyi ma red dam/ khyed rang dbyin ji yag po shes kyi yod tsang yul 'khor sbro 'cham ba'i sne shan gyi las ka zhig kyang lam seng thob kyi red/ da tshur slebs tshar nas yang bskyar rgya gar la log nas gang byed/ yang 'di gar snod pa la nyen kha med pa'ang ma red/ de ni khyed rang gis phal cher gsal bo shes kyi yod 'atso’ zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘jo lags/ da lta nga 'dzin grwa bcu gcig ma gtogs thon yod pa ma red/ gzhi nas mtho rim slob sbyong byed rgyu bsnad yod/ 'di gar gtan du snod 'dod da chen po 'dug ste/ yin na yang chab srid kyi gnas bab la 'gyur ba gang 'gro sus shes/ rgya mis gzhis lus sngalged mi tsho la yid ches blos 'gel byed

138 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/kyi med dus byes 'byor ba cho la de bas dogs pa che ba spo+od tsang ga dus 'dzin bzung byed min cha mi/ rtogs pa red/ lhag par du nga la slob sbyong mthar 'khyol ba zhig byed rgyu'i go skabs de rgya gar du ma gtogs yod mi ma red/’ ces baji+od/der bsod na mas lha mos snye6bu khyed rang gis da lta lab pa ba'in bod kyi chab srid kyi khor yug la 'gyur ba gang 'gro dngos gnas cha mi 'tshal ba tan tan red/ 'di gar gtan du snod rgyu ga nas yong / ngas thog mar khyed rang rgya gar la gtong dagle+os pa'i rgyu mtshan yang slob sbyong yag po zhig byas te 7gong sa/ mchog la dbu 'og dpyang 'degs dang / bod gzhung gi zhabs zhu byed mkhan zhig byung na bsam pa'i re ba byas te btang ba yin/ byas tsang gnas skabs zla ba gcig gnyis 'di gar ngal gso byas te lhod lhod sdod/ mi lo mang po de tsam zug 'phrad ma byung tsang da cha 'di gar slebs tshar nas rgya gar la gtong 'dod da mi 'dug ste/ gtam gyi dpe ltar/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i la rgya de ja phor chang phor la brgyab na ga nas 'grigs/ rgya che sa nas bshad na rgyal khab gcig dang mi rigs gcig gi don dang / de bzhin sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du bod mi sa ya mang pos rang gi gces pa'i srog blos gtong thub sa la nga tshos phan tshun bral nyen gyi dka' sdug phran tshegs bzod mi zub pa ga nas yong / chung sa nas bshad rna khyed rang gi mi tshe'i mdun lam de rgya gar la log na bzang gi red/ 'dir ga re yod red/ nga tsho bod du snod mkhan gyi bod mi tsho'i mi tshe 'di khra tshang 'og gi byi'u tshang dang / spyang tshang 'os gi lug khyu ltar tsher ma'i steng du bsnad pa las kyang dka' ngal che ba yod/ phyag mchod 'bul byed sa'i

gnyen 'phrad kyi thong ba/ 139sku rten yang nang du sgrig gshom mi ②ོ ga pa'i btsan bka' btang yod/ dper na/ nga tsho'i nang mi tsho'i mchod gzhom nge da cha rang rang gi sems kyi nang du sgrig gshom byas pa las phyi la mngon rgyu yod pa ma red/’’ ces mig lu 'khor bzhin du smras/skabs nger phru gu chung ba gnyis ma gtogs de min khong cho tshang ma'i mig mig chus khengs te gnas skabs thung ngu zhig gi ring la tshang ma ngag bcad du gnas pa bzhin bsnad/gang 'tsham zhig nas bsod nams lha mos 68karma/ sang nyin 55 zhe tshogs 'du la 'gro dgos kyi med/ khyed rang yang zhogs pa blo bzang gi 'byor tho bkod zin pa dang las khungs nas nyin shas dgongaris pa zhus te shog zla sgron khyed rang yang sang nyin tshong khang sgo rgyab ste nga tsho tshang ma lhod lhod byas te bsngad na ma red pas lha zhes zla sgron gyi phyogs la bltas te smras pas de'i lan du zla sgron gyis za ma za bzhin pa'i ngang du ‘‘lags red/ a zhe lags/ sang nyin nga zhogs pa 'khyug tsam zhig tshong khang la phyin te khyim mtshes kyi tshong bcol ma brin pa de tsho phyir slog byed dgos yod/ phal cher chu tshod gcig lhag 'gor dogs kha po ma red/ de nas lam seng nang du log yong gi yin/ 'grigs kyi red pa a zhe lags/’ zhes dris/ kams ‘6tag tag red/ ngas yang blo bzang 'byor tho bkod zin pa dang dgongs pa zhus te log yong gi yin/’’zhes baji+od/dgong dro'i zhal lag grub pa dang karmas ‘‘yag blo bzang / da nga tshor khyed rang gi

140 mi che'i blo ba mngar skyur/slob grwa'i gnas tshul dang / spyir btang rgya gar nang du yod pa'i bod mi tsho'i gnas stangs skor la gcig shod dang /’’zhes 'bod skul byas blos blo bzang gis rang nyid thog mar bal yul nas bzung ste ka sbug dang / de rjes ma su ri slob grwar ji ltar slebs pa'i skor dang / de bzhin 7rgyal garin bo che'i bla na med pa'i dbu khrid kyi 'og tu btsan byol bod gzhung dang /tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs khag bod mi byings kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so sogs ji yod rang gis gang shes pa rnams sbas gsang med par khong tshor bshad/ lhag par du 7rgyal ba rin po ches bod bstan pa chab srid kyi thog la sku ngal ji ltar bskyon gnang gi yod pa'i gnas tshul thos pa dang bsod nams lha mor rang dbang med par mig chu sgor/ blo bzang gis rgya gar nang gi gnas tshul dus yun ring po'i bar du bshad par brten mtshan gyi chu tshod bcu gnyis ga 'dra byas te zin pa'ang ma tshor/ bsku da nams lha mos blo bzang gi mal chas bzo ba'i skabs su rgya mi'i kam pā li gsar pa zhig bton te g.yog grabs byed skabs blo bzang gis ‘‘a rne lags/ nga rgya nag nas bzos pa'i dngos chas la phyir ldog byed mkhan zhig yin/ byas tsang rgya mi'i ca lag bed spyod gtong gi med/ dgongs snumi ma gnang rogs/’’zhes smras/ der bsod nams lha mos 66ngas khyed rang gi sems tshor de shes song / nga dga' po byung / byas na 'di gyon na 'grigs kyi red mirices bod mis 'thag pa'i lwa ba rnying pa gnyis sgam gyi nang nas bton te blo bzang la g.yogs/sang zhogs der blo bzang gis zhogs ja btung tshar ba dang nang du a zhe lags khong

gnyen 'phrad kyi 'ong ba/ 14sprorang gnyis ma gtogs med par shes te/ 66a ne+e lags/ da khyed rang tsho'i gnas stangs skor la gcig gsungs gnang dang / nga phyin tshar ba'i rjes la'ang a zhe lags khyed tsho sdug po zhe drags myangs ma song ngam/’’zhes dris/ bsod nams lha mos dbugs ring zhig 'then te ‘6bu/ a ne+e snyan/ lo rgyus ring po red/ mi tshe gcig gi nang du thi gson thengs 'ga' zhas byas pa'i lo rgyus cha tshang zhod dgos byung na phal cher rdzogs mtha' med pa shod rgyu yod red de/ mdor bsdus te bshad na/khyed rang rgya gar la phyin tshar ba'i lo gcig gi rjes su rig gnas gsar brje zer ba'i rlung 'tshub kyi shugs de phran bu chung du phyin pa lta bu zhig byung ste/ rgya mis bod phrug gzhon skyes 'ga' zhig drag 'dems byas te rgya skad sbyong rgyu dang sbrags las byed slob sbyong gi ched du rgya nag la 'khrid pa red/ de'i gras la kam yang kho rang 'gro 'alhasnad chen po byas par brten gtong 'dod med bzhin du btang ba yin/ lo bzhi be cin du las byed slob sbyong byas te slob sbyong mthar 'khye la ma thag thog mar lha sar las bsko byas pas der lo gnyis bsnad pa red/ lha sar snod ring la zla sgron kha zug 'dugade nas gzhis ka rtser gnas sgor byas te da cha lo gsum 'gro grabs byed kyi yod/ karma pe cin la phyin te zla ba drug song ba'i rjes su kung hre'am yang na sbyi thab kyi lam lugs de med par bzos te/ de snga so sor bdag pa'i khang khyim dang zhing kha sogs mi grangs la dpags pa'i phyir slog byas pa red/mi’ces smras te blo bzang gi dkar yol gyi nang du ja blugs/ rang nyid kyi lag tu btags pa'i chu tshod der lta tsam zhig byas te slar yang mu mthud de/ ‘‘de dang dus mtshungs pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi thob thang jiri+o da skor gyi sdul bsgrags dang bcas te dgong re bajirna

142 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/chab srid slob gso zer ba der 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i tshogs 'du'i nang du gal te skad cha ma bzhad par bsnad na/ rgya mis da lta'ang sbyi tshogs rnying pa'i lta ba dang goms gshis bsnad 'duge ces dogs pa dang bsnyad bsko byed kyi yod tsang / ske bas re skabs re tshoge/sa/ 'du'i dkyil la skad cha bshad pa yi/na/ de 'dra la brten nas gezhis rtse bod pa'i bud med kyi 'thus mi zhes ming zhig btags te gla phogs brgyab nas bzhag pa red/ de nas bzung ste da lta bar du khyi la seng ge'i miri btags pa snar sbyi bde cus kyi las khungs kyi nang du las byed yin pa'i khyal red/a ne+es khu/tshugs byas te rgya skad dang rgya yig thar thor zhig dang / bod yig khyangs 'khyol tsam zhig kyang sbyangs pa yin/ ’zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis 66byas na deng sang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi dka' ngal de yod pa ma red dam ’ zhes dris/ bsod nams lha pos ‘‘dri ba der lan tag tag rgyag rgyu khag po red/ kha yam yam nas bltas pa yin na rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi ltogs zhi rgyab pa'i sems khral dang / rgya mis ming 'the gas sna tshogs kyi 'og nas lus la bkol spyod dang /mnar gcod/gsod brdung gi sdug bsngal lta bu myong dastos kyi yod pa ma red la/ de bzhin so d+dho/sa 'jon na dpal 'byor gyi thog la'ang sems khral de tsam med pa red de/ nga rang the ba'i bod mi yod do cog gi sems la bde skyid rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ gcig nas rgya mi gung khran gyi lam lugs de chos dug tu 'dzin pa'i lam lugs zhig yin pa'i steng du bod don thog la 'dzin pa'i srid byus de mkhregs bzung gi srid byus thig red/ rgya mi kho rang tsho'i khe phan la bsam blo gtong ba ma gtogs bod mi snu'i bde skyid la bsam blo rtsa ba nas gtong gi ma red/

gnyen 'phrad kyi lho'i ba/ 143dbe cha bzhag na༈ deng sang bod mi tsho'i nang la 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku par nyar chog gi yod pa ma red/ slob grwa'i nang du bod yig slob kyi yod pa ma red/ rgya skad dang rgya yig ma shes na bod yig gcig pu shes mkhan la la sa ka sbrod kyi yod pa ma red/mdor na bod mi tshor chos dad rang dbang dang /smra baji+od kyi rang dbang /tshogs 'dzo+oms kyi rang dbang sogs gzhi rtsa'i 'gro ba mi'i thob thang zer ba de rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ rgyu mtshan 'di 'dra la brten nas bod mi tshang mar sems kyi bde ba rtsa ba nas yong ma red/ da yin na yang dbang cha mi'i lag tu shor ba song tsang khog par me 'bar yang / du ba kha nas ma thon par byas te tshang mas sgyid po yod mdog mdog gi rnam 'gyur zhig ma bstan rang bstan red/ de ltar ma byas na rang gi srog la zug pa red/’’ces baji+od/de nas blo bzang gis blo pham pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te ‘‘a zhe lags/ nga'i pa lags dang a ma lags gnyis kyang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su 'das grongs gyur pa red pa ’’zhes baji+od par a ne+es ‘6khyed rang gnyis kyi pa lags dang a ma lags gnyis rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su lo na rgas te 'das grongs gyur pa ma red da/ rgya mis bsad pa red/ de tsho ma brjed pa byed dgos red/shes song ngam/ ’zhes phran bu khong khro ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas smras/ blo bzang gis ‘‘a ne+e lags/ khong gnyis ga re byas te bsad nga/ red/mi ces dris/ bsku da nams lha mos mdun gyi cog tse'i steng na yod pa'i ja dam de yar blangs te blo bzang dang rang nyed la ja dkar yol gang re blugs te ‘6de snga bod līdus 'gyur

spro44 mi che'i blo ba mngar skyur/ma byung gong la nga rang tsho'i mi tshang de gzhis ka rtse'i nang du phyug po zhe po da ma red de/'tsho ba 'dang nges yod pa'i mi tshang zhig red/khyed rang gnyis kyi pa pha'i ming la mi 'gyur dang a ma'i ming la sgrol ma zer gyi yod/ pa lags gzhis rtse bkris sgang dgon pa'i bla ma thar 'dod rin po che'i phyag mjo+od red/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su bcings grol dang bcos sgyur btang ba yin zhes ming snyan po zhig btags te/ nga tsho'i h+phong pa'i sa zhing dang / sgo phyugs sems can/ khang pa/ tha na khyim bya yan chad rgya mis gzhung bzhes rgyab ste nga tsho tshang ma nyi ma gcig la dbul phongs bzos pa ma zad mi mang mnyam las zer ba'i ming zhig gi thog nas pa lags dang / a ma lags gnyis la de snga mi tshe la byed chu nga med pa'i zhing las dang / sa las/rdo las sogs bong bu ltar bskul pa red/ de 'dra'i skabs zhig la dmar srung dmag zer ba'i bstan dgra de tshos dgon pa tshang ma'i lha sku rten gsum gtor bathig byed mgo tshugs pa ma zad/ chos byed dge 'dun gyi sde la dmigs bsal snang zug byas pa red/’’ces dang / de nas rang nyid kyi skro'i dpyang lhas der lag pas bzung ste phur phur byed bzhin du mu mazud de/‘6nyin gcig khong tshos thar 'dod rin po che la 7gong sa mchog la mtshan dmas zhu dgos pa'i skul 'ded ji tsam byas kyang rin po ches nga thi ba'i srog la thug kyang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar skur 'debs dang mtshan dmas zhu gi min gsungs par brten/ mi mang gis 'thab 'dzing thengs mang po myong dgos byung ba ma zad mtha' ma der btson khang la bcug song / de rjes su rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi kha shas kyis khyed rang

gnyen 'phrad kyi thong ba/ 145gnyis kyi pa lags thar 'dod rin po che'i phyag mdzod byas pa song tsang log sbyod pa red ces zhwa mo nag po g.yogs/ pa red/ 'thab 'dzing thengs lnga btang song /'thab 'dzing sgyi skabs su jo lags la 7rgyal ba rin po che dang thar 'dod rin po che gnyis la mtshan dmas zhu dgos pa dang / rang nyid mnga' bdag gral rim pa yin pa'i ngos len byed dgos zhes lab pa red/ jo lags kyis nga mnga' bdag gral rim pa min pa la yin zer gyi min la/ lhag par du rang gi 'di dang phyi ma'i skyabs gnas bcol sa'i bla ma la mtshan dmas rtsa ba nas zhu gi min zhes bshad tsang 'thab 'dzing de tsho'i skabs su nyes dung ba.ing drags pa'i rkyen gyis mi min ro min gcig bzos te btson 'jug byas song / jo lags lo sum cu so gnyis ma gtogs ma red de btson khang gi nang du thug 'phrad byed skabs nad gcong lo brgya bcu song ba'i rgan 'khog zhig las kyang skyo ba chags 'dug btson khang gi nang du'ang nyes dung tshod med btang pa'i gnas tshul go thos byung / btson khang du zla ba gsum bzhugs pa'i rjes su nyin gcig rgya mi'i nyen rtog pa gnyis yong ste khyed rang tsho'i btson pa de zhi tshar 'dug phyang po rtsis len par shog ces brda lan bskyal bar slebs song / gnas tshul de go ma thag khyed rang gi a ma dran pa 'thor te de ga rang du brgyal song / ngas lam seng chu rkang rtse gang thabs shes byas te a ma'i gdong la gtor bas gang 'tsham nas dran pa gsos pa byung song / nam rgyun khyed rang gi a ma de jo lags la gus brtsi dang brtse ba ha cang gi chen po yod tsang jo lags la 'thab 'dzing gtong rgyu 'go tshugs nas bzung a mas kha lag za gi yang mi 'dug la/de dus za rgyu yang dkon po red/byas tsang a ma gzugs po gcong po

sdu46 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/chags song / ngas chu gtor te dran pa gsos pa dang / ngu gi yang mi 'dug la skad cha yang chig gcig shod kyi mi 'dug a ma nga gnyis nang du slebs pa dang a mas karma dang khyed rang gnyis kyi lag pa nas 'jus te nga'i lag pa'i steng du bzhag ste/nga la mig gcer re bltas te yud tsam zhig bsdad rjes skad cha chig gcig ma bzhad par phyi la phyin song /de dus karma lo dgu dang khyed rang lo gnyis lon pa zhig yod red/ de nas bzung ste a ma mthong yod pa ma red/ mi tho'i zer yag la a mas gtsang chu la lcebs te rang zhi rgyab pa red ces zer gyi 'dug bden pa red/gang ltar jo lags grongs pa'i sems sdug de bzod ma thub par rang zhi rgyag dgos byung ba red/skabs de dus de 'dra'i rang thi rgyag mkhan bod mi stong phrag mang po byung yod pa red/’’ces mig la mig chu 'khor ba dang skad gdangs kyang cung zad mid pa 'khril ba'i sgro gdangs su gyur bzhin mu mazud de/‘6sang nyin der ngas khyed rang karma la bcol te jo lags kyi phung po rtsis len du phyin pa yin/ de dus nga rang yang lo bco brgyad lon tsam zhig red/ phru gu'i snang ba ma gtogs yod pa ma red de/ dus tshod kyi 'pho 'gyur dbang gis khyed rang gnyis kyi a ma'i tshab byed dgos dus nyin gcig la 'gyur ba phyin pa red/ sems pa skyo shos thig la jo lags kyi sku phung zhugs 'bul byed dus nga rang gcig pu ma gtogs med/ ngo shes pa dang / dga' nye blo dkar/ grong pa khyim mtshes su gcig gis de dus rogs pa byas ma byung / btson khang nas sku phung de mi thegs bzhin du rgyab la 'khyer te dgon pa'i rgyab kyi ri ldebs zhig la bzhag pa yin/ de nas nang

gnyen 'phrad kyi thong ba/ spro47du bud zhing phran bu yod pa de dbor 'dren thengs lnga byas te thing de tsho brtsigs/ zhing brtsigs pa'i steng du sku phung de bzhag ma zub pa'i dka' ngal chen po 'phrad byung /mi tshang mas rgyang ring nas ltad mo bltas nas snod pa las su gcig gis tha na rogs pa dgos pas kyang lab ma byung / mtha' mjug der u tshugs byas te sku phung zhing gi steng du bzhag thub tsam zhig byung / de nas zhugs me sgron te 'tshig 'tshig bar du der ma ṇi bgrangs/ mig chu btang ste bsnad pa yin/’’zhes baji+od de mig chu btang bas blo bzang gis a ne+e'i mig chu phyis bzhin du 66a ne+e/ de dus sus kyang rogs pa mi byed pa de 'dra dpe srid kyi ma red/ mi snu'i snying tshang ma rdo la gyur pa yin nam ’’zhes brjod/ bsod nams lha mos rang nyid kyi mig chu 'phyis bzhin du 6‘bu/ de dus khong tsho la'ang khag yod pa ma red/ gal te mi gcig gis nga la rogs pa byas yod na de la mnga' bdag gral rim gyi g.ya' 'dug ces lam seng 'thab 'dzing btang yod kyi red/ tshang ma rang gi srog la gces pa yin ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ /ོda ba/sam blo gtong skabs su la'ang khag mi 'dug bsam pa dran gyi 'dug’’bsod nams lha mos de ltar bshad zin pa dang zla sgron gyis thing tog dang / sngo tshal sogs sle chung gang khrom nas nyos te nang du slebs pas a ne+e dang blo bzang gnyis ka'i mig mig chus khengs te yod pa mthong ba dang / a ne+es blo bzang gi pha ma gnyis kyis dka' sdug myang tshul gyi lo rgyus de bzhad pa thag chod snyam pa zhig byung / de nas a ne+e dang zla sgron gnyis kyis nyin gung gi kha lag bzo rgyu 'go btsug

spro48 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/pa dang dus mnyam du karma yang nang du slebs/ karmas ‘‘blo bzang 'byor tho rgyab zin pa yin/yin na yang spyang grung 'dzoms po byed dgos/deng sang rgya mis rgya gar nas yong mkhan tsho la dogs pa che ru zhe drags phyin 'dug nye char rgya gar nas gnyen 'phrad la yong mkhan gyi mi gcig gi lag nas 7gong sa mchos gi sku par dang bka' slob kyi deb thon pa red ces 'dzin bzung byas te dri brtsad byed mus red/byas tsang blo bzang khyed rang phyi la 'gro mi dgos na mi dgos pa gtso don byas na/’’zhes brjod/blo bzang gis ‘6jo jo/snang dag mi dgos/ngas sbi gsang thon po byas chogaji’ces baji+od bzhin du rgya gar nas 'khyer yong ba'i 7gong sa mchog gi sku par dang / byin rten/ ma ṇi ril bu/ gnas chung gi phyag nas/ de ba'in nang mi re la dug log sna re bcas lag rtags 'khyer yod pa rnams so sor spud pas khong tsho tshang mas 7gong sa mchog sge sku par mjal ma thag tu rang rang gi sbyi gtsug tu bzhag ste dad pa'i spu long rgyas bzhin pa'i ngang nas mig chu btang /de nas a zhes sku par dang byin rten sogs tshang ma bsdus te khyim gyi rtse thog gi rtsig gseng zhig tu sbas te bzhag/de ltar blo bzang la rang nyid kyi a ne+e dang jo jo/ jo jo'i mna' ma dang phru gu bcas tshang ma thug 'phrad byed rgyu'i go skabs thob pa der dga' mgu yi rangs pa'i sgo nas skabs re g.yas g.yon gyi dgon pa khag la gnas mjal du 'gro ba dang /skabs re khrom bskor byed pa/ skabs re nang mi dang lhan du gling gar 'gro ba/skabs re rgya mis bod kyi khor yug la gtor skyon dang / bod mi tshor mnar gcod

gnyen 'phrad kyi snung ba/ spro49ji btang / nang chos kyis gtsos pa'i rig gzhung gi lte gnas khang gang dang gang smu gtor bzhig btang yod pa rnams la nyams zhib byas te rdo la ri mo bkod pa ltar sems kyi nang du phra lam mer gsal bar bzos/ dang thog gnas tshul 'di rigs tshang ma deb kyi nang du 'bri dgos bsams kyang rlung rta ma rgyugs par gal te yig cha de rigs rgya mi'i lag par thebs na mi 'grigs par shes te gnas tshul de dag sting dbus su bris/ de 'dra'i ngang nas dus yun zla ba gcig ni rmi lam lta bur rdzogs/blo bzang gzhis ka rtser zla ba gcig dang phyed rka bsnad pa'i rjes su de sngon rang nyid yong sa'i ṭaka 'khor gyi kha lo pa de ga rang gi mnyam du gnas bskor gyi ched du lha sar bskyod de ngo shes zhig gi nang du nyi ma lnga bsnad/ lha sar snod yun gyi ring la rtse pho brang dang / gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum/ de bzhin nor bu gling sa dang / jo bo rnam pa gnyis bcas 'a/ mchod mjal du bskyod/gnas mjal byed pa dang mnyam du blo bzang gis lha sa dang / de'i g.yas g.yon gyi sa gnas khag 'ga' zhig de bzhin gzhis rtse nas lha sa bar gyi lung pa'i khor yug dang / bod nang rgya mi'i mi 'bor 'phel rgyas kyi 'gyur ba/ bod mi tsho'i 'tsho ba dang / shes yon gyi gnas tshad/gzhan yang rgyal sa lha sa'i nang gi chang khang dang / za khang / gzhang khang / mtshan tshogs khang sogs mthong rjes sngon chos rgyal dang lo paṇa bkrin can rnams kyis dka' ba brgya phrag khyad du bsad de mi lo nyis stong lhag gi ring la bskyangs pa'i bod kha ba can gyi yul de gung khran kla klo'i rlung 'tshub ngan pa des lo ngo bcu sdog

spro50 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/bzhi lhag tsam gyi ring la thal ba'i dul du brlag ste/lta na sdug pa'i yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang / satsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i khor yug nang don rig pas gtsos pa'i rig gnas sbyi dang bye bras gi 'dzin skyong sbel gsum/ gzhan yang bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i legs byang dang / skad yig rig gnas sogs yongs rdzogs ming gi lhag ma tsam du byas yod pa shes par skyo ba gastang nas skyes te/ da nas bzung ngas rang gi rgyal khab dang /mi rigs/rig gzhung dang bcas pa nyams pa slar gso dang mi nyams gong 'phel byed pa'i don du snying la rus pa bcug ste/ slob sbyong byed ang bsam pa'i dam bca' gsar pa zhig jo bo'i sku brnyan gyi mdun du byas/ de nas gzhis ka rtser log ste bdun phrag gcig bsnad rjes lha rtse'i tshong dpon dang lhan du slar yang ne+e pā li'i do skyel ba yin khyal gyi chas su brdzus te tshong dpon gyi rogs skyor la brten te bal yul du slebs/ kāṣ+ṭha maṇa ḍūr nyin gsum bsdad rjes tshong dpon la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che lan mang zhus te rgya gar du chas/blo bzang rgya gar dang bal yul gyi sa mtshams so no li zhes pa der slebs pa dang /thog mar bal po'i sa mtshams nyen rtog skor srung bas rgya gar du 'gro bskyod chog pa'i thongs mchan lag khyer med pa dang / gyon chas sogs dngos chas sna mang 'khyer yod pa sogs la bsnyad de chu tshod gnyis bkag nyar byas pa ma zad mtha' mjug rgya gar gyi sgor mo lnga brgya sbrad pas de nas btang tsam byung / de nas slar yang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams nyen rtog pas za bsnyad byas pas ji phyi bsnoms pa'i hin sgor drug brgya lnga bcu'i skog rngan sbrad de go rākha bur du slebs zub/ go rākha

ske/zug 'u/na ཿོ/ོba ba/ nathag ngakathagangari brothag/ kro61'gyur med kyis skal ldan thuge pa dang lam seng ‘6kye/ de ring khyed rang sngar rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur skyid mdog kha po zhig bstan gyi 'dug ga re byas song /nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'dra rnyed pa ma red dam/’’zhes dris/skal ldan gyis ‘6kye/ de ring nga la ma ni o ḍar zhig slebs song / bkris kyis ka sbug nas sgor brgya dang lnga bcu btang 'dug ’’ces lan btab/ 'gyur med kyis ‘‘grogs po zer na de 'dra dgos pa red/dpe mi srid yag po red/de ring sang bkris ga re byed kyi sku da 'gro ’’zhes dris/ skal ldan gyis ‘‘bkris kho rang gi za khang dang thug pa bzo grwa la las ka byed kyi yod kyi red/ kho phyin pa nas bzung nga la yi ge slebs ma byung /yin na yang da ring sbrags brgyud du nga la dngul btang ba 'di phan po byung /da nga dmag sgar la 'gro rgyu'i lam gron yang rag song / zhes baji+od/ skal lngan gyi skad cha der 'gyur med phran bu ya mtshan skyes te ‘‘ga re/ dmag sgar la 'gro rgyu'i lam gron zer dus khyed rang dngos gnas dmag mir 'gro rtsis yod dam/ nga yid ches kyi mi 'dug’’ces baji+od/ der skal ldan gyis ‘0(nga / dngos gnas 'gro yag yin/khyed rang yang nga dang mnyam du 'gro na 'gro ’ zhes smras/'gyur med kyis 6‘byas na kha seng mi 'gyur gyi 'khris la ’’zhes skad cha mjug ma rdzogs sngon la skal lngan gyis ‘‘de da ngas yin mdog mdog gi skad cha bshad pa yin/ dbyin ji'i po li ṭikas 41 zer gyi mi 'dug gam/ bod skad la byas na 'di la srid don gyi skad cha lab pa red/ khyi ra 'jon rgyu med par lung chung skad kyis brgyangs na cho yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang gros mi la dris thag rang gis gcod dgos pa red/’rices po// ji01ཿ 05

spro62 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/baji+od/ 'gyur med kyis phar lta tshur lta zhig byas rjes skad shugs chung du btang ste ‘‘byas rna 'grigs ga nga yang khyed rang gi mnyam du 'gro gi yin/ ga dus 'gro ga mizhes dris/ der skal ji na gyis ‘ gtam gyi dbe la/ don chen bsgrab par ngang ring dgos zer ba ltar/ tsha ge tshi ge ma byed dang / mi tsho dwogs / za rogs red/ngas 'char gezhi tshang ma snga mo nas btang tshar ba yin/ do nub dgong dro rang sbyong grol tshar ba dang thab tshang gi thing brtsisas sa de'i 'khris la shog dang / ngas 'char gzhi tshang ma khyed rang la lab chog yin na yang / skad cha 'di nga rang gnyis kyi dbar la ma gtogs bya byi'u la bshad na'ang 'grigs kyi ma red da/ shes song ngam/’’zhes 'gyur med kyi gdong par masbyob mo btsugs te smras/ 'gyur med kyis kyang der mos mthun yod pa'i rnam 'gyur mgo bo gug gug thengs 'ga' byas te/‘6yong nga / yong nga / sems khral byed mi dgos/ byas na rang sbyong grol ma thag tu yin da/’ zhes smras te khong gnyis rang rang so so'i gnas su phyin/de zhub dgong dro'i rang sbyong glol ba dang 'gyur med lam seng slob grwa'i thab tshang 'gram gyi thing phung brtsigs yod sa de'i sar phyin te sgugs te bsnad/ dus yun skar ma bco lnga tsam phyin kyang skal lngan mthong rgyu med pas 'gyur med kyi bsam par skal lngan gyis phal cher mgo bskor btang ba 'dra snyam ste nyal khang du log grabs byed pa'i skabs zhig la skal ldan der slebs/ 'gyur med kyis ‘6kye/ 'di 'dra'i yun ring po ga re byas te 'gor song /’’zhes sdus/ skal lngan gyis ‘6nga khyed rang gi sngon la 'di gar slebs te bsnad yod/ ngas khyed rang ngang rgyun ring los

skal ldan 11ba grwa nas gsang bros/ spro63'dug tshod lta byas pa yin/’mizhes sprus/'gyur med kyis 66po/byed rang grogs po tshang ma la blos mi 'khel bar 'di 'dra'i tshod lta byed dgos pa gang yin nam/ri zhes phran bu rlung langs te baji+od par/ skal lngan gyis ‘‘de ring sang das tshod kho rang 'di 'dra red/ brtag dpād nan tan ma byas par lam seng mi zhwa blos 'gel byed rgyu yod pa ma red/lar nas gnas tshul 'di lta bu gal chen po dang nyen kha can zhig kyang yin sngabs gzab gzab byed dgos rgyu gal chen red/’’ ces brjod/'gyur med kyis ‘6da leka car btang nas ma bsnad bar 'char gzhi de lob dang / zhes baji+od/ skal ldan gyis ha ha zhes khrel dgod shor bzhin du ‘‘kye/ nga gnyis kyis rgya nag gi gzhung tshab la 'bar rdzas g.yugs nas gtor rgyu'i 'char gzhi rgya chen po de 'dra 'ding gi yod pa ma red da/slob grwa nas bros 'a〈sna rgyur 'char gzhi rgya chen po dang gting zab po de 'dra dgos pa ma red/ rjes ma bdun brag si gza' spen pa'i nyin der 'gro chas rgyobs/sgam la sogs pa'i ca lag mang po 'khyer yag yod ma red/ dug log brje len kha shas thig dpyang phad kyi nang du blugs/ de nas dngul ga tshod yod pa tshang ma 'khyer shogade min gang yang dgos pa ma red/ gza' spen pa'i zhogs pa nga rang gnyis ka khrom la deb chas nyo bar 'gro gi yin zhes dbo ngas ba zhu dgos/ khrom la slebs pa dang lam seng snum 'khor 'bab tshugs su phyin te am bha la la 'gro mkhan gyi yo ṭa de'i nang la 'asbyol rgyu red/ de min 'char gzhi dgos pa ma red/ shes song ngam/’ zhes baji+od/ 'gyur med kyis ‘6de 'dra nyin gung mo ṭa'i nang du 'dzul te sa/la te dge rgan dang slob phrug gzhan pa tshos mthong gi ma red dam/’ zhes sdus/ skal ldan gyis ‘6las gang 'dra zhig byas kyang

164 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/nyen kha med pa gcig kyang yod pa ma red/ nyen kha chung du gtong rgyu'i thabs shes gtso bo de blo khog red/ byas tsang blo khog dgos pa red/ shes song ngam/ da skad cha mang po yod pa ma red/ khyed rang gza' spen pa'i nyin de thon chog chog gi gra sgrig byos/’’zhes baji+od de 'gyur med de ga rang du bzhag ste phyin/ 'gyur med kyis skal lngan gyi tshod mi thebs pa lta bu'i 'du shes zhig 'khyer te rang nyid kyi nyal khang du log nyi ma drug phyin pa'i dgong dro der skal ldan 'gyur med kyi nyal khang du yong ste/66grogs po sang nyin red da/ gra sgrig byos ma gtogs/ ’zhes pa tsam zhig baji+od de rang nyid kyi nyal khang du phyin/gza' spen pa'i zhogs pa der skal ldan dang 'gyur med gnyis kyis rang rang gi dug log brje len rnams dbung phad re re'i nang du bcug ste/ chos dge sbyin pa lags kyi las shag tu dgongs pa zhu bar bskyod/ las shag gi sgo 'gram du slebs pa dang 'gyur med kyis rang nyid kyi dpung phad de phyi log tu 'jog grabs byed skabs skal ldan gyis 66dpung phad phyi la ma 'jog mnyam du 'khyer shog ’ces baji+od de khong gnyis chos dge sbyin pa lags kyi sku mdun du bcar/ khong gnyis las shag gi sgo nas 'dzul ba dang rgan sbyin pa lags kyis ‘6khyed gnyis ga re yin pas ’zhes skad cha dris/ de'i lan du skal ldan gyis ‘‘rgan lags/ san jo gling la nga'i pa lags kyi ngo shes pa'i 'tshem po ba zhig yod pa red/ nga gnyis da ring khekhere 'gram la dug log lhan pa brgyab yag dang bzo bcos byed yag kha shas yod pa bskyal du 'gro gi yin/ dasongs pa grenang robs gnang /’’zhes dgongs

skal lngan slob grwa nas gsang bros/ 165shog de rgan sbyin pa'i phyag tu phul bar rgan sbyin pas thog mar dgongs shog der bltas/ de nas skal lngan gyi lag tu 'khyer yod pa'i sa skya legs bshad kyi deb de mthong bas ‘6khyed rang sa skya legs bshad klog gi yod pas ’ zhes sdus par/skal lngan gyis rang nyid kyi mgo bo lag pa g.yas pas phur phur byed bzhin du ‘snyelags yod/ yin na'ang mkhregs po 'dug’ ces zhus/ rgan sbyin pas zhal ras 'dzum pa dang bcas te ‘‘ma shes pa tshang ma mkhregs po yod red/yin na yang u tshugs byas te klog dgos red/ ga ler shes 'gro gi red/ yag po red/bod yig gi deb gcig klog gi yod kyang rung med kyang rung lag par thogs pa tsam zhig gi yag po red/’’ces baji+od de dgongs zhog tu sa yig bskyon/khodzeng gnyis rgan lags kyi las shag nas thon te khrom phyogs su 'gro skabs slob rgyag 'ga' shas kyis khrus rgyag gi yod pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis sil pol rtse gi yod pa/ 'ga' shas kyis dug log 'khyu gi yod pa/ 'ga' shas khrom la 'gro gi yod pa sogs mthong /gnyis ka'i sems kyi nang du slob grwa nas 'gro mi 'dod pa'i thang thang zhig dang /yang dge rgan dang slob zug gzhan dag tshos khong gnyis mo ṭa'i nang du 'dzul ba sogs mthong mi yong ngam snyam pa'i zhed snang dang tsha lhang lhang zhig yod bzhin du snum 'khor gyi 'bab tsāgs su slebs/ de nas am bha lar 'gro mkhan gyi snum 'khor de'i nang du 'dzul te phyin/ khong gnyis am bha lar ma slebs bar du sems la dngangs 'tshab chen po byung yang am bha lar slebs rjes lhod bathig lta bya zhig byung /am bha lar kha lag rgyag tshad re zas te sa ha ran byar bar

166 mi che'i gro ba mngar skyur/du me 'khor dang de nas snam 'khor brgyud de caka ra tar slebs/ der slebs pa dang 'gyur med kyis rang nyid kyi jo jo brtsad gcod byas te zug pa dang khong gnyis slob grwa nas bros te dmag mir 'dzul bar yong ba'i skor bshad/jo jos kyang khong gnyis la lam ston dang rogs pa gang yong byas te gnyis ka dmag mir tshud thabs byas pas dka' ngal de tsam med pa'i thog nas nga/mag mi'i sgrig khongs su tshud/shim lā slob grwar gza' spen pa'i dgong dre'i zhal lag gi skabs su slob phrug tsho tshang gsher gartong skabs skal ljan dang 'gyur med gnyis dus thog tu ma slebs par shes te/chos dase sbyin pa lags kyis slob grwa'i rgan bdag 'ga' shas san jo gling gis gtsos pa'i zhim lā'i mtha' bskor g.yas g.yon du 'tshol bar btang yang ma brnyed/ slob phrug 'ga' zhig la sdu brtsad byas skabs da gzod khong gnyis 7slob grwa nas gsang bros byas pa shes te/ gza' zla ba'i zhogs pa lhan tshogs kyi skabs su chos dge sbyin pa lags kyis slob phrug tshor don rkyen de'i skor la bka' slob gnang skabs 66nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ kha nyin gza' spen pa'i nyin mo der skal lngan dang / 'gyur med gnyis slob grwa nas gsang bros byas pa red/ga par phyin yod sped tan tan sgod rgyu med de/ slob phrug gzhan dag tshos/ zer 'gros la bltas na/ phal cher dmag mir phyin pa 'dra/ ngas dmag mir phyin pa de skyon red zer gyi med de/ 'gro stangs de nor ba red/ gal te slob sbyong rtsa ba nas byed 'dod med pa dang mi shes pa de 'dra yin na slob grwa nas dgongs pa zhus te/tshul mazun byas te phyin na 'grigs kyi red/sus kyang bkag 'gog byed kyi ma red/

skal ldan 11ba grwa nas gsang bros/ sgro67da dung 'gro khar kha btags gcig las med kyang gyon te 'gro chog gi red/ de 'dra mi gsod rta 'khyer gyi nag nyes byas pa nang bzhin bros te 'gro dgos pa ma red/khong gnyis kyi bsam par dge rgan la mgo bskor btang ba de 'jon po yin snyam pa zhig yod 'gro ste/ dngos 'brel byas na rang gis rang mgo bskor btang ba red/'di tsho'i gras rang sdun rang la chung ba'i dbe mtshon red/’’ ces gsungs bzhin pa'i ngang du rang nyid kyi sbyan shel de phyag g.yas pas mar phud de gzan gyi sne mo gcig phyag g.yon pas bzung ste gtsang ma bzo bzhin du slar yang mu mthud de/66bod nang du bod phrug khri khrag mang por slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs dang mthun rkyen rgya mis sbrod kyi yod pa ma red/ byas tsang lo ltar re bzhin bod phrug mang pos rang gi gces pa'i srog dang bsdos te hi mā la ya'i ri brgyud brgal nas rgya gar du yong gi yod pa nga tsho tshang mas shes gsal red/ khong tsho gal te slob grwa gcig la 'gro rgyu'i go skabs thob pa'i dbang du btang yang / rgya mis gang bkod khyab byas pa de ma gtogs rang gi skad yig dang rig gzhung sogs rang 'dod ltar sbyong rgyu'i mthun rkyen rtsa ba nas sbrod kyi yod pa ma red/ der ma zad deng sang rgya mis bod du srid byus gsar pa zhig lag bstar byas te slob grwa khag gi nang du bod yig slob khrid byed mi choge pa dang / 7gong sa mchog gi sku par nyar mi chog pa/ dgon pa dang lha khang sogs la ma'od mjal dang gnas mjal du 'gro mi zlongan pa/grwa btsun tshos rang 'dod ltar chos nyams len byed mi chog pa/ mdor na rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub de las kyang ches ngan pa'i srid byus 'ig yod/ de 'dra'i gnas stangs zhig gi 'og tu snod mkhan gyi gzhis lus sbun zla tshos da dung yang slob spyong dze+edon

168 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/gnyer byas te nyin mtshan du mar lto mi 'byor ba dang / 'grul bzhud kyi sa thag ring ba/ rgya mi'i me mda'i kha 'og nas bros dgos pa/ rkang lag gangs 'phyid thebs pa/sa mtshams nas nyen rtog pas 'phrog bcom byed pa sogs kyi dka' ngal grangs las 'das pa yod kyang btsan byol du bslab pa slob gnyer gyi ched yong dang yong bzhin pa red/’’ces dang / de nas phran bu thugs blo pham pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas mu mthud de/ ‘6gnas tshul de las zlog ste nga tsho byes 'byor ba tsho sbyir gnas tshang rgya gar gzhung dmangs dang /yang sgos btsan byol bod gzhung /lhag par du 7gong sa mchog gi bkrin la brten nas mthun rkyen yag nyes la ma ltos par rang dbang lung par rang 'dod ltar gyi slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs bzang po 'di 'dra zhig thob kyang /da dung slob grwa skyid po mi 'dug zer na/kha ham pa che drags pa red/ yang na skyid dras/sa pa red/ rang ngos nas 'gro song zho gang yang gtong mi dgos par zas gos gnas mal gyi mthun rkyen 'dang nges bzhin pa yod pa'i ngang la/ slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs thob bzhin du da dung skyid ma shes na/ sa paṇa gyis gsungs pa'i spu med pa yi phag pa de mi na na gang red/ byas tsang khyed rang tsho tshang mas skyid dus sgyid shes pa dang / gang yod pa de la chog shes pa byed dgos rgyu de gel chen po red/ mdor na/ nga rang tsho btsan byol bod rgyag tsho la yod pa'i mthun rkyen 'di lta bu rgya gar gzhung gis rang nyid kyi chab 'bangs tsho la'ang sbrod zub kyi yod pa ma red/ lhag par du btsan 'os tu yod pa'i gzhis lus spun zla tsho'i gnas stangs de snying dbus su bcangs te go skabs la go skabs yin pa ngos 'dzin pa'i thog nas mdun lam ma 'chol ba byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ de lugs tshang mas

skal ldan 11ba grwa nas gsang 11sa/ sdu69bsam blo gtong dgos/’’ zhes gsungs gnang pas slob phrug mang po zhig gi sems la skul lcag dang skul ded byung bar ma zad/ bod kyi gnas stangs gsungs skabs slob phrug du ma zhig gi mig la rang dbang med par mchi ma 'khor dgos pa zhig kyang byung / rgan lags kyis bka' slob de gnang tshar ba'i rjes su mi 'gyur gyi bsam par gal te rgan lags kyis bka' slob 'di lta bu zhig snga mo nas gnang yod na skal ldan dang 'gyur med gnyis slob grwa nas bros yod mdog kha po ma red/da yin na yang khong gnyis la phyis drag pa yin kyang 'byung 'gyur sngon 'gog la phan thogs chen po byung song snyam pa zhig byung /gzhi rim 'dzin grwa bcu gcig gi rgyugs sbrod grub 'bras rtser son byung bar brten thog ma'i 'char gzhir rang gzhung shes rig las khyangs kyis blo bzang eng leṇaṭa gyi nang gi mtho slob drag gras zhig tu gtong thabs gnang rgyu gnang yang / stabs nyes pa zhig la dgos nges kyi 'grim 'grul yig cha khag dus thog tu bzo ma zub pas thog ma'i 'char gzhi sgrig pa ltar lam lhongs ma byung / des na shes rig las khyangs kyis blo bzang la gal te blo bzang rang ngos nas thabs thes kyis rgya gar nang gi mtho slob legs gras zhig la tshud thub na slor+sha yon la sogs pa'i 'gro gron rnams shes rig las khungs nas gtong gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob/ der brten blo bzang gis thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sbrags byas te bdun phrag 'ga' shas kyi ring la ldi li dang ma su ri gnyis kyi dar+shar la phar 'gro tshur yong thengs bzhi byas pa'i rjes su ldi li'i nang gi mtho slob mtshan snyan che shos sen ṭi/siṭi phen/

170 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/zhes pa'i nang du tshud thub pa byung / mtho slob de'i nang du bod pa'i slob phrug tshud pa'ang thengs dang po de yin/phyi zla drug pa'i zla mjug tu song tsang tsha ba che ba'i skabs zhig la blo bzang ldi lir slebs pas thog mar zla shas kyi ring la slob grwa'i nyal khang du rlung 'khor re yod kyang rlung gi reg pa tsha ba dang / slob grogs rnams kyang 'grug pa dang / 'bras ljongs pa/ gar sha pa dang /khya nu ba bcas rang nyid dang ngo ris 'dra ba thar thor zhig mthong rgyu yod pa las shas che ba rgya gar ba yin pas ma tshad ngo shes pa'ang gcig kyang med pa/ rtsa ba'i slob grwa'i sbyi thab kyi kha lag yag po yod kyang bod zas sna gcig kyang mthong rgyu med pa/ dge rgan dang slob phrug tshos kyang bod pa yin zer dus de tsam gyis brtsi mthong dang cha 'jog mi byed pa zhig tshor bas phran bu sems la 'tsher snang dang ma skyid pa zhig byung / 'on kyang rang gi pha yul gyi gnas stangs dang /a de'i bslab bya/7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob dang dgongs gzhi/ rang nyid kyi ma 'ongs mdun lam/ gzhan yang rgya gar nang du yod pa'i bod phrug gzhan dag tsho'i dka' ngal bcas la bsam blo gtong dus rang nyid ches skyid po dang / go skabs bzang po thob yod pa sogs la bsam zhib byed bzhin pa'i ngang nas slob sbyong la snying rus lhod med byas te bsnad/ gang 'tsham zhig nas shag rogs dang 'dzin grogs rnams dang rim pas 'dris che ru phyin pa dang / 'dzin grwa'i nang nas slob sbyong gi thad la'ang legs gras su tshud zub pa/ de bzhin slob grwa'i khor yug kyang rim pas rgyus lon zub pa byung bas sems pa skyid du dang bag phebs su phyin/

ska'i/ ldan slob grwa nas gsang bros/ 171skabs rer gza' spen pa dang nyi ma/ de bzhin gung gseng sogs kyi skabs su rang gi 'dzin grogs 'ga' shas dang mnyam du man ju ṭi lar bod pa'i gzhis kem yod sar phyin te/zug pa dang mog mog za ba dang /gzhan yang rang rigs ngo shes rnams dang thug 'phrad kyis skabs re bod pa'i chab srid gnas stangs kyi skor la bgro gleng byed pa dang / skabs re bod btsan byol gzhung gi phyag las gnang phyogs kyi skor la dge 'don skyon sel gyi bsam 'char gzhan la shod pa/ skabs re 'dris che ba'i grogs po tsho dang lhan du bu mo su mdzes kyi skor la lab gleng byed pa sogs byas/zla ba gnyis kyi gung seng skabs su rang gi pha yul gcig pa'i dge bshes/ nye char bod nas slebs pa zhig 'bras spungs blo gsal gling du bzhugs yod pa de'i sar phyin te/ dge bshes lags kyi sku mdun nas chos zhu mkhan mgo ser ba kha shas yong gi yod pa de tshor skad sgyur byed pa dang / yang skabs re ma su rir zla ba sgrol ma'i nang du phyin te bod khyim slob phrug tsho la dbyin ji dang ang rtsis slob pa sogs kyang byas te bsnad/blo bzang san siṭi phen mtho slob tu slebs te lo gnyis dang phyed tsam phyin pa'i rjes su nyin gcig rang nyid kyi nyal khang gi nang du deb cig klog te bsnad yod pa'i skabs zhig la shag rogs prem ku mār yong ste/ ‘6blo bzang /tu me/mil ne+e/ko yi/a ya he/’’(khyed rang la zug 'phrad byed mkhan zhig slebs 'dug)ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘hang / kya mu je/ mil ne+e/ kon ho saka ta he/’’(ga re/ nga la zug mkhan e/su yin srid kyi red/)ces dris/

172 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/prem ku swār gyis ‘8ko yi/lar ki he/zla ba/ṭ+wāṃm ba tā/ra hi he/apa ki/me byu ba/ho saka tā/ he/ or kon ho gā/’’(bu mo zhig 'dug ming la zla ba yin zer gyi 'dugakhyed rang gi dga' rogs yin 'gro/ de min su yong /)zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis ha ha zhes gad mo dgod pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan lan gang yang ma 'jal bar nyal khang gi phyi la lta bar phyin/ nyal khang gi rgyal sgo'i 'gram du zla ba sgrol ma bu mo gzhan zhig dang mnyam du sgug bsngad yod pa mthong ba dang blo bzang sems pa dga' thing byas pa dang lhan du der rgyugs te/ 6‘yag zla ba sgrol ma/ ga dus slebs pas/ de 'dra gnyid lam nang bzhin ga 'dra red/ ces baji+od bzhin du po la lag pa btang / de nas bu po rogs pa der yang bkris bde legs zhus/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘nga tsho gnyis can lha gar nas da lta rang slebs pa yin/ 'u rdzi/ g.yang 'dzoms ngo shes kyi mi 'dug gam/ nga rang tsho ka sbug gi 'dzin 〈snags/nya’zhes thog mar blo bzang dang de nas g.yang 'dzoms phyogs la lta bzhin baji+od/ blo bzang gis g.yang 'dzoms la lta skyor zhig byas te/‘6a las/da dran pa gsos song /khyed rang 'di 'dra'i rgyug pa chags na ngas ngo ga 'dra byas te shes thub kyi red/’ri ces baji+od/der g.yang 'dzoms kyis bzhin 'asbyom pa dang lhan du ‘‘da kring yog mang po zas/lnga li mang po 'thung pa'i bkrin red/ yin na yang tsha ba 'di'i nang la ki lo bco lnga tsam bzhu tshar ba yod/’’ces baji+od par khong tsho gsum ga gad mo shor/de nas blo bzang gis g.yas g.yon la lta skyor zhig byas pas khong gnyis kas ko bas bzos pa'i lag phad nag po re 'khyer yod pa dang / zla ba sgrol ma'i lag tu

shā/bzhu 'u/na ཿོ/ོba ba/ nathag ba/thagachog broza// 173'gyig shog gi 'thum bu zhig las de min dngos chas gang yang med pa tshor te/‘6khyed gnyis la ca lag gzhan pa 'khyer yag med pas ’’zhes sdus/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘6nga gnyis slebs pa dang man ju ṭi lar phyin te ca lag de tsho maglon khang zhig gi nang la bzhag yod/ khrus brgyab zin pa dang lam seng khyed rang zug 'phrad du yong ba yin/’’zhes smras/ der g.yang 'dzoms kyis ku re dang sbrags te zla ba sgrol mar lta bzhin du ‘‘'ong / mos khyed rang ma thug sngon la kha lag kyang za gi min zer gyi 'dug be+e rtswa ri/tum se/mil ne+e/ke li ye/be tāb/he/’’(snying rje/khyed rang thug 'dod kyi bzod sgom mi thub bzhig bzhig red/)ces baji+od/ der zla ba sgrol mas phran bu ngo tsha ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te 6yor rdzi/ 'di 'dra'i gang byung mang byung dran tshad ma lab dang / zhi bar shog mices baji+od bzhin du g.yang 'dzoms la mig log cig bltas/g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘dngos yod gnas tshul bzhad pa la skyon e yod/’’ces zur za dang sbrags te baje+od/ der blo bzang gis ‘6yag da/nang la yar 'gro gi min nam/ da dung 'dir rgyun ring tsam bsnad na/ g.yang 'dzo+oms da dung de las mang tsam bzhu yag gi nyen kha yod red/’’ces baji+od de khong gnyis rang gi nyal khang du 'khrid de phyin/nyal khang du slebs pa dang blo bzang gis thog mar rang nyid kyi shag rogs prem ku swār khong gnyis la ngo sprod byas/ de nas ‘6khyed rang gnyis 'khyug tsam prem dang skad cha bzhad de lhod lhod byas te snod ang ’’zhes baji+od de slob grwa'i nye 'gram gyi tshong khang zhig tu chu grang mo dang zhel tog nyo bar phyin / blo bzang phyi la song rjes zla

spro74 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/ba sgrol mas blo bzang gi sngod khang der lta zhib yag po byas/ khang chung gru bzhi gu yangs po zhis gi nang du nyal khri gnyis dang / rgya cog gnyis/ rkub kyag gnyis/gnar/ pang la dbyang ba'i rlung 'khor gcig de bzhin 'gyig gi bāl kri gcig dang lcags slam che chung gsum/ chu grang mo 'jos sa'i rdza ma gcig gu thung dang stod thung la sogs pa'i gyon chas sna ge bdun tsam zhig dbyang lung la bkal te bzhag yod pa dang / gzhan yang rgya cog re re'i steng du deb srab zug 'dra min sna tshogs zang nge zing nge byas te brtsigs yod pa dang / blo bzang gi nyal khri'i sngas mgo yod sar 7gong sa mchog gi sku par zhig gi mdun du dbe cha brgyad dgu zhig kyang gcig thog tu gcig brtsigs te yod pa mthong / dus yun zung ngu zhig gi rjes su prem ku mār gyis khong gnyis la ‘‘apa log/ a rām se/ be+e ṭi ye/ me ja ra/ ba dzar/ ja ke a tā hung /’’(khyed rang tsho lhod lhod bzhugs rogs gnang / nga khrom la phyin te yong gi yin/)zhes baji+od de phyi la song /ska2ri ma bcu tsam zhig gi rjes su blo bzang slebs te khong tsho gsum gyis chu grang mo 'azung ba dang / zhal tog za ba sogs byas te skad cha bshad de bsnad yod pa'i skabs this/ la zla ba sgrol mas 6‘blo bzang khyed rang gis dbe cha mang po zhig brtsigs te bzhag 'dug da nang chos la dbyings zhugs pa ma red dam/’’zhes dris/blo bzang ṅgas 6ā+o da/dbyings zhugs zer na'ang red/don gnyer dang spro snang slebs pa zer na'ang red/ gang ltar nang pa'i chos kyi phyag dpe de tsho'i nang nas deng sang gi rig gsar slob tshan gyi nang du med pa'i gnas tshul mang po shes kyi 'dug

ska'i/ ljan slob grwa nas gsang 11tha// 175byas tsang da lta slob tsharna gzhan mang po sbyang dgos dus dus tshod med pa ma gtogs/ gzhen phyag dpe 'di tsho lhod lhod byas te klog 'dun chen po 'dug dpe cha 'di tsho tshang ma dge bshes dpal ldan lags kyis lho phyogs gdan sa nas bsur gnang ba red/’’ces baji+od/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘phyag dpe 'di tsho'i steng nas thes bya gsar pa ga re rnyed kyi 'dug gam/ gcig shod dang /’’zhes blo bzang la re khadun byas/blo bzang gis ‘‘'di tsho'i nang nas las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang /tshe 'di phyi'i skor/ dge sdig la blang dor tshul bzhin ji ltar bya dgos min/ nyon mongs dug gsum la gnyen po ji ltar bsten dgos min/ sangs rgyas dang chos dge 'dun zhes pa ga 'dra jig la zer gyi yod med/ mdor na/ gzhi bden pa gnyis ga tan la phab/ lam thabs shes gnyis nyams su blangs/ 'bras bu sku gnyis ji ltar thob tshul bcas kyi skor la phra zhing phra ba gsungs yod pa red/ ces baji+od par khong gnyis kyis de dag bitachig tsam go ba las gnad don gang yang ma rtogs kyang zla ba sgrol mas ‘6byas na khyed rang grwa pa byed rtsis ma red dam/’mi zhes blo bzang la dris/ blo bzang gis ‘6da lta'i cha la grwa nga/ rang da byed rtsis med de/ ma 'ongs pa la go rim med zer ba ltar sus baji+od shes/’’zhes gad mo shor bzhin du baji+od/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘6de 'dra'i thag gcod chen po ma byed ma gtogs kha shas re sgug chen po byas te bsngad yod pa shes kyi med dam/’rizhes smras/ der blo bzang gis ‘6sus sgugs nas bsnad yod red/ ’ces dris/g.yang 'dzoms kyis zla ba sgrol ma'i phyogs la zur mig cig lta tsam byas pa'i mod la blo bzang la ‘6shes kyi med mdog mdog ma byed dang / sting rje/ zla ba sgrol mas sgugs nas

spro76 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/bsnad yod red/ gzhan su ’’zhes baji+od ma thag tu zla ba sgrol ma ngo tsha nas gdong dmar por gyur te g.yang 'dzo+oms la 66a tsi/ bu mo de zhi bar shog ga re lab kyi yod/ blo bzang la sgugs snod mkhan khyed rang yin pa/ can dhi gar la yod dus ga dus yin na'i blo bzang zug 'phrad la 'gro dang / blo bzang thug 'phrad la 'gro dang /zer mkhan de khyed rang yin pa/ da re yang u tshugs byas te 'di gar yong ba min nam/’mi zhes baji+od/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis 66nga da slob grwa gcig pa dang lhag par du 'dzin grogs song tsang zug 'dod byas te yong ba yin/ khyed rang can dhi gar la yod dus ga dus yin na'i blo bzang gi skor shod kyi med pas/ gal te blo bzang gi yi ge ma slebs par bdun phrag gnyis tsam song na yi ge slebs ma song dang yi ge slebs ma song zhes skad ga tshod rgyag gi yod/ dgongs dag nyal dus kyang yi ge sngas la bcug ste nyal gyi med pas/ ’zhes baji+od/ der zla ba sgrol mas lan zhig rgyag grabs byed skabs blo bzang gis ‘6da khyed rang gnyis shod res btang nas ma snod/ de las nga rang tsho khrom la kha lag cig za bar 'gro/ ma red pas ’ri zhes brjod/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘6red red/ da ga par khrid na'ang khrid rogs gnang /de ring nga gnyis khyed rang gi mgron po song tsang nga gnyis ga par skyel ma skyel khyed rang gi lag tu yod red/’’ces baji+od par zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘ga re zer gyi yod red/ nga gnyis ga par skyel ma skyel khyed rang gi lag tu yod zer dus nga tsho ca lag 'du 'ig red pas ’’ zhes baji+od de gad mo shor/yud tsam ris gi rjes su khong tsho gsum nang nas thon te slob grwa'i rgyal sgo'i 'gram

skal lngan 11ba grwa nas gsang bros/ spro77der slebs pa dang blo bzang gis ‘‘yag dang po nga tsho kha lag za bar 'gro gi yin nam/ yang na sbro 'cham la 'gro gi yin ’mizhes khong gnyis la skad cha dris/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘6khyed rang gi 'dod pa ltar gnang rogs/ da gin g.yang 'dzoms kyis de ring nga gnyis ga par bskyal na'ang khyed rang gi 'dod pa red lab ma song ngamalha zhes g.yang 'dzoms la lta bzhin smras/ blo bzang gis o ṭo rika shā 4spya zhig skad btang ste thog mar khong gnyis za khang zhig tu 'khrid/ de nas sdi li'i nang gi yul bsgor sbro 'cham pa 'gro sa'i sa gnas gal che ba/ ku tupa mi ṭ+wāṃr dang / in ḍi ya geṭi/ lāl ki lā/ bā nyi ṭim pal/ bijaya ghaṭa/ sogs la spro 'cham du 'khrid de dgong dre'i chu tshod brgyad pa zin mtshams thig la khong gsum man ju ṭi lar slebs/der bod pa'i za khang zhig gi nang du kha lag zos te mgron khang du phyin/ mgron khang du slebs pa dang zla ba sgrol mas ‘6de ring ldi li zer ba'i rgyal sa skad grags chen po de yag po lta yag byung song / thugs rje che gnang / yin na'ang khyed rang gis nga gnyis ldi li bod khang la 'khrid ma song /ri zhes rang nyid kyi lag par yod pa'i ko ba'i lag phad de rgya cog gi steng du 'jog bzhin smras/ blo bzang gis ‘6a las/ngas da ldi li bod khang du 'khrid 'dod byung / yin na'ang da bar nga'i sar yong mkhan gyi bod pa tshos bod khang de phyi rgyal ba tsho 'gro sa red ces baji+od de 'gro 'dod byed mkhan mi 'dug byas tsang nga'i bsam par khyed rang gnyis la'ang lta 'dod e yod bsam byung /byas na dgongs dgad rjes ma tan tan 'khrid kyi yin da/’’zhes lan btab/ der g.yang 'dzoms kyis 6‘rjes ma khyed rang can dhi lhar la yar yong gi 4245 0—71khusmo5khyid+ku7

kro78 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/min nam/ sa cha skyid po dang gtsang ma yod red da/’’zhes baji+od/ der blo bzang gis ‘‘zengs ma gcig tan tan yong gi yin/ nga dha ram sa lar 'khyug tsam 'gro dgos pa zhig yod/ skabs de dus stabs cig don gnyis byas te yar mar gang rung zhig la yong gi yin/’jizhes baji+od/gang 'tsham zhig nas blo bzang gis 66da phal cher phyi po byas song / nga hos ṭal la log gi yin/’’baji+od de 'gro grabs byed skabs g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘ñca rdzi/de ring 'di gar mnyam du bsdad na 'grigs kyi ma red pas/ sang nyin zhogs pa nga gnyis 'di nas thon pa dang khyed rang yang hos ṭal la log na 'grigs kyi red/'di gar nyal khri ni gnyis 'dug pas zla ba sgrol ma nga gnyis mnyam du nyal na 'grigs kyi red/ nga tsho khyed rang thug 'phrad du yong ste khyed rang de 'dra'i brel ba ga re red/ yang yang ni thug gi yod pa ma red/ de ring lhod lhod byas te snod/ ma red pas ’zhes zla ba sgrol ma'i phyogs la lta bzhin smras/ zla ba sgrol mas 66'ong /red red/ de ring lhod lhod byas te snod/’’ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘6byas na nga gzugs po zhig 'khru gi yin/ a cor 'khyer yod pas/ khyed rang gnyis kyang 'khyu gi min nam/’’zhes baji+od/ der g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘6'khru khang chung chung zhig gi nang du mi gsum mnyam du zhong gi ma red/dang po khyed rang khrus ’’zhes sgam gyi nang nas a cor dang yi rtsi bton te blo bzang la sbrod bzhin smras pas khong tsho gsum ga gad mo zhor/

ska0zhu ldan slob ba/ natha bkathagang 11thag/ smo79de ltar khong gesum res mos kyis gzugs po 'khrus tshar ba'i rjes su lhod lhod byas te bsnad yod pa'i skabs thig la blo bzang gis ‘‘zla ba sgrol ma khyed rang bi e thon rjes ga re byed rtsis yin nam/’’zhes dris/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘da lta tan tan gang yang med/ gcig byas na be eḍi byas te dge rgan byed dgos bsam gyi 'dug dge rgan las gzhan pa'i btsan byol spyi tshogs kyi nang la las ka 'di byas na bsam pa gcig mi 'dug khyed rang ga re byed rtsis yin ’’zhes phar dris/ blo bzang gis ‘6nga rang gi 'dod pa la da dung mu mthud de em e byed dgos bsam gyi 'dug ste/ shes rig las khungs kyi bka' la brtsi dgos tsang gang gsungs kyi yod med da lta shes kyi med/ phal cher gangs can sgyid gshongs la yar shog gsungs kyi med 'gro ’’zhes brjod/ de nas blo bzang bis g.yang 'dzo+oms phyogs la bltas te ‘‘khyed rang ga re byed rtsis yin/’’zhes dris/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis 6‘nga rang gi 'dod par bud med tshogs pa'i nang la las ka byed dgos bsam gyi 'dug yin na'ang las ka rag gi yod med ha go gi med/’’ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘6khyed rang bud med tshogs pa la dbyings ga re byas te zhugs pa red/’’ces dris par zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘deng sang g.yang 'dzoms pho mo 'dra mnyam dang / bud med kyi thob thang dang rang dbang bcas kyi thog la zhub phyogs pa'i bud bed tsho nang bzhin dbyings zhe drag zhugs yod red/byas tsang bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang la bud med kyi thob thang rtsod mkhan dang po de byed kyi yin zer nas shor shor red/’’ces baji+od/ g.yang 'dzo+oms kyis ‘‘nyon dang blo bzang / zla ba sgrol ma mo rang byad med yin yang nga la rgyab skyor byed rgyu bzhag ste/ zur za 'di 'dra byed kyi yod red/ 'di

180 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/'dra lab na bod pa'i bud med tsho sbyi tshogs kyi nang nas ga 'dra byas te langs zub kyi red/’ ces baji+od/blo bzang gis bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcas te zla ba sgrol ma'i phyogs la lta bzhin du ‘6deng sang mi tshos pho po 'dra mnyam zer ba de tshang ma mi yin pa'i cha nas chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/chos lugs/shes yon/smra baji+od/de bzhin sbyi tshogs kyi rang dbang dang thob thang la longs su sbyod rgyur 'dra mnyam dgos pa red zer gyi yod na ni bden pa red ma gtogs/ de min skyes pa dang bud med gnyis byed las dang rnam pa/ ngo bo bcas gang gi thad nas kyang 'dra mnyam red zer gyi 'dug na ni nga la yos mazun med la/de 'dra yong shes yag kyang yod pa ma red/’’ces baji+od/g.yang 'dzoms kyis blo bzang gis bshad pa de la mno bsam zhig btang ste/‘6'dra mnyam min pa ga 'dra yin nam/ skyes pas byed zub sar bud med kyis byed mi thub pa ga re yod red/’mices brjod/ blo bzang gis tsha lo ma zhig rgya cog steng nas lag pas blangs te pags pa bshu bzhin du ‘‘skyes pas byed thub sar bud med kyis byed mi thub pa'ang mang po yod red la/ de bzhin bud med kyis byed thub sar skyes pas byed mi thub pa'ang du ma yod red/ gzhan pa phar bzhag ste khyed rang nga nang bzhin yar langs te gcin pa gtong thub kyi med pa/ de bzhin ngas phru gu la zhu ma bsnun thub kyi ma red/ nga'i lta stangs la skyes pa dang bud med gnyis dngul ṭam gyi ngos phan tshun nang bzhin nam/ yang na thabs dang shes rab gnyis nang bzhin gcig la gcig ltos kyis gnyis ka gal chen po red ma gtogs rnam

skal lngan 11ba grwa nas gsang 11sa/ spyo8kropa mtha' dag nas gcig mtshungs red ces zer mi thub/’’ zhes smras/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis 66nga tshos pho mo 'dra mnyam dgos yod zer yag de skyes pa dang bud med gnyis kyi lus kyi chags rabs 'dra mnyam red zer gyi yod pa ma red/sbyi tshogs kyi nang du gang ci'i thob thang 'dra mnyam dgos yod ces shod kyi yod pa red/’’ brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘‘byas na bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du skyes pa la yod pa'i thob thang bud med la ma sbrad pa zhig ga re 'dug kha shas zhig drangs dang ’’zhes baji+od/g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du bud med la ga dus yin na'ang mthong chung byed kyi yod pa dang gcig dper na nang mi zhig la cha bzhag na bu mo skyes pa las bu skyes par dga' tshor che ba byed kyi skusnad pa/ de bzhin de snga bod la mkhas pa tshang ma skyes pa ma gtogs bud med kyi mkhas pa'i ming ha lam go rgyu med pa/ gdan sa khag gi grwa pa tshor cha bzhag na dge bshes lha nga phrag mang wa 1ten yong gi sku da kyang btsun ma'i dge bshes zhes pa zhig go rgyu med pa dang / lhag par du dge sle nga ma zhes pa rtsa ba nas besna rgyu mi 'dug gzhan yang nang mi gcig la cha bzhag na a ma des phru gu lta rgyu dang kha lag bzo rgyu de bzhin nang las yongs rdzogs byed dbosnas pa'i srol zhig 'dug gzhan yang nye ba'i cha la ma gtamags bud med tsho la 'os zhog blugs rgyu'i thob thang yang sbrad yod sa ma red/ mices brjod/blo bzang gis 6‘nga'i bsam par khyed rang la de ring sang gi nub phyogs pa'i bud

182 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/med ring lugs zer ba'i shugs rkyen gyi rlung ngar de phog pa tsam las bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi nang du nyams zhib yag po zhig gnang med pa 'dra/bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du bud med la mthong chung byed kyi 'dug zer ba'i spyi tshogs de'i nang du bod pa'i bud med kyang tshud yod pa red/ lar nas mthong dang brtsi bkur zhes pa de yong ba rang rang gis bzo dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan las re ba byed rgyu'i dngos po zhig ma red la/de bzhin khrims dang sgrig gzhi bzos te yong rgyu zhig kyang ma red/bu mo skyes pa las bu skyes par dga' tshor che ba byed kyi 'dug zer ba de mi'i sbyi tshogs chen po zhig gi nang du gnas tshul mi shes pa'i dud khyim re zung gis de 'dra byed srid pa red/ spyi yongs kyi bod pa'i sbyi tshogs nang du rgya gar nang bzhin gyi bag ma'i rdzong skal spu+od dgos pa'i srol ngan de 'dra med stabs/bu dang bu mo ga re skyes kyang dga' tshor byed pa ma gtogs/ ngas da lta bar du bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du ma'i mngal du yod pa de bu mo yin pa shes te mngal gsod btang ba red ces go ma myong / lar nas pha ma dang sbyi tshogs la phan thogs mkhan zhig yin na ni bu mos kyang phan thogs byed thub kyi yod/ phan mi thogs mkhan zhig yin na ni bus kyang phan thogs byed thub kyi med/ gzhan yang de snga bod la skyes dman gyi mkhas pa byung mi 'dug zer rgyu dang /dge slong ma mi 'dug zer rgyu de tsho de'i skabs dang de'i dus kyi bud med tshos rang rang gi thob thang len ma zub pa dang / len ma shes pa red ma gtogs go skabs dang gnang ba ma sbrad pa rtsa nas ma red/ nub phyogs pa nang bzhin bod kyi bud med tsho la 'os shog gi thob thang bkag pa dang / gzhan yang las rigs 'ga' zhig gi nang du bud med 'dzul zhugs mi chog pa bcas byung yod na

skal lngan 11ba grwa nas gsang 11sa/ 183thugs khag med/ 'on kyang de 'dra rtsa ba nas byung yod pa ma red/ chos phyogs nas bzhad na thub pa bcom ljan 'das kyis dge slong pha me gnyis zhes 'dra mnyam gyi go skabs gnang yod pa red/dge tshul pha ma dang /dge slong pha ma'i sngom khrims la grangs ka mang nyung zhig tan tan yod pa 'dra/ de ni gzugs po'i chags rabs kyi dbang du byas te bzos gnang ba las nye ring gnang pa zhig rtsa nas yin gyi ma red/sangs rgyas la nye ring yong shes kyi'ang ma red/mi’ces dang / de nas zla ba sgrol ma 'phred nyal brgyab ste bsngad yod sa de nas sngas 'bol zhig lag pa g.yon mas blangs te rtsig pa'i ngos su bzhag ste/ der rgyab bsnyes byas te mu mthud par/‘‘srid phyogs nas bshad na/ btsan byol bod mi'i bca' khrims kyi nang du pho mo 'dra mnyam zhes 'khod pa nang bzhin lago len du'ang 'gel gyi sku1da/de las lhag 7gong sa mchog gis nye char gal te bod mi sa ya drug gi dbo sa mkho dang mthun pa'i dus tshod smin gyi 'dug na ma 'ongs par tā la'i bla ma'i sku skyes de bud med kyi gzugs su'ang phebs srid pa red ces gsungs gnang 'dug ga byas tsang bud med tsho la rnam dbyod bton rgyu yod na bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du go skabs cha tshang snga mo nas rgyul yod pa red ma gtogs bkag pa zhig po da pa ma red/ de nas a mas nang las dang bu phrug gso skyong byed kyi 'dug zer dus pa pha de nyal nas snod kyi 'dug zer gyi yod pa red pas/ de 'dra yin gyi ma red/ pa phas zhing sgrags nas slebs dus a mas me btang ba la ya mtshan skye dahos doni med/ bod spro'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du nang mi re zung 'dra yod na ma gtogs de min skyes pa dang bud med gnyis kyi dbar la gcig gis gcig la bshu gzhog gtong mkhan rtsa ba nas

spro84 mi tshe'i sgo ba mngar skyur/yod pa ma red/ gal te pa pha de 'jon pa yod na kho phran bu dbang che ba yong srid pa dang / a ma de 'jon pa yod na mo hran bu dbang che ba yong srid pa red ma galta gas de min nang mi tshang mas las mnyam rub byed 11la yag po zhig yod red/ phran bu gcig gis mang ba dang gcig gis nyung ba byed srol 'dis gcig gis gcig la brtse ba dang gus bkur gyi thog nas bzod sgom dang chog shes byed pa'i goms gzhis bzang po zhig red/ de nas dngos sku da gnas tshul la bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du cha snyoms kyis bshad na pa pha las a ma dbang che ba sku da/ de 'dra song tsang kha rgyun du'ang 6'dam brgya sgog sgog brgya'i dbon bo de nga yin/ nga'i dpon po nang la yod/’ zer yag de byung ba red/mi ces brjod/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis 66byas na bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du skye dman dang / bud med ces tha snyad kho rang skye ba dman pa dang / mi gral nas ma bud tsam zhes btags pa 'di tsho mthong chung khyad gsod byas pa ma red dam/’’zhes sdus/ blo bzang gis 6‘'di 'dra'i tha snyad kyi rigs la rtsod pa rgyag dgos byung na rgyab nas rgyab tshar gyi ma red/ 'di tsho 'dod rgyal gyi ming yang yin srid pa red/ rjes sgrab kyi ming yang yin srid pa red/ de lta bu'i ming 'dogs mkhan gyi 'dod rgyal me+ekhan po de skyes pa'ang yin srid pa red/byad med kyang yin srid pa red/ tha snyad btags pa nang banin don la gnas dgos pa'i khyab pa yod pa ma red/ dber na/ khyed rang la g.yang 'dzoms zer dus phywa dang g.yang tshang ma 'dzo+oms yod pa'i khyab pa sked la/nga la blo bzang zer dus nga sems bzang po yod pa'i khyab pa'ang med pa nang bzhin red/ lar nas bcom snan 'das kyis chos 'di rton pa bzhi gsungs te/ gang zag la mi rton choso la rton/ tshig la

skal ljan 11ba grwa nas gsang 11sa/ 185mi rton don la rton/ drang don la mi rton nges don la rton/ rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton/gsungs pa red/yang gal te dag cha de'i dka' ngal 'phrad kyi 'dug na ni sa ma btags sma bris te 6sman ’bzos na'ang 'grigs kyi med 'gro/’’zhes baji+od g.yang 'dzoms kyis 6‘byas na nga tsho skyes pa'i sman red zer gyi yod dam/nad ga re la phan pa'i sman red dam/ ’zhes dris/ blo bzang gis 6‘da nad ga re la phan gyi yod med de ngas lab kyi min/ ngas lab mi dgos pa'i thog nas shes pa byed rogs gnang ji’zhes baji+od pa dang khong tsho gsum kar rang dbang med par gad moshor/de nas zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘dngos gnas byas na tho da pa'i bud med tsho la thob thang rtsod dgos pa med par ma zad/ da dung chol kha so so'i sbyi 'azus kyi nang du bud med gnyis nges par du dgos pa'i cha rkyen dmigs bsal bzos 'dug ga dbe yag po ma red dam/ mizhes smras/ der blo bzang gis ‘‘dngos 'brel byas na ngas lta dus dmigs bsal btang ba 'dis bud med la mthong chung dang khyad gsod la 'a11 gi med dam bsam gyi 'dug cha rkyen zhig ma tshang na dmigs bsal gtong ba'i lugs srol yod pa ma gtogs cha rkyen tshang na dmigs bsal gtong dgos don yod pa ma red/ rnam dbyod kyis rtsal bton te thob thang blangs pa dang /dmigs bsal gyi 11ga nas thob thang blangs pa gnyis la zhib mo'i blo yis dbyad na gdeng 'arjog gi khyad par tan tan yod pa red/ rnam daphyod 'gran sdur gyi thog nas sbyi 'thus bzhi bcu zhe drug tshang ma bud med slebs kyang 'grigs pa red/ de

186 mi 31re bro ba mngar skyur/'dra byung na yag po'ang red/ in dra/ hūṃ dhis srid blon byed thub sa la g.yang 'dzoms kyis bka' blon khri pa byed mi thub pa yong gi ma red/’’ces baji+od/ zla ba sgrol mas kyang de'i steng du ‘ā+ong da/bod kyi bud med kyi brka' blon khri pa dang po de byed dang / yang na dge slong ma'am/ btsun ma'i dge bshes dang po de byed khyed rang la rag las 'dug’’ces gad mo shor bzhin du baji+od/khong gsum de 'dra'i skad cha la mgo 'khor te bsnad pas mtshan gyi chu tshod dang 〈sna zin pa'ang ma shes/ zla ba sgrol mas mtha' ma der 66da nga tsho nyal na ma gtogs 'phyi po chags 'dug’’ces baji+od de khong gsum gnyid kyi zhing khams su song /chig gi 'ja' tshon mthong ba'i mig ldan yang //don gyi brlan bsher rtogs pa'i rgyang shel bral//phyi yi mdzes sdug tshor ba'i dbang bo des//nang gi ro bcud mi lon ya re mtshan// rang gi sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i sred zhen gyi me lce//gzhan gyi bde ba bsregs pa'i bud thing du sbyad de//bde sdug thob dor 'dod pa'i sems can gyi gzhis la//cis kyang bcos su med pa'i rang bzhin 'di e bden//

gangs skyid kyi mtshan tshogs/༄༅༅/ /dus yun mi ring ba zhig gi nang du blo bzang gis mtho slob mthar phyin ma thag tu bod gzhung shes rig las khyangs kyi bka' dgongs tshul bzhin dang du blangs nas dha sar yong ste/shes rig gi slob deb bskyar zhib sde tshan gyi nang du las ka byed rgyu 'go btsugs/ thog mar ldi li nas yong skabs dha sar ngo shes pa ni su yang med snyam ste/ sems la phran bu 'tsher snang gcig dang bcas yong yod kyang /dha sar slebs skabs ka spug dang ma su ri bod gzhung slob grwa nas yin pa'i slob 〈snags bu dang bu mo ngo shes mang po zug par dga' tshor chen po byung / dha sar slebs te bdun phrag gcig tsam phyin pa'i rjes su nyin gcig blo bzang las khyangs 〈snal te meka loḍa phyogs su 'a〈sna ba'i lam khar ngag dbang rgyag pa la thug blo bzang gis thog mar phar mthong skabs de snga slob grwar yod pa dang mi 'dra bar gzugs stobs phran bu ring du phyin pa gang zhig la sha skam du phyin yod pas yin nam min nam snyam pa zhig byung yang / ngag dbang gis blo bzang tshur mthong ma thag tu lam seng ngo shes te/ ‘6ya blo bzang ma red pas ’’zhes dris/blo bzang gis cung

spro88 mi che'i 11 ba mngar skyur/the tshom dang bcas ‘‘khyed rang ngag dbang yin pa ’’zhes baji+od/ ngag dbang gis lam seng ‘0(nga / nga ngag dbang rgyag pa yin/ da rgyag pa'i sa la bsnad yod pa ma red/ mi 'dug ga ces rang nyid kyi gzugs po la lta bzhin du lag pa btang ba dang mnyam du mu mazud de 6‘slob grwa gtor nas bzung ste lo mang po'i ring la ma thug par de ring 'di gar ga 'dra byas te slebs song ’’zhes skad cha dris/ blo bzang gis dri ba der lan ma brgyab 〈snan la ngag dbang gi mnyam du ye da pa'i a lcag gzugs sdo la sha lo nag pa der lta tsam nig byas par ngag dbang gis ‘'a( kho nga rang nga'i skye dman chung bdag lags red/’ ces ngo sprod byas/ blo bzang gis phar bkris bde legs zhus pa bzhin tshur yang bkris bde legs ba1snad pa tsam ma gastosnags 'dzum mer tsam dang sku dkar tsam zhig kyang ma bstan par mig nam mkhar blta zhing bsnad / de nas blo bzang gis ‘6nga ldi li nas bi ye tshar nas shes rig la las ka byed kyi sku1da/ da lta slebs nas bdun phrag gcig las phyin ma song ’zhes brjod/ ngag dbang gis 6‘a las/ da yag po byung /nga yang rtsas zhib khang du las ka byed kyi sku(da/ chung bdag lags 'ahre da bsten las khyangs la yod red/ri’ces brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘‘ngag dbang khyed rang 'di gar ga dus slebs pas/ las ka byas te rgyun ring 'e da phyin sku nga / chang sa yang rgyab tshar 'dugamyur po byung /’ zhes brjod/ ngag dbang gis ‘‘nga 'di gar slebs te lo gsum 'gro gi 'dugachang sa rgyab nas kyang lo gnyis phyin song /da dha ram sa la'i mi rnying pa chags tshar ba red/ nga dang mi 'gyur gnyis 'di gar mnyam du slebs pa yin/ ’zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘a las/ mi 'gyur yang 'di gar yod red pas/

gangs skyid kyi patshan ྅nyanas/ 189las ka ga par byed kyi 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/ der ngag dbang gis ‘6mi 'gyur deng sang 'di gar yod ma red/ nga gnyis 'dzin grwa bcu gcig thon tshar ba dang bod gzhung gis las byed slob sbyong zla ba drug sbrad de mi 'gyur ti sbyo gzhis chags kyi las drung la btang song / nga yang la dwags la gtong grabs byas song ste/ mtha' ma der 'gro dgos pa rang byung ma song / da cha mi 'gyur yang phal cher de ga'i gzhis chags kyi bu mo zhig dang mnyam du chang sa brgyab 'dug zer yag cig go 1snas byung ’’zhes baji+od/ de mtshams nas chung bdag gis blo kha ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te ‘‘de ring nyin gang 'di gar lam gyi steng du langs te snod rtsis yin nam ’’ zhes thog mar ngag dbang la lta tsam byas/ de nas blo bzang phyogs la bltas te mu mazud de ‘‘khong rang la'ang blel ba yod kyi red/ nyin gcig ca da casnad gnang ste nang la phebs gnang / nga tsho gnas chung grwa tshang gi 'gram la snod kyi yod/’’ces smras/ngag dbang gis ‘‘red red/da nga tsho lhod lhod byas te zug chog sang nyin gza' nyi ma red/ nga tsho bsnad bsnad pa yin/ yin cig min gnyis shog ang /’’zhes baji+od de khong gsum so so'i phyogs su bskyod/sang nyin der gza' nyi ma song tsang blo bzang gis zhogs pa'i chu tshod dgu pa bar du zhogs nyal brgyab pas gangs sgyid sbyi thab kyi zhogs ja de ma non/ langs 'acasnad de tsam ma byung yang / gnyi mug gnyid la rdzogs mtha' med/ nyal rang drags na rang skal chad/ zer bro'i dge bshes dpal lngan lags kyis dus rgyun gdan sa'i grwa pa tshor bka' bkyon gtong ba'i gsung de lhang lhang dran pas yar langs te/ khyus zhig

190 mi che'i 11 ba mngar skyur/rgyag dgos bsam nas chu'i nal rka yod sa der phyin kyang chu med pa shes te/ rang nyid kyi thab tshang du chu 'gyig zom phyed tsam zhig yod pa de nal rka'i 'gram du 'khyer yong ste kha ngo bkrus/ de nas zhogs ja zhig 'thung bar 'gro dgos snyam ste bod gzhung sman rtsis khang dang gangs skyid gnyis kyi dbar la rgya gar ba'i ja tshong khang chung chung zhig yod pa de'i nang du phyin te/ ja dkar yol gang dang sa mo sa gnyis mngags/ rgya cog nar mo sbrang bus khengs bsnad pa de'i steng du hin dī'i gsar shog himācal zhes pa zhig yod pa de klog gin bsnad/ hin dī'i gsar shog de klog skabs klog shes kyi yod kyang chig phal che ba'i don dag mgo ma tshod bas blo bzang sga bsam par slob grwar 'dzin grwa lnga pa bar du hin dī sbyangs kyang bar lam lo shas kyi ring la hin dī'i skad brgyab pa tsam ma gtogs gsar shog sogs bklag rgyur goms 'dris mu mazud ma byas pa'i rkyen red snyam pa dus mtshungs da nas bzung rang gi gnas tshang rgyal khab kyi skad yig la'ang do snang phran bu byed dgos bsams/ blo bzang gis gsar shog klog bzhin bsnad yod pa'i skabs su ngag dbang der 'o ma nyo bar slebs/ngag dbang gis ‘6ya blo bzang khyed rang 'dir bsnad 'dug ga nga khyed rang gi las shag la phyin kyang sgo lcags brgyab 'dug’’ces smras/ blo bzang gis 6‘nga zhogs ja zhig 'thung bar yong ba yin/ yag byas na ja gang 'azung / snod dang /’’ zhes rang gi mdun gyi rkub kyag stong pa de la lag brda byas/ ngag dbang gisu bsam blo zhig btang rjes ‘‘sdod 'dod da 'dug ste nga 'o ma nyo bar yong ba yin/ yang dus tshod la

gangs skyid kyi mtshan thechenas/ 191ma slebs na don med kha bdung bzed rgyu red/ da gas byed kyi ma red/ nga'i nang la phar 'grode ring lhod lhod byas te sdod dgos/ma red pas/’’zhes dris/blo bzang gi bsam par de ring dmigs bsal gyi las ka ni med/ ngag dbang gi las zhag kyang mthong gi red snyam ste/ ‘‘byas na yong nga / 'gro’’zhes rang nyid kyi zhogs ja dang ngag dbang gi 'o ma'i rin pa bcas sbrad de ngag dbang dang mnyam du kho pa'i las zhag tu phyin/ngag dbang gi las shag de ni khangaspeg gru bzhi che chung gnyis can zhig ste/ che ba de nyal sa dang chung ba de thab tshang yin/ nyal khang de'i nang du nyal khri gnyis dang dkyil der mdun cog gcig dang rkub kyag gnyis/ zur gcig tu zhing bskos legs po byas pa'i mchod gshom che chung 'tshams po dang / bkod pa legs pa zhig gi nang du rje yab sras gsum gyi sku 'dra dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du 7gong sa mchog dang gnas chung dang lha mo'i sku par yang bsgrigs yod pa/ de dag gi mdun der dngul ting to lā bcu re tsam yod pa'i bdun tshar dang / mchod kong gnyis bcas bsgrigs yod / nyal khri'i steng du 'gyig gdan 'bel po re'i khar nyal kheb khra khra re g.yogs yod pa dang / de'i steng du rum gdan sngo nag ja 'brug kha sprod kyi ri mo yod pa re bting yod / mchod gshom yod sa'i kha thug der tshon khra can gyi gzugs mthong rlung 'phrin dang / brnyan 'phrin 'phrul 'khor rang sgrig cha tshang gcig shing sgrom bkod legs pa zhig gi steng du bzhag yod/ nyal khri gnyis kyi steng du ko ri ya nas thon pa'i nyal zan spu can tshon khra can gnyis re stebs legs po brgyab
