192 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/ste nar mar brtsigs yod / de dag gi steng du rgya nag nas thon pa'i sngas 'bol 'tshem drub kyi ri mo yod pa gnyis re bzhag yod/ thab tshang gi nang du rdo bzhun rlangs rdzas thab gcig dang / 'khyag sgam chen po gcigadug log 'khyu ba'i 'phrul 'khor mo gcig gzhan yang thab 1snad dang / sder ma/ ja dkar/ ja dam/ tsha dam bcas dngos gtsang legs po byas te bang khri'i steng du sgrig skusnad/ngag dbang dang blo bzang gnyis nang du slebs skabs chung bdag lags dang bu po sgrol ma gnyis gzugs mthong rlung 'brin lta gin misnad sku da pa mthong / chung bdag lags kyis thog mar do snang med par ltad mor mabosto 'khor nas bsngad kyang blo bzang nang du slebs pa shes ma thag yar langs te/ ‘6bkris bde legs/bzhugs gnang dang /’’zhes rkub kyag gcig la lag brda byas/ blosna bzang gis kyang phar ‘6bkris bde legs/ sku khams bzang wa / ’zhes ba1snad/ chung bdag lags kyis ‘‘lags yin/’rizhes baji+od ma thag tu ngag dbang gis sgrol ma'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ ‘6'di nga'i bu mo sgrol ma red/ ces blo bzang wongo sbrod byas pa'i rjes su sgrol mar ‘‘yag 55nga kal 43 la bkris bde legs zhus/’’zhes smras/ 1snal mas ngo tsha byas te gdong bkug ste sdod pa las bkris bde legs ma zhus/ 'on kyang chung bdag gis ngag dbang la mig log cig bltas te ‘‘nga'i bu mo/ khyed rang gcig pus bzos pa yin bsam gyi 'dug gam/ nga tsho'i bu mo yang lab shes kyi yod pa ma red/’rices smras/ ngag dbang gis 66a las/ kha nor ba red ma 43//bakhu1rngu lug zhang /

gangs skyid kyi mtshan tshetshunas/ 193gtogs kun slong de 'dra yod pa ma red/ dgongs dag zhes brjod bzhin lag par 'khyer yod pa'i 'o ma'i zom chung de chung bdag la sbrad/ chung bdag gis gzugs mthong rlung 'phrin de bsad de/ mchod gshom gyi 'og tu yod pa'i phyag sgam de'i nang nas cog leṭi gcig bton te sgrol ma la sbrod bzhin du ‘6da khyed rang phyi la rtsed mo rtse bar rgyugs/ yang dug log btsog pa bzos nas log ma yong ang ’’zhes baji+od de sgrol ma phyi la btang rjes thab tshang du ja bzo bar phyin/ngag dbang gis nyal khri'i steng du rgyab bsnyes byas te lag pa gnyis rang nyid kyi ltag par bzhag ste/ 6‘yag da gcig shod dang / lha ram sa la ga 'dra 'dugaskyid po 'dug gam/’’zhes skad cha dris/ blo bzang gis ‘6da lta slebs grabs song tsang mi dang /sa dang /khor yug sogs gang yang 'dris med pas skyid po yod med sgod tshod thig gi mi 'dugalar nas gtam gyi dbe la/bla ma byin rlabs che dang chung / dngos la ma rag rang la rag zer ba ltar skyid dang ma skyid zer yag de rang nyid kyis khor yug dang bsdun shes ma shes la rag las kyi med 'a〈sna ’mizhes baji+od/ ngag dbang gis ‘‘de dngos gnas bden pa 'dra bo 'dug khyed rang gis shes gsal ltar ka sbug slob grwa gtor ba'i rjes su nga tsho thim lār 'gro mkhan gyi nang nas bu mang po 'asnumal tog brgyab ste phyin song / thog mar nga yang skyid po zhe drags ma byung / yin na'i ga ler mi 'dris sa 'dris byung ste skyid po byung / 'gyur med dang skal ldan yang slob grwa nas gsang bros byas te dmag mir phyin sku nga / shes kyi sku da dam/’ri zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘‘yod yod/ 'gyur med dmag sgar du slebs nas zla ba

sgro94 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/brgyad tsam phyin pa'i rjes su nga la yi ge btang byung / 'gyur med dmag mir phyin pa der thog mar nga la 'dod pa ma byung ste/ khos dmag mir bsnad de dus tshod 'phro brlag tu btang mi 'dug dmag sgar nas yig 'grul gyi lam nas yig tshad btang ste da cha kho bi e thon grabs yod red/ las ka yang dmag dpon gcig gi drung yig yin pa 'dra/ snying rje/ nga la yang skabs skabs su dngul sgor mo brgya nyis brgya de 'dra bskur bskur bar bsnad pas phan thogs chen po byung /’ zhes smras/ngag dbang gis ‘‘a las/ dpe yag po red/ ma gzhi khyed gnyis slob grwa rang nas 'cham po yod pa/ byas na sgong nga'i rgyal mi+o kho ga re byas 'dug khong gnyis mnyam du 'dug gam/’rizhes sdus/ blo bzang gis 66skal lngan dmag sgar la lo gnyis tsam zhig bsnad pa'i rjes su kho pa'i a zhang phyi rgyal la yod pa zhig gis phyi rgyal la 'then pa 'dra/deng sang ga par yod med shes kyi med/’’ ces baji+od/ngag dbang gis ‘6a las/ da phyi rgyal la slebs yod na da kho rang phyug po chags yod kyi red/de min ngas kho la sgo nga gcig dang zhing tog gnyis da dung sbrod rgyu lhag yod/da thug na'ang phal cher len gyi med 'gro ’rizhes gad mo shor bzhin baji+od pas/blo bzang yang mnyam du gad mo shor/ de mtshams nas chung bdag lags kyis ja mngar mo dkar yol gnyis dang bzhes tog sder tse gang bcas rgya cog gi mdun du bzhag ste/ ‘‘blo bzang lags/ gsol ja bzhes tog mchod gnang /’’zhes smras/blo bzang gis mgo bo gug tsam zhig byas te ja dkar lag tu blangs te ja 'thung bzhin pa'i ngang du ‘6mi 'gyur yod sa der bod mi mang los yod red/ kho 'di par

gangs skyid kyi mazungan thergyanas/ 195yong gi mi 'dug gam/’’zhes dris/ ngag dbang gis ‘6bod mi phal cher chig stong yar mar gcig med 'aglo yirna na'ang gzhis chags skyo ba'i gras zhig red/ mi 'gyur kho rang lo ltar 'di gar skabs re rtsis rgyag dang / skabs re tshogs 'dur yong gi 'dug da lta'ang rang 'jags rkang pol rtse rgyur dbyings zhugs te ga dus zug na'ang rkang pol gyi skad cha red/ gzhis chags nang du chang rag dar so chen po yod tsang da kho chang la dga' po chags 'dug de min 'gyur ba zhe drags thebs mi 'dug’ ces baji+od pa dang mnyam du ‘6khyed rang bod la'ang thengs gcig phyin pa red zer gyi 'dugapha gir gnas stangs ga 'dra 'dug gam/bod mi tsho dngos gnas skyid po mi 'dug gam/ ’zhes dris/ blo bzang gi bsam par skad cha zer ba de rlung dang gcig pa red zer ba de dngos gnas bden pa red 'dug snyam pa'i ngang nas 6‘nga bod la phyin pa red sus zer gyi 'dug gam/’’zhes dris/ngag dbang gis 6‘nga la lab mkhan de phal cher g.yang 'dzoms yin pa sku da/ nga rang tsho'i 'dzin grwa gcig pa g.yang 'dzoms yod pa/ mo thengs gcig can dhi ghar nas 'di gar slebs song / mos zer gyi 'dug / khyed rang sdi lir yod pa'ang mo'i sa nas shes byung /’’zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘6a las/ red red/ sayang 'dzo+oms nga la zug byung / bstan bzhig slong yag dang chob tsha the de da lta'ang rang 'jags bsnad 'dug’’ces brjod/ ngag dbang gis yud tsam sgugs rjes sgug ba〉snad ma theg pa ltar ‘6nga'i dri ba la lan yod ma red dam/ zhes smras/de'i lan du blo bzang gis yud tsam zhig bsam blo btang ste/ ‘6da bod du bod mi'i

spro96 mi che'i zo ba mngar skyur/gnas stangs ji yod ngas shes mdog byed kyi min/gang yin zer na nga gzhis ka rtse dang lha sa gnyis la ma gtogs slebs yod pa ma red/ lha sa la'ang gnas bskor byed zhor la nyi ma lnga tsam zhig ma gtogs bsnad med/ gzhis ka rtse'i bod mi tsho'i gnas stangs nga rang gis gang mthong ba dang / tshod rtsis byas pa bcas bshad pa yin na/ gnas stangs yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug phyi nas bltas na bod mi tsho hran bu dpal 'byor yar rgyas phyin pa dang /rdzon ma las sbyang grung 'dzo+oms su dang gtsang du phyin pa lta bu zhig tan tan 'duga'on kyang bod mi phal che ba rgya 'og tu sems ba skyid po med pa mngon gsal dod po 'dug de gcig ni bod mi rgan gzhon bar gsum tshang mas 7gong sa mchog zhal mngal 'dod chen po byed kyi 'dug rgya mis ni 7gong sa mchog gi sku par da yin da yin/ srung mdud yan chad btags pa yin na dogs pa byed kyi yod tsang chos dad rang dbang rtsa ba nas mi 'dugabod chos ldan gyi zhing zer sa der chos byed mi chog pa bathos na bod mi tsho sems pa skyid po yong rgyu sbros bral red pa/ dgon pa dang lha khang 'ga' shas sgo phyes te grwa pa grangs tshad nges can de 'dra tshogs 'tshogs pa dang 'don pa gyer pa de 'dra byed kyi 'dug ste/de tsho tshang ma phyi rgyal gyi tshags shog 'god po dang / yul bsgor sbro 'cham pa tsho la bod la chos dad rang dbang sbrad yod pa'i 'grems ston dang dril bsgrags kyi ched du dang / rgya nag gzhung la phyi rgyal gyi dngul gyi yong sgo bzo rgyu kho nar dmigs pa mngon gsal dod po 'dug ya mtshan pa zhig la/ nga'i a ne+es zer stangs la bltas na/ bod mi tsho ni de snga bod du rgya mi ma slebs pa'i skabs kyi chos dad dang /da lta rgya mis chos byed mi chog pa'i btsan gnon gyi 'og gi chos dad gnyis bsdur

gangs skyid kyi mtshan cechenas/ smo97na deng sang ha cang gi chos dad che ba yod red zer gyi 'dug phal cher 'dra bo yang 'dug de min thing nags 'breg gcod la sogs pa'i khor yug gi gtor skyon dang /rgya'i mi 'bor gyi khyab brdal/ bod pa'i rig gzhung gi nyams chag gang ci'i thad nas bltas kyang mgyogs m+bhar bzang thag ngan thag 〈snad ba gcig ma byung na/ phal cher bod la re ba med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug’rices baji+od/der ngag dbang gis dbyags ring zhig 'then rte/ ‘‘da ga re byed dgos red/ nga tsho btsan byol du yod pa tshos byed rgyu ni gcig byed kyi skusnad pa'i khyal red de/ 'di gar ga tshod byas kyang gzhis lus bod mi tsho la phan 1snags sku nga gi med pa red/’mices yid thang chad pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas baji+od/ der blo bzang gis lam seng ‘6de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red da/gzhis lus bod mi tshos nga tsho btsan byol du yod pa tsho la re ba chen po rgyag gi 'dug khong tshos nga tshor re ba byed stangs la bsam blo btang na phal cher gnyid khug rgyu yang khag po red/ dpe mi srid pa'i re ba chen po rgyag gi 'dug’mices baji+od/ ngag dbang dang chung bdag lags gnyis kyis blo bzang gis bshad ba der do snang che mdog kha po byas te nyan/gang 'tsham zhi/ga nas ngag dbang gis 6‘a ni khyed rang bod la ga 'dra byas te thar zub pa red/ sa mtshams ni dam po zhe drags sku da pa'i skad cha 'dug’mices sdus/slo bzang gis rang nyid kyi gu zung sba khyag nang nas sna phyis zhig bton te sna bung phyis tsam zhig byas te rang nyid de snga lo gsum gyi gong la bod du ji 'dra byas te

198 mi tshe'i 〈sna ba mngar skyur/phyin pa'i gnas tshul yongs rdzogs sta gon dang bcas bzhad pas ngag dbang gi bsam par blo bzang blo khog chen po dang gyong po byung 'dug snyam pa zhig byung / de mtshams nas chung bdag lagaso thab tshang du phyin3) kha lag g.yo sbyor byed bzhin bsnad/ ngag dbang yang yar langs te blo bzang la 66khyed rang lhod lhod byas te snod ang / ngas sbyi thab nas kha lag len sku1nga /mi’zhes baji+od de lto snod che chung gnyis 'khyer te phyi la song / blo bzang gis rgya cog gi steng du yod pa'i shes bya'i dus deb de lag par blangs te lta gin bsnad pa'i skabs zhig la chung bdag lags thab tshang nas yong ste/‘ā+o da/shes bya'i gsar 'gyur tshang ma rnying pa red/de las 'di klog gnang ’zhes ṭims apha in ḍi ya slogasar shog cig blo bzang la sbrad/blo bzang gis ‘6theng yu ’’zhus te gsar shorga de klog gin bsnad/skar ma bco lnga tsam phyin pa'i rjes su ngag dbang gis sbyi thab nas kha lag 'khyer yong ba dang mnyam du sgrol ma yang nang la 'khrid de slebs/ chung bdag lags kyis sbyi thab kyi kha lag kring mo ga dang / zhog be ga dang phing gnyis bsres pa'i tshal gyi skyor rogs su lda li dang sha tshal zhig bathos sku da pa de dag rgya cog gi steng du sgrig ste khong tsho tshang mas mnyam du nyin gung gi za ma bzas/ kha lag zas tshar ba dang ngag dbang gis ‘‘chung bdag lags/de ring blo bzang nga gnyis 'khyug tsam zhig dha shod la 'cham 'cham phyin na 'grigs kyi red pas/’’zhes sdus/ chung bdag lags kyi sems kyi gting du ngag dbang phyi la gtong 'dod med kyang skabs der blo bzang 4411ba rngu50ky-i1baspu1'i sa/dzi57rdu9'i9dzi1

gangs skyid kyi ma'apyon thechenas/ spro99yod sar 'grigs kyi ma red ces lab ma phod par ‘‘'grigs kyi red/ khrom nas zhor la nyo cha yang brgyab shog yin na'ang mgyogs po shog ma gtogs nang du dug log dang thab snod 'khyu yag mang 〈sna 'dug da/’ zhes baji+od/ chung bdag lags kyi skad cha shod stangs de la bltas na ngag dbang khong gnyis 'cham po e yod snyam pa zhig blo bzang la byung /de nas ngag dbang dang blo bzang gnyis ga ler dha shod phyogs su bskyod/ lam du gom stabs ga ler bgrod pa dang lhan du blo bzang gis ngag dbang la 66khyed rang dang skye dman gnyis 'cham po yod pas/’’zhes dris/ ngag dbang gis ‘6da sngo gas po ga re lab dbe sa red/ 'cham po med zer na ni yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig yod red/ yod zer na ni med pa 'dra po zhig red/ bud med tshang ma 'di 'dra skusnad srid kyi ma red/gal te tshang ma 'di 'dra rang yin na ni ngas khyed rang la chang sa zer yag de ga dus kyang ma rgyag ang zhes baji+od 'dod 'dug’ ces brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘‘de 'dra yin na chang sa mgyogs wabyu de 'dra brgyab nas gang byed/lo kha shas ma sgugs par gang byed/lhamices brjod/ ngag dbang gis ‘‘mi zer mkhan 'di la mngon shes med pa'i skyon 'di red/ ngas thog ma nas 'di 'dra skusgong ba shes kyi sku da na da grwa pa byed sa red/ da dbar la rgya gu sgor tshar ba skusnang tsang byed thabs gang yang mi 'dugalas red bsam ste ba1snad sgom byas te 1snad rgyu las gzhan thabs shes mi 'dugami’ces brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘6dka' ngal dngos gnas de ga re red/’’ces dris/ ngag dbang gis rang nyid kyi lham gyi rting pa sa la brud pa dang mnyam du

200 mi tshe'i dre ba mngar skyur/nyi zer skyob pa'i mig shel nag po de mar phud de stod thung khra khra de'i sba khug nang du 'jug bzhin pa'i ngang nas ‘‘dka' ngal dngos yod de mi la shod du song na shod mi shes pa zhig red/ ngas da lta bar du su la'ang bshad med la/ bshad nas phan thogs yod pa'ang mthong gi mi 'dug gang yin zer na gang zag gnyis kyi dbar la khams mi mazun pa dang /lta ba mi mazun pa/ 'jig rten lta stangs sogs la 'gal ba yod na/ de sel ba'i thabs la thog mar der gcig gis gcig la bsdun shes dang / bsam shes/ go shes nyan shes/ lhag par du rang skyon ngos 'dzin zub pa dang /gzhan gyi yon tan mthong zub pa zhig nges par du dgos kyi red dran gyi 'dug cha rkyen 'di rigs ni 'gal zla ba gcig la tshang gi med na dka' ngal sel thabs yong rgyu sbros bral red/ rgyal khab gnyis kyi dbar la yin na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs gnyis kyi dbar la yin na'ang 'dra/yang chos lugs gnyis kyi dbar la yin na'ang 'dra/de bzhin bza' tshang gi dbar la yin na'ang 'dra/gang ltar lag pa gcig gis thal yo brdab mi zub pa nang bzhin red/mi’ces brjod/ blo bzang gis 66de 'dra'i khams mi mazun pa ga re 'dugami’ces dris/ ngag dbang gis 6‘sbyir btang gtam gyi dbe la/ rang skyon ri bo ltar che na'ang 'geb sla/ gzhan skyon khab mig ltar chung na'ang 'tshol sla/ zer ba ltar gzhan la skyon 'tshol rgyu de las sla po sku nga tsang ngas lab na khyed rang phal cher yid ches mdog kha po ma red de/ yin na'ang khyed rang gis dris tsang ngas mdor bsdus thig bzhad pa yin na/ chung bdag gis nga po rang kho nar bdag pa'i rtsed chas sam/yang na/a lad pad gog cig nang bzhin rtsis pa ma gasto gas/ dga' sdug gi tshor ba cadang thub mkhan gyi mi zhig yin pa'i bsam blo

gangs skyid kyi mtshan themyunas/ 20sprortsa ba nas gtong gi yod pa ma red/ 'jig rten 'di'i nang gi sems can tshang mar mang nyung la ma ltos pa'i skyon gyi cha dang yon tan gyi cha gnyis ka 'dzoms yod pa red bsam gyi yod/dber na/ma'o tse tung la cha bzhag na skyon mang po yod pa red de/kho la yon tan gyi cha yang mang po yod red/ ma zhi bar du rgya nag mi ser sa ya mang pos kho la mthong dang brtsi 'jog byas pa de khos btsan gnon gdug rtsub btang ba kho na la 'jigs skrag gis yin gyi ma red/ rgyal khab chen po de tsam zhig la rang 'dod ltar dbang sgyur byed zub pa'i bsod nams dang dbang thang zhig tan tan yod red dran gyi 'dug ma red pas/ ’zhes dris/ blo bzang gis 6‘de 'dra bo 'dug da yin na'ang rgya gar gyi kha skad la ma song na pahili ju tī 5 ma byas par khar thug la shod dang / ’zhes bskul/ der ngag dbang gis mu mazud de ‘‘chung bdag lags kyis nga la 'dzam gling nang gi skyon yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsnoms pa'i skyon gyi gong bu zhig ma gtogs yon tan gyi cha stal 'bru tsam yang med pa zhig rtsi gi yod/mo rang la cha bzhag na skyon gyi cha nas rang don kho ga bcug rgyu ngoms kyi khengs pa can/ gzhan la bsam shes sped pa/ chags snang dang phrag dog nga rgyal gyi gong bu/mig ser tsha bo/mdor na dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la zhugs pa lta bu zhig yod la/sku1na tan gyi cha nas bshad na/ nang las 'jon po dang / las kar ngar po/ gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten la do snang chen po/zhal 'don byed rgyu dang /phyag mchod 'bul byed par hur po/ phru gu dang rang nyid kyi pha ma gnyen 'brel la brtse gdung chen bo bcas yod red de/ nga'i ngo shes dang / dga' nye blo dkar/ pha ma dang sbrun mched su yin kyang 45gnas tshul thad kar mi sgod par bsgor nas zhod pa'i don yin/

202 mi che'i zo ba mngar skyur/mthong chung dang smad ra gtong ba/ khong tsho'i ming tsam go na'ang mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa/ tha na blo dkar sems gtsang gis lag rtags chung chung zhig sbrad kyang mi len par phyir slog byed pa sogs byed kyi yod/ de bzhin ngas rgyun du phyi la mi gzhan dag dang mnyam du skad cha shod pa dang 'brel ba byas pa sogs byas na mo rtsa ba nas dga' gi med/ yang nang du khu sim mer deb 'dra klog ste bsnad na'ang dga' gi med/ mdor na/ ngas lus ngag gis 'gul bskyod byas tshad nor 'thul dang skyon la rtsis mkhan zhig yod/’’ces baji+od/de mtshams nas khong gnyis lha zhod kyi khrom du slebs pas ja khang zhig tu ja 'thung bar phyin/ ja 'azung bzhin pa'i skabs su blo bzang gis da gin ngag dbang gis gang bshad pa de'i thog la bsam blo 'khor bzhin du 66de 'dra yin na ngag dbang khyed rang la dka' ngal tan tan 'dug nga'i bsam par khyed rang gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs ni 'grig thag chod 'dug gru gu bu po sting rje po zhig ni 'durgu de bzhin gnyis ka la gzhung gi las ka ni yag thag chod 'dug bas skyid po 'dug snyam ste rjes su yi rangs skyed dgos pa zhig byung / da lta byas dus mi’zhes cang ma smras par khya sim sper bsnad rjes mu mthud de ‘‘da yin na yang dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis/bltas na skyid skyid 'dra ba'i 'jig rten gyi phyan tshogs/thob na rang rang skabs kyi sdug bsngal re 'dug pa/'a2la snang bde ba'i gnas skabs rmi lam tsam song rjes/ cis kyang rang sems skyo ba'i rkyen sna re 'dug pa/ zhes gsungs pa de dngos po'i gnas tshul red/ ma red pas mi zhes brjod/ ngag dbang gis ‘6red

gangs skyid kyi mtshan ༄gis/ 203red/ da ga rang red/ dge chos lags kyis de'i mjug thog de ga rang du /re dogs 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi+o/ /thu+ogs 'byung dga' ba'i nyams kyi 'a ma dang 'dres pas/ /bza' btung langs sbyad phyi yi skyid chas tsam 'grigs kyang / blo bde gu yangs nang gi skyid nyams de mi 'dug /gsungs 'dug pa de yang bden pa ma red dam ’’zhes gad mo shor bzhin baji+od blo bzang gis ‘6gnas stangs de 'dra yin na khyed rang ga 'dra byas te snod kyi yod ’’ces sdus/ ngag dbang gis 66da bsad na ches/ brdung na chung / zer ba nang bzhin red/ kha bral dgos bsam dus ni bu mo de blos phod kyi mi 'dug 'di 'dra byas te mu mazud rgyu ni khag po 'dug ste/ skyid kyang bla ma dkon cog sdug kyang tshe sngon las red zer ba ltar tshe sngon ma bud med kyis kha brdung bzed rgyu'i las zhig bsgos yod pa yin gyi red bsams te/ skabs re snying rje 'dra bsgom/ skabs re snang med du btang ste 'jog gi yod/ phar bshad tshur bshad byas te go brda 'phrod mkhan zhig yin na go brda sbrad na 'grigs kyi red de/ besna brda 'phrod mkhan gyi rigs de ma red/ rang shed che ba la dbe bsags tshar ba red/ ngas skad cha ma bshad par bsnad na/ skad cha shod kyi mi 'dug 'dam 'bag gis ba༄tes pa'i mi red/ ces zer gyi yod/ skad cha bshad na ni lam seng chig re re bzhin go ba gzhan par blangs te/rgyab 'dre rgyag rgyu 'go btsugs kyi yod red/gzhan pa phar bzhag ste nga'i mig gi lta stangs dang / rnam 'gyur ston stangs tshun chad nas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces skyon baji+od byed kyi red ’’ces brjod/ blo bzang gis bran bu ya mtshan

lha04 mi che'i sgo ba mngar skyur/bskyed pa dang bcas ‘‘byas na thog mar khyed gnyis ga 'dra byas te 'dzoms pa red ’ ces dris/ngag dbang gis 66thog mar thug dus 'di 'dra mi 'dugasems pa dkar mdog kha bo/ brtse gdung che mdog kha po/ kha yang nyung mdog kha bo/ mi la bstun shes che mdog kha po 'dug skabs de dus ngas phyi ma bya'i sgro mdangs mdzes pa de ma gtogs/nang mi gtsang dug gi kha rlangs de tshor yod pa ma red/'di 'dra'i skabs su deng sang phyi rgyal gyi lugs 〈snal la chang sa ma brgyab bo nga la lo shas phan tshun brtag dbyad byas te khams dang dbang po cha kun nas mazun min lha ba'i lugs srol 'di yag po red bsam gyi 'dug mi 'dug gam ’ zhes sdus/ blo bzang gis der 66red red/ mi tshe gcig gi skyid rogs sdug rogs song tsang /chang sa ma brgyab sngon la phan tshun yag po byas te ngo shes pa byed rgyu dang /gcig gi khog tshod gcig gis lon pa byed rgyu de dngos gnas gal chen po red/ dus yun lo kha shas sgug dgos kyang sgug rgyu red/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la brtag dpyad nan tan byas te thag bcad tshar nas da gzod dka' ngal 'phrad kyang sdug rus rgyag rgyu red/ gcig gis gcig la blos gtong yang byed dgos pa red la/phan tshun bsam shes kyang byed dgos pa red/ 'di 'dra ma byas na mi tshe skyid po yong rgyu spros bral red ririces brjod/de mtshams nas blo bzang gis slar yang ‘6gal te ngas chung bdag lags su skad cha zhig bshad na ga 'dra byas sku nga ’zhes sdus/ngag dbang gis lam seng 66ga pa/ ga pa/ de 'dra sgod rgyu bsam blo'i yul la'ang ma 'ardzog ma gtogs/ de nas nang gtam phyi la skyel 'dug zer nas nga skyid du 'jug gi ma red/ skad cha bzhad nas nyan mkhan de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ ngas

gangs skyid kyi mtshan ྅6nas/ lha05'jam byas na e dragartsub byas na e dragathabs shes med na ma gtogs yod tshad byas pa'i khyal yin te/ 'gyur ba 'gro yag mi 'dug phal cher zhing rgan hreng pa nang bzhin phyogs gcig la hreng tshar ba 'dra ’’zhes baji+od bzhin du rang gi lag par btags pa'i chu tshod der bltas te slar yang mu mazud de ‘‘da 'phyi po byas 'dugang gnyis log na ma gtogs yang don med kha brdungs bzed dgos red ’’ces smras/de nas khong gnyis kyis dha shod khrom nas dgos mkho'i rigs nyo dgos pa nyos te chu tshod bzhi pa ma zin tsam zhig la gangs skyid du log/ngag dbang ni slob grwar yod dus nas mi gzhis ka 'jam po dang / su byung tshang mar 'asdus bde po/ dran rkyen pa dang rgyu dgas bzang po/ slob sbyong la dmigs bsal 'dun pa de tsam med kyang rig snyobs che bas 'bad brtson la de tsam bsten mi dgos par yig rgyugs las sla por 'phrod zub mkhan/gtsang sbra 'brod bsten la de tsam gyi do snang med kyang rang byung gi khor yug la dmigs bsal sbro snang che bas rgyun du me tog dang /zhing sdong gi lo ma sna tshogs/de bzhin bya dang bye'u'i sgro sogs bsdu rub kyis 'bri deb kyi zhog bu'i dbar la nyar tshags byed pa dang / 'bu rigs sna tshogs bzung ste shel dam nang du nyar ba/ chu tshod dang rlung 'asrin sogs 'phrul 'khor gyi rigs bathig sgrig byed rgyur dga' po/ dus tshod stong pa nam yin la rang nyid gcig pur zhing sdong gi 'og tu bsnad de gangs ri dang sgrin pa chu klung sogs kyi mdzis sdug gi dpal nyams su cadang zhing g.yas g.yon la bltas te snod kyi yod pas 11ba 11gas gzhan dag tshos kho la skabs re sayanasi/ pa lags sam/ tshan

206 mi che'i bro ba mngar skyur/rig gi pa pha zhes ming 'dogs byed kyi yod/ gzugs chabs rgyag pa yin pa gang zhig la/ sha mdog gro shun gyi mdog mig 'gor la sna leb pa/ skad cha shod skabs stod pa'i skad kyi gdangs 'khyul med du yod pa zhig yod/ slob grwa thon pa'i rjes su'ang gzugs po ring du dang /sha phran bu skam du phyin yod pa dang /bsam blo gtong phyogs dang lta ba 'khyer tshul la 'gyur ba shugs che phyin pa ma gtogs de min chung dus kyi gzhis ka ngang rgyun ring po dang / bzod bsran chen po/ 'dod chung chog shes che ba/ 'dris rtag pa dang dgo' nye'i la rgya srung rgyu bcas kyi thad la 'gyur ba rtsa ba nas phyin med/nyin gcig gangs can skyid gshongs kyi spyi thab tshogs khang gi nang du dha sa sa gnas gzhon nu'i dpal 'byor bsdu 'god kyi ched du go sgrig byas pa'i mtshan tshogs zhig tshugs/ de'i nyin gangs skyid kyi las byed pa gzhoskoskyes tsho dang / de bzhin bod khyim steng shod dang / meg loḍa/ zlos gar bcas nas kyang pho gsar mo gsar mang po mtshan tshogs der slebs/ mtshan tshogs go sgrig pas de zhub dgong dro'i mdzad rim bkod pa ltar/ thog mar gsol ja bzhes tog dang / de nas dgong tshigs 'bras dang kring mog bzhes mog grang tshal dang sha tshal/ sngo tshal dang ming tshal/ bod ja dang mngar ja/ de bzhin bi yar dang chab mngar sogs gang 'dod 'degs 'bul zhus pa'i rjes su sa bcad ma stong tsam gyis bod gzhas sgor gzhas thengs kha shas zhig 'khrab/ bod gzhas de dag 'khrab skabs kyang rgan pa tha re tho re zhig las gzhon skyes mang che bar kha nas gzhas chig thon rgyu med pa'i khar

gangs skyid kyi mtshan thogis/ 207rdog sgra de dag kyang tsong dang sgog pa bajungs pa lta bu zhig yod/ chu tshod dgu pa zin mtshams zhig la khang pa'i rtsig pa sger ba dang / nyan pa po'i rna ba ral 'gro ba lta bu'i phyi gling pa'i rol dbyangs tshig 'dzin na go rgyu med mkhan/ don bzung na 'char rgyu sped mkhan/dbyangs nyan na 'gyur khyag med mkhan/sbyang ki dang /'phar ba/wa mo/stag dang seng ge glang chen/ khyi sbyang sogs tshang ma sdeb gcig la ngus pa'i sgra gdangs dang 'dra ba zhig gi 'og tu bod pa'i pho gsar mo gsar tshos gcig gi mdun du gcig langs/ gcig gi gdong la gcig gis lta zhing rkang pa zha la'i steng du phyi 'dred nang 'dred dang / daphyi mgo phar g.yug tshur g.yug byas te/ bod kyi sto thang gi steng du phyi bas dred mong yong min so lta byed pa nang bzhin gyi ḍan si zhes pa de 'khrab 'go tshugs/ ḍan si zhes pa 'di 'khrab dus bod pa'i gzhon skyes tsam ma yin par a ma dang pa ba rgan 'khogs gdong gnyer mas khengs/ skra kha bas bkab/gzugs po gzhu ltar gug tshar yod pa 'ga' zhig la'ang bod rang btsan thob pa ltar nam langs 'gro gi yod/ khong tsho'i bsam par phyi rgyal du slebs te ma 'ongs bod kyi 'dzugs sgran dang yar rgyas la sman pa'i gsar btod kyi rig gsar gzhan ma shes kyang / balha phrag nyer gcig gi mi gral la tshud pa'i phyir ḍan si rgyag myong /glog brnyan lta myong /zer yag cig bzo dgos snyam pa'ang yong srid pa yin/de nyin can dhi ghar nas zla ba sgrol ma dang / g.yang 'dzo+oms kyang slebs skusnad pas dus yun gang 'tsham zhig gi bar du khong gnyis kyis blo bzang dang / ngag dbang /chung bdag lags/de bzhin ngo shes pa'i las byed 'ga' nig dang mnyam du skad cha

lhaX8 mi che'i blo ba mngar skyur/bshad de bsnad/de mtshams zhig nas zla ba sgrol mas blo bzang la ‘‘blo bzang /da ḍan si 'khrab ka 'gro gi min nam ’zhes dris/blo bzang gis 66da gin bod gzhas shes pa kha shas zhig ni 'khrab tshar ba yin/da ḍan si zer yag 'di shes kyi'ang med la/ 'khrab 'dod kyang mi 'dug khyed rang 'khrab 'dod skusnad na 'khrab gnang mi zhes baji+od/der g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘blo bzang /zla ba sgrol ma la rogs pa byos/ yo la 'khrab rogs med na ga 'dra byas te 'khrab kyi red ’’ces bskul/ blo bzang gis 66ḍan si zer yag 'di la 'khrab rogs gcig yin gcig min gnyis dgos red sus zer gyi 'dug gam/ ltos dang 'khrab rogs med par 'khrab mkhan ga tshod 'dug ’rices tshogs khang nang du bu dang bu mo rang nyid kher rkyang 'khrab mkhan de tsho la masbyob brda byas te baji+od/g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘ā+ong /zla ba sgrol ma/da blo bzang la re ba ma byed/snying rje grwa pa sgod sgod bzhag zhogade las khyed rang gi rogs pa ngag dbang gis byed kyi red ’ces ngag dbang la lta zhing smras/de nas zla ba sgrol mas ngag dbang la bltas te/ ‘‘'khrab kyi yin pas mi’zhes dris pas ngag dbang gis chung bdag lags mi gzhan zhig gi mnyam du 'khrab nas bsdad pa mthong ste/ 6‘'grigs kyi red mices brjod de zla ba sgrol ma'i mnyam du langs te skar ma bathe lnga tsam zhig 'khrab/ de rjes slar yang g.yang 'dzo+oms kyis skul ma byas pa bzhin ngag dbang gis g.yang 'dzoms kyi mnyam du'ang 'khrab thengs 'ga' shas 'khrab/mtshan gyi chu tshod bcu gnyis yol grabs byed pa'i skabs zhig la ngag dbang gis chung bdag laṭa nang du log tshar ba shes te/ blo bzang dang / zla ba sgrol ma/g.yang 'dzo+oms bcas la gzim 'jam gnang go zhus rjes kho pa'ang nang du 'o ga

gangs sgyid kyi mtshan themyunas/ lhaX9nang du slebs pa dang ngarig dbang gis 6‘da ring khyed rang nga la 'gro gi yin kyang ma lab par 'di 'dra mchuthogs po 5ོga tshar 'dag yang ga re byas d+dho/nga ’’zhes dris/chung bdag gis mig log cig bltas te/ byu‘nga rma log 2 khyed rang la gnod skyel gyi yod sa red/ da khyed rang log yong nas ga re byed rkya 'byol mo de tsho'i mnyam du mtshan gang ma bsnad par ga re byas te log yong pas ’’zhes baji+od/ ngag dbang gis ‘‘da ga re zer gyi ji+o5ོda /ga re 'dod nga khengs ma song /khong gnyis kyi mnyam du gzhas kha zhas zhig 'khrab pa la ga re yod red ’’ces smras / chung bdag gis ‘'a(nga khyod/ngas ha go gi yod/da ring gzhas 'khrab/sang nyin kha skyel/gnangs nyin mnyam du nyal byed rgyu'i bsam blo yod red pa/ gzhang tshong ma de tsho ni dha ram sa lar khyo ga 'tshol du yong ba red/ de tshol khyod rang 'dra po de 'dra ma gtogs rag sa yang ma red ’’ces skad shusas chen po'i sgo nas rlung che ru phyin pa lta bu zhig byas te baji+od/ngag dbang gis 66khyed rang don med mi la 'di 'dra'i snyon 'dzugs ma byed/ khong gnyis kyis nga ngo shes kyi yod tsang 'khrab rogs byed lab pa red/ de min nga tsho'i dbar la 'brel ba gang yang med ’’ ces ba1snad/ chung bdag gis ‘ā+ong / khyed rang lam seng 'chal po de tsho'i phyogs byed kyi red/ khong tsho de 'dra'i yag po yod na khong snu'i mnyam du rgyugs/ mi tshe kho rang kho nga tsho'i mnyam du gzhas 'khra/ ba nas sdod/ nang la log 5ོ/nga nas ga re byed ka zhes baji+od/ ngag dbang gis tsho ‘gzhas da khyed rang gis kyang nga ma yin par mi mang po'i mnyam du 'khrab kyi 'dug ga de la skyon med pa zhig dang ngas 'khrab pa la skyon yod pa zhig ga re yin nam ’’zhes dris/ chung bdag lags kyis 6‘skyon med na da dung 'khrab ga rgyugs/ g.yang

210 mi tshe'i zo ba mngar skyur/'dzo+oms zer mkhan 'phrul mo des nga'i mnyam du gzhas 'khrab khul byas pa ma gtogs mig de ga dus yin na'i khyed rang la bltas nas snod kyi 'dug de yang 'phrul mig dang 'dod chags kyi mig de 'dra red/ skye dman 'di tsho la can dhi ghar la rgya gar saka dhar de 'dra ga re byas te rag gi med dam/ 'di nas yar yang yang ga re byas te yong gi yod dam/’’ces baji+od/ ngag dbang gis da yag po rang byed sa ma red bsam ste bzang lan ngan lan gang yang ma 'jal bar rang gi gyon chas rnams phud de mal gzan gyi nang du nyal te bsdad/ skar ma lnga tsam zhig phyin pa'i rjes su chung bdag gis glog sbar te ‘‘'chal po 'di yis nga skyid du 'jug gi mi 'dug dkon cog mkhyen nga 'di 'dra'i dmyal ba myong dgos pa gang yi na nam ’’zhes srog rlung drag tu 'phar nas thab tshang nang gi dkar yol dang sder ma sogs sa la brdab ste bcags/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis bu mo sgrol ma'ang gnyid sad de yar langs/ sgrol ma ngus pa dang mnyam du chung bdag laṭa yo rang yang ngu gin bsnad/ngag dbang gis sgrol ma pang par blangs te byams po byas nas slar yang gnyid khyag tu bcug rang nyid kyang gnyid du 'gro ba'i thabs shes ji tsam byas kyang / chung bdag lags kyis rgyun du yid ches blo 'gel mi byed pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / ral gri las kyang rno ba'i mi sting dum bur gtong ba'i tshig mtshon/ nyes med nyes 'gel gyi bsnyad 'dogs/mthong chung khyad gsod dang dma' 'bebs byed pa/ngo r+shas pa dang gnyen sbyan gyi mdun sar go rgyu btang ste dma' 'bebs byed pa sogs blo la 'khor te rang nyid bzod dka' ba'i dmyal khams su lhungs pa lta bu zhig snung ba dang /

gangs skyid kyi mtshan māṅgas/ 211yang skabs re 'di dag rang gis skye ba sngon mar bsags pa'i las kyi rnam smin dus su smin pa zhig yin gyi red snyam ste las bdag gir byed 'dod pa'i kun slong yang skye ba sogs byas te gzhog g.yas brje g.yon brje byed bzhin bsnad pas gang 'tsham zhig nas gnyid kyi zhing khams su skabs cig bde ba can du gnas phos pa ltar song /blo bzang dang / zla ba sgrol ma/ g.yang 'dzoms gsum zhogs pa'i chu tshod gnyis pa bar du bsnad rjes blo bzang gi las shag tu log gzhan dag bu dang bu mo bsnoms pa'i gzhon skyes nyi shu tsam zhig gis zhogs pa'i chu tshod bzhi pa bar du ḍan si mu mazud de 'khrab nas bsnad/ de nyin pho gsar gnyis ra bzi ste bu mo gcig gi don la rgyab 'dre shor te rogs pa gzhan dag tshos ma bkag na phan tshun gri rgyag rgyu'i mtshams su slebs grabs kyang byas/ gnas tshul 'di rigs mtshan tshogs kyi skabs 'ga' zhig la yong bzhin yod/ sang casnags der chu tshod brgyad pa tsam zhig la zla ba sgrol mas zhogs ja bzos te blo bzang dang g.yang 'dzoms gnyis yar blangs/ khong tsho gsum gyis zhogs ja 'thung tshar ba'i rjes su g.yang 'dzoms kyis 6‘de ring nga tshor 'char gzhi ga re yod red ’’ces blo bzang la dris/ blo bzang gis 6‘dmigs bsal 'char gzhi de 'dra med/ khyed rang gnyis ga par 'ah+pho 'dod 'dug gam/ da 'khyams sa dmigs bsal de 'dra ni yod pa ma red ’’ces baji+od/zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘de ring nga tsho meka loḍa dang gtsug lag khang du 'aglo de rjes dha shod la slog brnyan zhig lta bar phyin na'ang 'grigs kyi ma red pas ’’ces brjod/

21 2 mi che'i sngatho ba mngar skyur/blo bzang gis ‘‘red red/ dang po mchod mjal zhig zhud+dha// de nas bod kyi mgron khang du nyin gung kha lag cig bzas/ da dung dus tshod 'dug na ltad mo lta bar phyin na'ang mi 'grigs pa mi 'dug ’’ces ba13da/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘byas na ngag dbang yang 'gro gi yod 'gro skad btang na ma red pas ’’zhes dris par blo bzang gis gnas stangs shes kyi yod tsang ‘‘da ngag dbang skad ma gtong /phru gu dang nang mi yod ma/ban gyi mi la las ka mang the sku'od red/ nga tsho nang bzhin stabs bde po yod pa ma red ’’ces baji+od/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘'a(nga / kho rang gi skye dman de ngas dbang che mdog kha po zhig mthong skusnang / skad cha shod stangs dang rnam 'gyur ston stangs nas ngas ha go bi 'dug ’’ces baljod/blo bzari gis 66da gtam gyi dpe la/skyung kas skyung kar zhod res mi 'dug mchu to dmar po 'dra 'dra red/ zer ba nang bzhin rjesar ma khyed rang gnyis kyang chang sa brgyab tshar na de nang bzhin min 'gro ’’zhes gad mo thor bzhin brjod/der g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘‘blo bzang /bu mo tshang ma gcig pa yod pa ma red da/ lar nas nga rang tsho bod pa'i sbyi tshogs kyi nang du bza' tshang ma 'grisas pa zhig byung na skyon de lam seng bud med kyi mgo la g.yog rgyu de yag po ma red/ skabs re khyo gas ma 'grigs pa'ang yod red/ skabs re bud med kyis ma 'gigs pa'ang yod red/de ngos len byed dgos pa red ’’ces baji+od/blo bzang gis ‘6khyed rang gis lab pa de bden pa red/ ngas mtha' gcig tu rgyab skyor byed kyi yod/da lta bud med zer dus ngas dran pa gsos song /khyed rang gi bud med tshogs pa 'i las ka de ga re byas song ’’zhes dris/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘6bud med tshogs pa'i las ka de 'grigs song / zla ba rjes ma'i tshes gcig nas

gangs skyid kyi mtshan nyo6kas / lhakro3las ka mgo 'dzugs byed rgyu yin/ 'on kyang bud sped tshogs pa la pas snyeg so sos thabs shes byas na ma gtogs sru+od yag med zer gyi 'dug byas tsaḥri da res nga dha sar khang pa zhig thabs shes byed par yong ba yin/ khang pa 'grigs na gzhis chags su 'khyug tsam phyin te de nas las ka 'go 'dzugs rgyu red ’’ces brjod/blo bzang gis 66byas na yas/ po byung 'dugazla ba sgrol ma khyed tsharing ga re thag sacod byas pas/ bi eḍa byed rtsis yin nam zhes sdus/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘da ngas bi eḍa byed rgyu thag bcad tshar ba yin/ g.yang 'dzoms med par can dhi ghar la da dung lo gcig snod dgos pa de phran bu nyob sa red de/ yin na'ang nyi sgron gyi grogs mo zhig bi e byed par yong gi 'dugabyas tsang lo gcig mo'i mnyam du khang pa glas te snod rgyu byas pa yin ’’zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘ byas na nyi cha/ kha shas 'di gar ngal sa/41 rgyobs rizhes ba1snad/zla ba 〉tel mas 6‘nyi cha/ gsurma bzhi zhig 'di gar bsnad de de nas ma su ri la 'khyug tsam zhig nang mir thug 'phud du 'gro 'dod 'dug yin na'i lam la gcig bu 'gro rgyu 'di blo bde po zhe drags mi 'dug ’’ces baji+od/ der g.yang 'dzoms kyis ‘6blo bzang rang nyi ma gnyis gsum zhig dgongs pa zhus te zla ba sgrol ma skyel 3stogles byas na 'grigs kyi ma red dam/’mizhes dris/ blo bzang gis ‘‘red red/ nga yang pa lags a ma lags sang tsho dang / nyi sgron dang lhag pa bcas la ma thug par dus yun gang tsam phyin sdu'ong / thug 'phrad 'khyug tsam zhig sku1nga gi red/ byas na de ga rang byed rgyu byas/ ma red pas ’’zhes zla ba sgrol mar lta zhing smras pas zla ba 〈snal mas bzhin 'adz+nyom pa dang bcas mgo bo gug tsam zhig byas/

214 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/de nyin khong tsho gsum gyis thog mar gtsug lag khang du mchod mjal la phyin te mi re res gser kong re phul nas smon lam btab/ de nas lha mo dang gnas chung la 'phrin bcol re phul rjes gtsug lag khang la bslor rar 'gro skabs/ de nyin tshes pa bco lnga 'khel bas phyag 'tshal mkhan dang / mchod me 'bul mkhan/ bskor ba byed mkhan/ kha 'don gyer mkhan/ sgom rgyag mkhan sdu'ogs bod mi rgan gzhon mang po yod pa'i khrod du phyi rgyal ba mgo ser po'ang mi nyung ba zhig yod pa mthong /gtsug lag khang gi rgyab ngos nas mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi rdo skas ring po de babs te khong gsum meka loḍa phyogs su bskyod skabs lam du 11 phyogs nas yong ba'i grwa bstan 'dzin thug blo bzang gis phar ngo yag po shes kyi med kyang bstan 'dzin gyis blo bzang lam seng ngo shes te/ ‘‘blo bzang lags/ bkris bde legs/ nga mdang dgong rang lho phyogs nas slebs pa yin/ dge bshes dpal ldan lags kyi dge phrug yin/ dge bshes lags kyis khyed rang la phyag bris zhig dang / phyag rtags thig bskur gnang song / phyag bris de gal chen po yin gsungs gnang gi 'dug nga dngos gnas byas na gangs skyid du mar bcar rtsis yin/ da 'di gar mjal te yag po byung song ’’zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘6a las/ dge bshes lags sku gzugs gsal thang red pas ’’zhes sdus/ bstan 'dzin gyis rang nyid kyi lag tu 'khyer yod pa'i dpyang phad ser po de'i nang nas yi ge zhig dang / ras 'thum zhig phyir phyung bzhin du ‘snyelaṭa/ dge bshes lags sku gzugs gsal thang red ’’ces zhus te yi ge dang lag rtags gnyis blo bzang la sbrad/blo bzang gis 6‘sku zhabs khyed rang nyi ma kha zhas bzhugs rtsis yod pas ’zhes dris/bstan 'dzin gyis ‘‘nyi

gangs skyid kyi mtshan ྅ṣ+ṭhanas/ 2spro5ma lnga drug cig snod rtsis yin/ nga'i sbun mched cig bod nas gnyen 'phrad du slebs 'dug kho rang zug 'phrad du yong ba yin ’’zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis ‘6bzhugs sa ga par bzhugs yod rices sdus/ bstan 'dzin gyis ‘6nga kini grwa tshang la bsnad yod ’ ces baji+od/blo bzang gis ‘6byas na marngal yong ’’ zhes zhu bzhin bstan 'dzin la lag pa zhig btang ste khong tsho sku so'i 'gro yul du song /khong gsum gyis meka loḍa ghan jir slebs pa dang khrom gzhung gi tshong khang ha lam phal che ba'i nang du 'dzul te skabs re 'di la ga tshod red/ 'di la ga tshod red/gcog cha yod pa ma red dam/ zhes sogs baji+od de kha tshong rgyag pa dang ༈skabs re ca lag sne re gnyis nyo ba sogs byas te yar 'khyams mar 'khyams dus yun gang 'tsham byas/ meka loḍa gyi the da mi'i tshong dathe na mang che bar tshong chas ṭig la gong tshad ga tshod yin min 'dri dus tshang mas kha gcig bsgrags lta bur ‘‘phyi rgyal ba dang gzhan dag la btsong na rin pa 'di 'dra zhig red/ nga rang tsho bod mi na nga tshags la rin pa 'di 'dra zhig red ’ces gong tshad mi 'dra ba gnyis brgyab su+ol zhig skusnad pas khong gsum phran bu ya mtshan bskyed dgos pa zhig byung / der brten blo bzang gis zla ba sgrol ma dang g.yang 'dzoms gnyis la ‘6tshong pa 'di tshos bzhad pa nang bzhin bod mi nang tshags la rin pa chung ba rgyag gi sku1da na yag rngopha ma red pas/ dngos gnas mi rigs kyi la rgya zer na 'di 'dra gcig la zer gyi yod mdog red ’’ces brjod/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis kyang 6‘'ong / tshong pa 'di tshos bshad pa nang bzhin byed kyi yod na da yag po red/ nga yang dga' po byung zhes

216 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/baji+od/ der zla ba sgrol mas ha ha zhes khrel dgod cig shor bzhin du ‘‘hin dī yi glog brnyan sgo le'i nang du he ma / ma li ni yis gal te rta yis zhwa dang mnyam du grogs po byas na rtas ga re bza' yi red/ ces zer gyi mi 'dug gam/ tshong pas tshong chas rkang gcig yin kyang de'i steng nas be sang ga tshod bza' e thub lta ji/ red ma gtogs spyang zhis kha nas tshil lam gyi re ba byed mkhan kho rang smyu+od pa red/dber na chung tsag gcig la cha ba'ag na skra shad ldi li'i sa nyir lha dzar gyi nang du sgor po gnyis byed sa de la 'di gar sgor po bco lnga la 'tshong gi 'dug byas tsang bod pa tshong pa tshos mah+phon khang dang / za khang / tshong khang sogs bag king ham be les nang bzhin brgyab mi 'dug gam ’mizhes smras/zla ba sgrol mas de ltar brjod pa der blo bzang dang g.yang 'dzoms gnyis mgu bo byung ste/ blo bzang gis sayas g.yon gyi mgron khang la sogs pa'i khang pa rdzig po de tshor yag por blta tsam 'ig byas te bod mi skyabs bcol ba tshos mi'i lung par 'di 'dra'i 'dzugs skrun byed zub pa de/ gcig nas bsam na sa sku sa sdug dka' las brgyab pa'i grub 'bras kyang red la/las dang dbang thang las byung ba'i bso da nams kyang red/gnyes nas byas na mi'i lung par skyabs bcol ba'i tshul du bsnad de/ sbyin bdag las g.yog po mchor ba zer ba'i dbe ltar yul mi tsho las kyang gra rgyas tsam dang nyams che tsam byed rgyu 'di nor ba min nam snyam pa 'ig kyang byung /byed yol chu tshod dang po zin mtshams thig la g.yang 'dzoms kyis khong gnyis la 66da 〈snad bog 〈snags kyi 'dug nga tsho kha lag za bar 'gro gi min nam ’ zhes dris/

gangs skyid kyi mtshan tshechokas/ 2spro7zla ba sgrol mas 66byas na za khang ga re'i nang la 'gro gi yin ri’zhes dris/ blo bzang gis ‘6ho ṭal ṭi beṭi la 'grogatsang ma dang kha lag yag po yod pa ma zad stsod sa yang yag po yod red ’ces ba ngod de khong gsum pod kyi gsol mgron khang du phyin/ blo bzang gis kha lag gi sngon la chu grang mo shel dam re mngags te 'thung bzhin pa'i ngang la dge bshes dpal lngan lags kyi yi ge nge bsngogle/sa na sa bklags/yi ge de klog tshar ba dang blo bzang ṅgas ‘cikhyad mtshar ngage bshes lags kyis da lo dgun kha'i gung seng yin cig mi na gnyis lho phyogs su shog las ka gal chen po zhig yod gsungs gnang 'dug ga re yin nam ’’zhes baji+od/ g.yang 'dzoms kyis/ 6‘da dge bshes lags kyis khyed rang grwa pa ra bcug rtsis yin gyi red/ de min gdan sa la las ka gal chen ji+o/ ga re yong ’’zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘yin gyi ma red/ phal cher yang phyi rgyal nas dge phrug /ba shas yong gi yod pa'i rtags red/ skad sgyur byed yag yin pa thag ched ’rices baji+od/ zla ba sgrol mas 66skad sgyur byed yag las sla los 'dug nyi ma la chu tshod ga tshod sgyur dgos red ’ ces dris/blo bzang gis ‘6las sla po rtsa ba nas mi 'dugalhag pa ra du chos chib mkhregs po de 'dra gsungs dus skyag pa 'phred la shor gyi 'dug de 'dra sku nga tsang ngas nyi ma re la chu tshod gnyis tsam zhig skad sbyar byas tshar ba'i rjes la sku gzhogs de tsho'i mnyam du nga rang yang dpe khrid la 'dza stagi yod/ dbe khrid smu 'gro dus rang nyid la blo bskyed dang / sngar ma shes pa mang po zhig shes kyi 'dug lho phyogs la phyin na phan thogs che shos de de red ’’ ces ba1snad/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘6byas na khyed rang da lo dgun kha lho phyogs la 'a〈sna gi yin nacha/ ’ zhes dris/ blo

218 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/bzang gis ‘‘da dge bshes lags kyis shog gsungs tsang 'gro dgos byed kyi red/ gzhan da lo rdo rje gdan dang / wa ṭ+wāṃ ṇa mi/ rwa mchog 〈snang bcas la gnas bskor zhig 'gro dgos bsam pa byung ’’zhes baji+od/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘6gnas bskor la rjes ma nga bi eḍi thon tshar nas mnyam du 'gro na 'grigs kyi ma red dam/gcig byas na lhag pa dang nyi sgron yang 'gro gi yin zer gyi 'dug khong gnyis 'gro ma thub na'ang a ma lags nges par du 'gro gi red/ snying rje/ a ma lags da lta bar du ma su ri nas phyi la thon mā+ong yod pa ma red ’’ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘yong nga / yong nga /de 'char gzhi yag po 'dug ’ ces brjod par g.yang 'dzo+oms kyis ‘6da khyed gnyis kyis nga 'khrid kyi min zer gyi yod pa red pas/khag mi 'dugargya gar gyi kha rgyun la ma song na ka byāb me ha ḍi chags sku1nga bsams kyi sku1da 'a〈sna mimizhes baji+od/ zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘khyed rang la chig rgyag byed dgos byung na yon tan 'dugazugs rjes gzigs/ nga tsho'i mnyam du yong rogs gnang / dga' bsu skusnad/ma red pas blo bzang ’’zhes baji+od/ der g.yang 'dzo+oms kyis ‘‘a tsi/ rtsed mo lab pa yin/ nga da las ka nas dgongs pa thob mdog kha po ma red/ dgongs pa thob na 'gro zub min lta gi yin ’’zhes brjod/de mtshams nas rgya cog gi steng du kha lag rlangs pa 'tshub 'tshub slebs pas khong gsum gyis kha lag rgyag tshad zos te gangs skyid sdudags su log thog ma'i 'char gzhi la de nub dgong dro der khong gsum glog brnyan zhig lta bar 'a〈sna rgyu'i bsam blo yod kyang de nyin glo bur du dha sar char pa shugs che babs pa ma zad khong gsum

gangs skyid kyi mtshan rāts+tshanas/ 219yar mar tshang ma rkang thang la bskyod pas thang chad po yang byung bar brten phyi la ma phyin par nang du ngal gso byas te bsnad/ sang nyin der blo bzang las khungs su bskyod rjes zla ba sgrol ma dang g.yang 'dzoms gnyis meka loḍa g.yas gasku na du g.yang 'dzo+oms la khang pa zhig 'tshol du phyin pas yongs gling slob grwa'i nye 'gram zhig tu khang mig gnyis can zhig la zla bar sgor yo sum brgya sbrad de gla rgyur thag bcad/nyin bzhi pa der g.yang 'dzoms rang gi gzhis chags su logade rjes su blo bzang dang zla ba sgrol ma gnyis ma su rir pha ma zug 'phrad du bskyod/de'i dgun thog der blo bzang gis las khyangs nas zla gcig ring gung seng zhus te lho phyogs su dge bshes dpal ldan lags kyi sar ba/dad de/ dge bshes lags kyi sar phyi rgyal nas ched mngags yong ba'i zhub phyogs pa'i dge phrug bcu grangs zhig la byang chub lam sgron dang / rgyal sras lag len sdu bdun ma dpe khrid gnang ba der skad sgyur phyag rogs zhu ba dang chabs cig dus tshod snyong pa nam yod la rang nyid kyis kyang dge bshes lags dang / de min gyi dge rgan gzhan pa'i sku mdun nas dpe khrid zhus/ zla ba sgrol ma yang can dhi ghar nas bi eḍa thon ma thag tu ma su ri bod khyim du dbyin ji dang sbyi tshogs rig gnas kyi dge rgan gyi sa dmigs thig thob ste/ las ka byed rgyu 'go tshugs/ g.yang 'dzo+oms ni da cha bud med tshogs pa'i dbus rgyun las kyi drung cher 'khod pa ma zad dus yun mi ring ba zhig gi nang du mdo stod sbyi 'thus su 'os 'dems yong rgyur the tshom med ba lta bu zhig yod/zla ba sgrol ma'i spun mched lhag pa ni sdi li po tā la'i 'grim 'grul khang

220 mi che'i sgo ba mngar skyur/du las ka byed kyi yod pa dang mnyam du sa gnas sazhon rta'i tshogs gtso yang yin pas rgyun du bod don dril bsgrags dang / rngam ston khrom bskor/ zas bcad ngo rgol sogs go sgrig byed ma tshar bar snod dgos pa lta bu zhig yod la/ rang nyid kyang de rigs go sgrig byed rgyur dasa' po yod pas dka' ngal yod pa'i rnam pa tshor gyi zu/da/nyi sgron ni da lta be+eng lor mtho slob tu sman pa'i slob sbyong byed bzhin pa yi/na/rang nyid gang la dga' ba'i dngos de sol ba yin kyang g.yas 'khyil bzhin du snang //gang la 'dod 'bab med pa'i dngos de gser las grub kyang rag gi rin thang meng// /snang chul lha dang 'dre ru dbye ba'i 'khor ba'i chos nyid ston nga/'i gya gyu ri lam/ /de la brten na thar 'dod skye bus gnas lugs rtogs pa'i re ba mchis sam ci//'ango/da chags dmar po'i me la brten nas dbyal phongs sto rtsang bsregs pa'i dpa'i/ 'byor gyi lam lugs//zhe snang glang po'i stobs la brten nas nyam chung pad mo 'joms pa'i dmag 'thab kyi srid byus//gti mug phag pa'i gnyid la brten nas mi gtsang 'dam du byings pa'i chab srid kyi 'gro stangs///'jig rten yongs kyi zhi bde 'joms la rnam dpyod mig dang bral ba'i glang smyon de su yin//

dus 'khor dbang chen/bco〉9/ /de ltar btsan byol du yod pa'i bod mi rnams kyis rgan gras yi na na rang gi 'tsho thabs dang / bod sbyi pa'i rtsa don/ kha 'dorna dge sbyor/ dpal snabyor 'du 'god/ sa zhing 'debs las/ sud tshong snam thags sogs kyis dus tshod bskyal ba dang / gzhon gras tshos shes yon slob sbyong dang / rig gzhung gces 'dzin/ rig gsar 'phrul las kyi sbyong brdar/nang don rig pa'i bslab pa slob gnyer/de bzhin glos brnyan lta rgyu dang dbe gsar gyi rgyan gos la sbro ba ngang gis spel ba sogs byas te/ mi yul lung par mi tshe skyel/ gyi yod kyang / kun gyi sems nang du snga phyi la ma bltos par rang gi pha yul bod ljongs chos lngan gyi zhijuri du log rgyu yong gi red snyam pa'i re sgu ga dang / dus rtag tu/ ring nas snying du bsnag pa'i 'dod pa'i don/yongs rdzogs bod ljongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ /lhun grub chos srid zung 'brel dga' ston la/ /sbyod pa'i skal bzang myur ba nyid thob sgog /ces pa'i smon lam rgyag pa dang / 'tshe ba spangs pa'i thabs lam gyi thog nas rgyal sbyi'i nang du bod kyi bden pa'i gnad don dril bsgrags byed pa dang / rgyab skyor 'tshol ba sogs

222 mi tshe'i zo ba mngar skyur/byas te dus 'da' bzhin gnas/blo bzang shes rig las khyangs su slebs te dus yun lo gsum dang phyed ka phyin pa'i dgun thog der bal yul gyi rma chu rum gdan bzo grwa'i tshong pa bstan pa dang /o ri sa stod pa'i skyid sdug 'brug pa ngag dbang 'jigs med nang mi bcas kyis ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ sbyi nor 7bo/nga sa 7skyabs mgon rin po ches gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dpal dus kyi 'khor le'i dbang chen gnang rgyu zhal bzhes thob par brten phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas nang chos la dad mos yod pa'i skyes bu grangs kyis mi langs pa zhig rdo rje gdan du 'dzo+oms/ rdo rje gdan ni/rgya gar byang phyogs kyi mnga' sde bi hār gyi grong khyer ga yā nas ki lo mi ṭar lnga drug gi rgyang thag chod pa'i bodha ga yā zhes pa'i sa gnas su yod/ gnas der bdag cag gi ston pa bkrin can mnyam med shukya'i rgyal po byang chub mchog tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mjod pa ston sa'i byang chub kyi ljon thing dang /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten/de bzhin mchod rten gyi g.yasak+to g.yon du bod dang /tha'i leṇa ḍi/nye hong / rgya nag sogs kyi lha khang dang dgon pa'ang du ma yod/ gzhan yang de'i nye 'khor du bcom lngan 'das kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas lo drug dka' ba spyad sa / ma chod rten rnam dag drung / legs skyes mas 'o thug phul sa/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod/ dpal spyalan+d+ra/ bya rgod phung po'i ri/ rgyal byed tshal la sogs pa'i dad pa'i khyan bu slong ba'i gnas mchog kyang du ma zhig yod/ mdor na/ dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis rdo rje gdan gyi gnas bshad gnang skabs rgya khyon mtsho dang

dus 'khor dbang chen/ 223'dra ba'i grong khyer du/ /rgya dpangs ri dang mnyam pa'i mchod rten dag /brgya byin ngo mtshar 'di dag gzigs pa'i slad/ /rgya gar yul du lan gcig byon par zhu/ gsungs dgos pa'ang gnas mchog 'di'i byin rlabs myong tshor byung ste gsungs yod pa thag chod/dbang chen gyi go sgrig tshogs chung dang / ma/nga' sde gzhung / byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs/ dbang chen gyi sbyin bdag de ba'in 'brel yod tshang mas khur mnyam blangs kyi thog nas skabs der mi tshogs 'bum la nye ba zhig sa der 'dzoms rgyu yin par brten/ sdod sa dang / dgos mkho/ 'thung chu dang gsang sbyod/de bzhin bde 'jags dang 'phrod bsten/ 'grim 'grul dang srung skyob sogs gang sa ci thad nas mazun rkyen dgos mkho rnams lung pa'i gnas stangs— la gzhigs pa'i 'dod blo khengs pa lta bu zhig byung yod/ go sgrig gnang mkhan tshos chu med sar chu 'then/ glog med sar glog btsugs te/ 'bras zhing gi thang chen zhig tu ras gur stong phrag 'ga' zhas phub ste chos zhu ba rnams la snod sa dang / tshong pa tsho la tshong khang dang za khang /de bzhin 'brod bsten gyi ched du sman khang / sbro skyid kyi ched du zlos gar dang glog brnyan la sogs pa'i gzigs 'bul/ dad can tsho'i ched du phyag mchod 'bul zhu sa/ gzhan yang gsung chos dwa ba sogs kyi go sgrig kyang gang legs gnang yod/dbang chen gyi skabs der thag ring nas mtshan la bltas na nam mkha'i skar tshogs sa la 'phos pa lta bu zhig dang /nyin la bltas na sdi li grong khyer rdo rje gdan du spos pa lta bu zhig yod/

224 mi tshe'i blo ba mngar skyur/skyabs mgon rirna po ches dus 'khor dbang chen thengs re gnang skabs/ skyes bu tshang ma'i yid kyi re ba skong gnang gi yod pa la the tshom sbru tsam yang med/ de ji ltar yin zhe na/ dus 'khor dbang chen du yong mkhan mang che ba gsung chos zhu rgyu dang /dbang gi byin rlabs 'jug re/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i zhal mjal dang gsung thos kyi dad 'dun bcangs te yong gi yod pas khong tshe'i blo kha chims pa da nga / 'ga' zhig ni tshong kho na don du gnyer te za khang dang tshong khang 'dzin par yong gi yod pas de dag gi 'dod pa khengs pa/ 'ga' jig ni dus tshod ring por zug 'phrad ma byung ba'i nye 'brel dang dga' nye blo dkar tsho zug 'dod kyis yo nga gi yod pa khong tsho'i 'dod blo khengs pa/ 'ga' zhig ni sku 'gyed dang mang jar re ba byas te slebs pas de dag gi blo kha khengs pa/ 'ga' 'ig ni bod mi tshos dad 'dun ji 'dra byed pa dang /cho sa byed stangs kyi cho ba/ phyag len sogs la ya mtshan te lta bar skusnang mkhan skusnad pas de dag gi re ba skong ba/ 'ga' zhig sne gtong phod can gyi sbyin pa'i bdag po tshos/ dngul dngos kyi spyin pa ga'o/nga bar re bcangs kyis yong mkhan slong mo ba tsho yang 'dod blo /wengs pa/ yang 'ga' zhig ni chos kyi byin rlabs dang / gnad don la go rtogs de tsam sped pari rkyen gyis tshe ril dang / tshe chang / srung ma dud sogs la mi thob bathig bzhig gi 'tshang ka rgyag pa tsam las de min mi tshogs kyi dkyil du yar 'khyams mar 'khyams byed rgyu dang / yul bsgor sbro 'cham byed pa'i snang ba tsam zhis la sa med kyang 'di dag gi 'dod pa'ang chims pa bcas mdor na/ chos 'dod pa la chos dang / nor 'dod — la nor/ gnyen zug 'dod pa la gnyen 'phrad/gtam 'dod pa 'a/ gtam/ byin rlabs 'dod pa la byin rlabs bcas yong gi yod/

dus 'khor dbang chen/ 225yang skabs re rwa ku sha dang / mig ras/ tshe ril dang tshe chang sogs 'grems sbrod kyi skabs su bya rgod sha la 'dzing pa bzhin 'tshang ka rgyag pa'i srol ngan pa zhig yod pa dang / lhag par du dkyil 'khor mjal kha'i skabs su sru gu chung chung dang / rgas 'khogs/nad pa/dbang po skyon can sogs tshang ka'i nang du tshud de rmas skyon zhor ba dang 'chi skyon byung ba'ang re zung yong gi yod/ skyon 'di rigs ni go sgrig gnang mkhan tshos phran bu thugs snang chung ba'i rkyen yin/dus 'khor dbang chen 'di 'dra'i skabs su bod mi dang /'abhug pa/'bras smongs pa/la dwags pa/khya zhu ba/gar sha ba/mi ti ba/glo pa/mon pa/gnyan shang ba/mu gum pa/sta mang ba/ sog po ba/nyi hong ba/ rgya mi/ sogs chos dang ngo ris gcig pa yin pa dang / yang zhub phyogs pa skro ser po dang / rgya gar ba sna ring po/ de bzhin bal po gzugs thung zung bcas mi sna 'dra min 'du 'jo+oms yong gi yod pa ltar/ dha sa nas blo bzang dang g.yang 'dzoms/ de bzhin ngag dbang nang mi/ ma su ri nas zla ba sgrol ma dang mo'i nang mi/ bal yul nas stobs 'byor dang kho pa'i sru mo bsod nams dbang mo nang mi/la dwags nas rgarme bdag rgyun tshogs/te dzu gzhis chags nas mi 'gyur dang kho pa'i bza' zla nor sgron/ ḍi ra ḍūn nas 'gyur mid/ sgo phyogs nas dge bshes dpal ldan lags/ ka sbrug nas bkris bcas tshang ma ldo rje gdan du dbang chen zhu bar slebs/ blo bzang rdo rje gdan du slebs ma thag gnas kyi byin rlabs bsam bzhin pa'i sgo nas rang nyid kyi nyin deb de'i steng du gsham gsal gyi tshigs bcad 'di ltar bris/

226 mi tshe'i gro ba mngar skyur/rnam dag zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas par/rnam smin las kyis mnar ba'i sems can dag/sna mang bde ba'i gnas la 'god pa'i phyir//sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzod khyod min su//gnas kyi mchog gyur 'phags yul rdo rje gdan//mgon gyi masnar+shag gyur 'phags mamār+shan sbyan ras gzigs//chos kyi mchog gyur dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang //bstsal ba 'di las sbyin pa'i mchog cig gang //nyin gcig blo bzang dang zla ba sgrol ma kyis gnyis mchod rten la bskor ba byed skabs blo bzang gi dpung pa'i steng du lag pa 'jog mkhan zhig yod pa tshor te rgyab slog nas blta skabs bkris yin pa shes te blo bzang gis ‘0( rdzi/bkris/bkris bde legs ’rizhes baji+od/ bkris kyis blo bzang la lag pa gtong bzhin du ‘‘bkris bde legs/ khyed rang 'gyur ba de tsam phyin mi 'dug ’’ces baji+od de zla ba sgrol ma'i gdong la yag 〈snar bltas pas zla ba 1snal mas ‘‘bkris bde legs/nga zla ba sgrol ma yin ’ zhes brjod/ bkris kyis ‘‘bkris bde legs/ khyed rang yang blo bzang gi mnyam du ma su ri la 'gro mkhan gyi gras red pa ’’ zhes dris/zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘red red/ khyed rang de ring sang ga par yod/ las ka ga re byed kyi yod ’rices skad cha dris/ bkris kyis 66nga ka sbyag tu rang 'jags yod/ slob grwa

dus 'khor dbang chen/ 2ri7mthar ma bskyal bar nang du log ste deng sang tshong rgyag gi yod/khyed rang gnyis deng sang ga par yod/ las ka ga re byed kyi yod ’ ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘nga dha ram sa lar shes rig las khyangs su las ka byed kyi yod/ zla ba sgrol ma ma su ri la bod khyim gyi dge rgan red ’’ces baji+od/ bkris kyis ‘‘kha sang nga la 'gyur med dang stobs 'byor gnyis kyang zug byung / nga tshos skad cha bshad de rgyun ring bo bsnad pa yin ’’zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘a las/ 'gyur med kyang slebs 'dug gam/ kho te rdzu gzhis chags la yod pa ngas go byung ma galta gas rtsa ba nas zug ma byung / stobs 'byor deng sang ga re byed kyi 'dug ’ces dris/ bkris kyis 6‘'gyur med kho rang gi skye dman gyi mnyam du 'dug stobs 'byor deng sang bal yul la yod zer gyi 'dug da re'i dus 'khor dbang chen gyi sbyin bdag gcig kho'i nang mi red 'dug phyug po zhe drags chags yod pa 'dra mi’zhes baljod/ blo bzang gis ‘‘gzhan pa nga rang tsho'i slob grwa gcig pa su su slebs yod med shes byung ngam ’mizhes dris/bkris kyis ‘‘'gyur med kyang slebs yod ba 'dra/yin na'ang nga la zug ma byung / khyed rang la skal lngan zug ma byung ngam/ ngas kho 'tshol gyi pe da ri ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘‘a las/ skal ldan phyi 495 la phyin pa khyed rang gis ha go ma song ngam/ kho dmag mi la 'khyug tsam zhig bsdad rjes phyi rgyal la phyin song zer gyi 'dug ’’ces baji+od/ bkris kyis ‘6byas tsang de 'dra yin gyi red/gzhan dmag sgar la yod dus nga la yi ge 'dra slebs kyi sku da ’ces ba1 da/ de mtshams zhig nas khong tsho gsum gyis ja tshong khang zhig tu ja 'azung bar ba/rtod/sang zhogs der khong tshos gcig la gcig brgyud kyis brda lan byas te nyin gung

228 mi tshe'i lnga ba mngar skyur/rgyab tu khong tshang ma byang chub mchod rten gyi rgyal sgo'i 'gram du 'dzoms rgyu byas te so so'i gnas su phyin/de nyin dus btab pa ltar blo bzang dang / mi 'gyur/ ngag dbang / bkris/ 'gyur med/ rgan bdag rgyun tshogs/ stobs 'phyor bcas tshang ma mnyam du 'dzoms/ kho nga tsho tshang ma 'dzoms tshar ba dang stobs 'byor gyis ‘‘de ring dus tshod ring bor ma thug pa'i slob 〈snags kha shas 'dzoms pa sku nga tsang nga tsho tshang ma ga yā la za khang yag po zhig gi nang du kha lag za bar 'a〈sna/ sbyin bdag nga yin ’’ zhes smras/bkris kyis 6‘red red/ byas na tshang mar yos mazun sku da pas ’’zhes dris pas tshang ma'i 'dod pa yod pa ltar khong tshos ṭika si gnyis glas te grong khyer du phyin/ chu tshod gnyis tsam zhig grong khyer gyi khrom gzhung du 'khyams rjes grong khyer nang gi skar ma lnga ldan gyi ma〈snan khang tādzo be les zhes pa'i nang du kha lag za bar phyin/ za khang nang du slebs rjes stobs 'byor gyis ‘6da tshang ma bi yar ni 'azung gi yod kyi red/semang tsang bi yar mngags kyi yin da zhes baji+od/ gzhan dag sus kyang gang yang ma baji+od kyang blosna bzang gis 66ngas 'thung gi med/ r+shasnaka cig byung na 'grigs sa red ’ ces baji+od/der mi 'gyur gyis ‘‘khyed rang tha ma ni 'thung gi mi 'dugachang sa ni da dung rgyab mi 'dug grwa pa byed rtsas med dam ’’zhes dris/ ngag dbang gis kyang blo bzang la bltas te/ ‘shes dngos gnas/ gung seng nam yin la sgo phyogs gdan sar 'a〈sna stangs la bltas na mi 'gyur gyis lab pa nang bzhin grwa pa byed rtsis yod sa red da ’zhes kha snon byas/ blo bzang gis ha ha zhes gad yo sgor tsam

dus 'kho ra dbang / 229byas pa las de min gang yang ma baji+od/de nas mi 'gyur gyis rgan bdag phun tshogs la ‘‘khyed rang deng sang ga par sku da/las ka ga re byed kyi yod ’ ces dris/phun tshogs kyis ‘‘nga'i pha ma la dwags la yod tsang nga yang la dwags bod khyim la dge rgan byed kyi 'phad ’’ces baji+od/stobs 'byor gyis ‘‘a las/ la dwags de bod dang 'dra bo yod red zer gyi 'dug de 'dra 'dug gam ’zhes sdus/ phun tshogs kyis ‘6byang thang 'brog sa 〈snags la dbyar kha sbang sto ljang thing nge yod dus 'bri g.yag dang rta drel/ de bzhin ri dwags rgo ba dang rkyang sogs mthong rgyu yod tsang dngos gnas skyid mdog kha po 'dug de min la dwags kho rang la zhing nags la sogs pa gang yang ma1snang rgyu med par ga bar bltas kyang sa skya ther re ba zhig 'dug pas bod 'dra gi e yod ’ ces baljod/de mtshams nas ma〈snan khang gi gasdu'ol zhu ba gnyis kyis rgya cog gi steng du bi yar dang chu mngar mo sgrig pas blo bzang ma gtogs gzhan dag tshang mas bi yar 'thung 'go tshugs/ bi yar 'azung bzhin pa'i ngang du stobs 'byor gyis bkris la ‘6de ring nga tsho'i mnyam du sgo nga rgyal po kho yod na ga 'dra skyid bo yod red/ de ring sang khyed rang kho la 'brel ba sku'od pas ’zhes sdus/bkris kyis 66nga la 'brel ba med ’ ces brjod/ der 'gyur med kyis 66da bla ma phyi rgyal la slebs tshar dus sbyan bsal yang brjed 'aglo ba red/ gzhan khyed gnyis 'cham po zhe drags ma red bas/slob grwar yod dus khyed gnyis kyis nga la zub tshod btang nas nga'i smyu gu 'asgogatreb dran gyi 'dug gam ri’zhes brjod/bkris kyis gad pho sgor ba dang mnyam du 6‘dran

230 mi che'i dre ba mngar skyur/gyi 'dug dalta bsam blo gtong dus dngos gnas zub tshod red pa ’’zhes baji+od/der ngargu dbang gis bkris la bltas te/ ‘‘ngas da lta'ang sgo nga rgyal po'i bu lon sgo nga gcig dang zhing tog gnyis sbrod dgos yod/ khyod len gyi min nam ’ zhes baji+od pa dang tshang ma gad po sgor/ ngag dbang gis mu mthud de 66a tsi / sku rtse zhus pa yin/ da lta bsam blo galta nga dus ka sbug slob grwa la skyid po yod pa ’’zhes baji+od/ der mi 'gyur gyis ‘sdo(nga / khyed rang gis lab pa nang bzhin slob grwa der sgyid po'ang byung la don med sems la dngangs 'tshab byas te snod dgos pa de 'dra'ang byung / da lta bsam blo gtong dus skabs re gad mo shor ba'ang yong gi 'dug ’’ ces baji+od/ snyobs 'byor gyis ‘‘de 'dra dngangs 'tshab byed dgos pa ga re byung song ’’zhes dris/ mi 'gyur gyis phun tshogs phyogs la bltas te 66phyan tshogs khyed rang gis dran gsos kyi red/ skabs de dus khyed rang rgan bdag yin pa ri’zhes dris/ rtsan tshogs kyis 66ga re'i sgor red ’rices dris/ mi 'gyur gyis ‘6skabs cig la chos dge dgra 'dul lags kyis sus bris min ha ma go ba'i yi ge zhig rnyed pa'i skor la khyed tsho rgan bdag tsho tshogs 'du mang po tshogs dgos byung ma skusnang ngam ’zhes baji+od/phyan tshogs kyis 6'a( da dran pa gsos thegang /ltas ngan sus bris pa yin nam/ yin na'ang khyed rang gis 'di skor ga 'dra byas te shes kyi yod ’rices skad cha dris/ mi 'gyur gyis ‘6yi ge de ngas rnyed semang / ngas chosi dge dgra 'dul lags su sul ba yin ’zhes baji+od ma thag tu blo bzang dang sun tshogs gnyis kas dus mnyam du ‘‘yi ge rnyed mkhan de khyed rang as ’’zhes ches ya mtshan skyes te baji+od pa dang mnyam du phun tshogs kyis 66skabs de dus

dus 'khor dbang chen/ lha3sprochos dge lags kyis nga tshor yi ge de sus rnyed min rtsa ba nas gsungs gnang yod pa ma red da/ da lta byas dus ’zhes chig mjug ma rdzogs bo nga la blo bzang gis ‘6yi ge rnyed mkhan de khyed rang red 'dug ga ’ zhes hang sang mdog kha bo byas/de rjes ngag dbang gis ‘‘da ga re red/khyed tsho tshang ma yi ge zhig gi skor la lho na thor mdog kha po byed kyi 'dug ga re ka sbug blo ba grwa la gcig gis 'bar rdzas g.yugs rtsis byas 'dug gam/ yang na rgya mi'i sku pa slebs pa red dam ’rizhes dris/ de'i rjes su rgyun tshogs dang mi 'gyur gnyis kas hang sang mdog gi rnam 'gyur dang bcas gnyis kas dus gcig tu ‘6blo bzang khyed rang skabs de dus rgan bdag ni ma red/yi ge de'i sgor la ga 'dra shes kyi yod ’ces sdus/slo bzang gis 'dzam gling zhes pa sgor sgor dngos gnas red 'dug snyam pa dang bcas 'dzum dmul te/ 6‘yi ge de nga'i stod zung sgra khug nang nas brlag pa red/de'i don la ngas nyin mtshan mang por sems khral byas te sdod dbo sa byung ’rizhes baji+od/'gyur med kyis ‘‘byas na yi ge de khyed rang gis bris pa red pas ’mi zhes dris/blo bzang gis ‘‘'bri mkhan nga ma red de 'bri sa de nga red/stabs legs pa zhig la nga la yi ge de sbrad pa dang ngas nga rang gis ming sku da sa de nas dbral ba yin ’’zhes basprod/phun tshogs kyis ‘‘byas na yi ge de'i nang du bris pa nang bzhin gyi gnas tshul de dngos gnas byung ba red dam ’’zhes nan tan du sdus/ stobs 'a〈snar gyis 6‘khong tsho ga re'i skor la gleng :snang byed kyi sku(da ba gsal wa ma shes stabs khyed tsho ga re'i skor shod kyi 'phad/ngas mabesna yag po snud ma sku nga /'gre'akha

232 mi che'i blo ba mngar skyur/bshad cig rgyobs dang ’zhes rgyun tshogs la smras/ sun tshogs kyis skabs de'i gnas tshul byung stangs kyi gsal bshad cha tshang byas te mtha' mjug der ‘‘da byung rkyen de sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig de blo bzang khyed rang gi lag pa ru 'dug nga tsho la sgo phyes te ston dang ’’zhes 'bod skul byas/ der blo bzang gis gad mo shor ba dang mnyam du bsam blo 'khyug tsam zhig btang nas byung rkyen de bzhad pa la skyon mi 'dug snyam ste ‘6da smu+o de ga dus yin nam ngas yag po dran gyi mi 'dugagang ltar dgun kha zla ba gnyis kyi gung seng skabs zhig la slob sbyi zla ba lags kyis nga tsho slob rgyag tshang ma dang / dge rgan las byed 'ga' shas bcas ṭi si ṭa chu 'gram du nyi ma gsum gyi ring la gling gar khrid gnang song / skabs de dus chu 'gram gyi khyobras zhing mang po yod sa 'ig tu nga tshos gur rtsab ste gling ga btang ba red/de dus slob phrug tshos chab gsang gtong bar nye 'khris kyi thing nags dang / dbyar kha chu rgyugs sa'i grog shur skam po de 'dra mang po 'dug pa de tsho'i nang la 'gro gi 'duganyin gnyis pa'i dgong dro der nam srod rub ma rub kyi skabs der nga rang gcig bur chab chen gtong bar grog shur thag ring sa zhig tu phyin pa yin/nga grog shur de'i nang du 'asbyol te yar tsam zhig phyin bas bu gcig bu mo gcig gi steng du 'dzegs te bsnad yod pa mthong byung / nga slebs ba dang khong gnyis yar langs te bu mo de lam seng bros phyin song /bu des nga la yud tsam zhig bltas te/kho yang gur phyogs la log song / ngas chab gsang btang tshar ba dang gur nang du log phyin pa yin/sang nyin der nga zhing sdong zhig gi 'og tu deb klog ste bsdad sku da pa'i skabs shrīg la bu de yong ste nga la yi ge sbrad byung / ngas yi ge de bklags te nga rang gi ming yod sa

dus 'kho ra dbang / 233de dbral nas sba khyag nang du nyar bsnad pa yin/ chu tshod phyed ka tsam zhig gi rjes su bu mo de nga'i sar yong nas kha nas gong yang ma baji+od par mig chu gtong gi 'dug ngas mo la khyed rang sems khral ma byed ngas gnas tshul de mi gcig la'ang bzhad mi yong / nga la yid ches gtsang ma byos lab pa yin pas mos ngu thag bcad de log song / slob grwar slebs te nyin gcig po lo rtse ba'i skabs thig la yi ge de stod thung gi sba khug nas zags te mi 'dug ’ ces baji+od/ ngag dbang gis ‘6byas na bu de su red/ bu mo de su red ’’ces sdus/ de rjes mi 'gyur gyis kyang 6'a( bu dang bu mo de gnyis su red/ zhod dang ces khong tsho tshang mas shes 'dod shugs che byas/ blo bzang gis ‘‘byung rkyen de bshad par skyon mi 'dug pas ngas bshad pa yin/ bu dang bu mo su yin ngas su la'ang mi shod rgyu'i dam bca' byas par song tsang ming 'don byed kyi min ’’zhes baji+od/ mi 'gyur gyis slar yang ‘‘byas na khong gnyis da lta mnyam du bsnad yod pa red dam ’ zhes dris/blo bzang gis 6‘de 'dra'i khyalu slo sbrad na da ha go rgyu la dka' ngal yod pa ma red/ da nga'i khog pa bsngog phyir ma gnang rogs ’ zhes baji+od/ blo bzang gis de ltar baji+od pa dang khong tsho gzhan dag tshos kyang 5mitshugs ma byas/ de mtshams nas rgya cog gi steng du kha lag spebs pas tshang mas rgyag tshad zos te phyi dre'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam zhig la khong tsho rdo rje gdan du slebs/sang nyin der mi 'gyur rang gi bza' zla nor sgron gyi mnyam du mchod rten la bskor 46khu1dzirngu gsangabarda/

234 mi tshe'i gro ba mngar skyur/ba byed bzhin yod skabs blo bzang dang thug/mi 'gyur gyis blo bzang la nor sgron ngo sbrod byas/ blo bzang dang casnar sgron gnyis kyis phan tshun 'tshams 'asdu zhu res byas/khong gsum gyis ja tshong khang zhig tu phyin te ja 'azung bzhin pa'i skabs su blo bzang gis 6‘mi 'gyur khyed rang gis skabs de dus yi ge de chos dge'i lag par phyal rgyu'i bsam blo ga 'dra byas te 'khor ba red ri ces dris/mi 'gyur gyis ‘‘de dus ngas bsam blo rtsa ba nas ma btang bar sul bzhag rjes su nga rang 'gyod pa chen po skyes par ma zad/ bdun phrag gcig gnyis kyi ring la sems pa'ang skyid po rtsa ba nas ma byung / 'on kyang btang tshar ba'i mda' mo ra log shog zer sa ni mi 'dugastabs legs pa zhig la de dus bu dang bu mo de gnyis ngo 'brod yod ba ma red ma gtogs/ gzhan slob grwa nas bton rgyu yin pa thag chod ’’ces baji+od/ blo bzang gis ‘8red da/ nga yang sems khral chen po byung / lhag par du de dus rgya gu 'ga' shas kyis gnas tshul de'i skor gleng skabs da dbe bsags song bsam pa byung ’mimi 'gyur gyis ‘6khyed rang gis bu dang bu mo de su yin min dngos gnas su gcig la'ang bshad med dam ’’zhes dris/ blo bzang gis ‘6khong gnyis kyis ngal yid ches byas te blos bkal ba song tsang / ngas glo brkus na ga nas 'grigs/ gnas tshul de nga chang sgri bzi yang kha nas thon gyi ma red/ der gzad byung rkyen de'i rjes su bu mo des nga ga dus zug kyang ngo tsha mdog kha po zhe drags byas pa song tsang tsā ba grwa gtor dus ngas ched mngags mo'i mnyam du zhim lār ma phyin par ma su rir phyin pa yin ’’zhes baji+od/ mi 'gyur gyis ‘‘dngos gnas khyed rang gi bsamakhablo gtong stangs der bcos min rjes su yi rangs yod/ khyed rang khong gnyis la

dus 'khor dbang chen/ lha35bkrin chen po yin pa ma zad/ nga'i mi che'i 'gro stangs kyi thog la'ang bkrin chen bo yin/ nga da lta 'di 'dra yod pa de dngos gnas khyed rang gis slob grwar yod dus bslab bya thengs gcig brgyab pa de'i bkrin red/ de min da gzod ga par slebs yod med nyis so red/ zugs rje che gnang zhes smras/ de'i kha snon du nor sgron gyis ‘‘mi 'gyur gyis dus rgyun du blo bzang lags khyed rang gi skor bshad de sdod kyi 'dug kho rang gis khyed rang gi skor bshad bshad nyid kyis nga yang khyed rang zug 'dod chen po byung ’’zhes baji+od/blo bzang gis snye6de ring dngos su zug dus mi cho med cig mi 'dug gam ’ zhes baji+od/ nor sgron gyis 66ga pa ga pa/ pho gsar stag 'dra zhig 'dug ’ces baji+od / der de ma thag tu 'gyur gyis nor slon la bltas te 66yag da khyod blo bzang la sems ba 〈snaratshar 'dug gakhas da gin khrid ma skusnang na tag tag yin zhes brjod bas khong snamagasum ga gdapo sgor/ de rjes nor sgron gyis ‘6a tsi/sems pa da su la'ang sgor chog gi sku da kyi red la/mi tshang mas kha gsang ma gsang red ma gshetogs/ gzhan gyi sems55 gang bsam pa de gzhan dag tshos mthong thub kyi 'dzed na daltagamochayod red/ mi—'gyur khyed rasdagis kyang kha ma gsang pa red ma gtogs ga dus yin na'ang he ma/ ma li ni yi 〈snag brnyan blta gi yod pa/ de sems sasnye+or ba'i rtags ma red pas ’’zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis gad mo shor ba dang mnyam du mi —'gyur la bltas te/ ‘6da 〈snags po lan rgyobs ’ri zhes baji+od/ mi 'gyur gyis ‘‘de ring sang gi bud med 'di tshor kha ya sus kyang thub kyi ma red/ da yin na'ang blo bzang khyed rang gis phar nor sgron la sems pa ma shor na nga blo bde po 'dug gzhan he ma/ ma li ni yis nga la tshur

236 mi che'i gro ba mngar skyur/sems pa shor ba la ni nga po la zug sku da pa ma red ’’ces brjod pa dang nor sgron gyis bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ ‘6gal te zug na tshur sems pa sgor gyi yod pa'i yid ches yod mdog mdog red bas mi’zhes dris/mi 'gyur gyis rang nyid kyi gdong dang skra la lag pa 'chang tsam dang /gzugs bor lta tsam byas te/ ‘6yagablo bzang / drang bo sgod dang / ga re nga la sems ba sgor ma 'os pa de 'dra 'dug gam ’ zhes sdus/ blo bzang gis mi 'gyur la lta yag byas te/ ‘‘ga pa/ ga pa/ sems pa shor mi los pa de 'dra gcigakyang mi 'dug gadzite khyed rang zug na da rgya gar glog brnyan 'khrab mkhan gyi bu ma tsho da a cang cang / lha sgyu u ma'ang lha dbang phyug gangs khrod du bzhag ste te dzu gzhis chags su yong rgyu nyag cig red ’ces brjod pa dang slar yang khong gsum ga gad yo shor/ de'i skabs su zla ba sgrol ma khong tsho'i sar slebs te/ blo bzang la lta bzhin du 66khyed rang 'di gar bsdad 'dug gangs chu tshod gcig tsam zhig zhe wa btsal pa yin/ da ni thang yang chad sku nga mi’zhes smras/blo bzang gis thog mar zla ba sgrol ma mi 'gyur dang nor sgron gnyis la ngo sprod byed grabs byed dus mi 'gyur gyis lam seng ngo shes te/ ‘6yag zla ba sgrol ma/bkris bde legs/ bzhugs gnang dang mizhes rkub kyag stong ba zhig la lag brda byas/ de nas mu mazud de nor sgron phyogs su bltas te/ ‘ldor sgron nga'i skye dman red/ zla ba sgrol ma ni nga tsho ka sbug slob grwa gcig pa red ’’ces ngo sprod byas/nor sgron dang zla ba sgrol ma gnyis kyis phan tshun 'tshams 'dri zhu res byas/ mi 'gyur gyis ja zhig mngags grabs byed skabs zla ba sgro+ol mas ‘6dbo ngas dag nga ja 'thung long med/ blo bzang 'tshol du yong ba yin/ dge bshes lags kyis khyed rang

trīdus 'khor dbang chen/ 237thug dgos yod ces da lta nga tsho'i nang la sgug nas bzhugs yod mices blo bzang la lta zhing smras/blo bzang gis ‘rim las/ byas na nga 'gro dgos byung song / sang nyin zug yong ’’zhes baji+od/ mi 'gyur gyis 6‘sang nyin lhod rdzod byas te nyin gung kha lag nga tshos mnyam du za dgos/ zla ba sgrol ma khyed rang yang shog ang ’’zhes brjod/zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘yin da yin/ a ni sang nyin mjal yong ’’zhes nor sgron dang mi 'gyur la lag pa gtong bzhin smras/ khong tsho bzhi de nas kha gyes te rang rang gi gnas su phyin/:( bzang dang zla ba sgrol ma gnyis khrom gzhung gi thal 'tshub dang 'tshang ka can gyi srang lam de gshags te zla ba sgrol ma'i nang 'byud sa phyogs su 'gro skabs blosna bzang gis ‘‘dge bshes lags su de 'dra'i gal chen po ga re gsungs yag yod dam ’ zhes zla ba sgrol mar dris/ zla ba sgromal mas ‘6gang shes gsal rngo( rang da gsungs gnang gi mi 3dug yin na'ang gsung 'a〈snas la bltas na phal cher khyed rang grwa pa byed du 'jug rtsis yin pa 'dra ’zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis dga' snang dang bcas te/ ‘‘dngos gnas/ de 'dra yin na da nga rang gi bsam don grub sa red/nye ba'i cha la nga la dus rtag tu dgon pa dang /ltakhang /de bzhin chos dwa dang / dbe khrid byed pa zha stag mi lam la sku nga gi 'dug ces brjod/ blo bzang gis de ltar baji+od pa'i rkyen gyis zla ba sgrol ma'i mig la rang dbang med par mig chu'i gaṅgā 'khor bzhin du ‘‘a las/ byas na dbon g.yu lar phebs 'dod sku da pa dang / lha gnam sde'i lung bstan byung pa gnyis 'gab mtshungs pa red/ nga dga' po byung ’’

238 mi che'i hro ba mngar skyur/zhes baji+od bzhin du mig chu 'gog thabs dang sems skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur mi thon pa'i thabs shes byas kyang byed ma zub/ blo bzang gis zla ba sgrol ma'i rnam 'gyur mthong ba dang sems rtse zing byas te/ ‘‘byas na/ byas na/ khyed rang gis nga la ’rizhes zla ba sgrol ma'i gdong gi mig chu 'phyis bzhin du chig lhag ma de kha nas ma thon gong la zla ba sgrol mas blo bzang gis gang 'asdu 'dod yod pa shes te mgo bo gug gug byas pas blo bzang la baljod mi shes pa'i tshor ba shugs drag cig skyes te zla ba sgrol mar 'tham/ zla ba lha la mas kyang blo bzang la shugs che tsam 'tham ste skad shugs chen po byas te ngu sgor/ g.yas gasku na gyi 'grul pa tshos khong gnyis la lta gi yod pa shes te/ blo bzang gis bskyar du zla ba sgrol ma'i mig gi mchi ma rang nyid kyi lag pas 'phyis te/ ‘‘da nang la 'gro ’ri zhes baji+od de zla ba sgrol ma'i lag pa g.yas pa de rang gi lag pa gasku1na mas bzung ste nang du khrid phyin/nang du slebs ma thag dge bshes lags su bkris bde legs zhus/ dge bshes lags kyis ‘‘blo bzang / nye char khyed rang gi a ne+es nga la yi ge zhig 'byor byung /de'i nang du gal te khyed rang la 'dun pa shugs che yod na grwa pa byed du 'jug rogs gnang zhes nan tan bris 'dug la/ mi ngo shes pa brgyud de kha lan yang bskur 'dug lhag par du gal te khyed rang grwa pa byed zub na a ne+e'i glo kha rdzogs pa yin zhes dang /jo jo kami'i 'dod pa la'ang de ltar 'dug ces bris 'dugabyas tsang de ring nga 'di gar yong don khyed rang la grwa pa byed 'dod yod pas zhes dri bar yong ba yin ’ zhes brjod/blo bzang gis bsam blo zhig btang /zla ba sgrol ma dang /mo'i

dus 'kho ra dbang / lha39a ma/ de bzhin nyi sgron bcas la lta tsam byas te/ ‘‘dge bshes lags/ gnas tshul 'di thag gcod byed pa la nga la bsam blo gtong rgyu'i dus tshod cig dgos sa red la/ lhag par du nga la pha ma gcig gi sbun las lhag pa'i byams skyong dang rogs ram brtse ba byed mkhan gyi nang mi zhig kyang yod pas khong tsho dang gros bsdur byas te khong tsho'i 'dod pa dang bstun dgos pa'ang ngas shes kyi yod/ byas tsang nga la de'i thog la bsam blo gtong rgyu'i dus tshod dgos 'dug ’’ ces baji+od/dge bshes lags kyis ‘‘'grigs kyi red/ 'grigs kyi red/ de la brel ba yod pa ma red/ khyed rang 'di'i thog la zla ba gcig gnyis dang lo 'ahor yang brel ba yod pa ma red/ 'phral phugs gnyis ka'i bsam blo sgod rdzod btang ste thag bcad na 'grigs kyi red/ shes song ngam/ byas na 'phyi po byas song / da nga dgongs pa zhu gi yin/ lhan rgyas tshang ma lhod lha da bzhugs gdan 'jags rogs gnang zhes gsungs te phyi la phebs/dge bshes lags phyi la phebs grub pa dang blo bzang gis a ma sgrol ma la ‘6a ma lags/ da gyin gong du ngas dge bshes lags k+ṣiṃzhus pa bzhin/ khyed tsho'i nang mi 'di nga rang gi nang mi dang khyad par sbu tsam yang med/ lhag par du nga rgya gar lung par slob sbyong byed dus ngo shes pa dang gnyen sbrun yar bltas gnam dang mar bltas sa ma gtogs med pa'i skabs su zla ba sgrol mas gtsos ba'i khyed tsho nangami tshang mas nga la so so'i sha khrabatanas mched pa ltar byams skyo nga dang rogs ram byas pa bzhin ngas kyang pa lags dang a ma lags khyed rang gnyis la pha ma'i 'du shes

240 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/dang / zla ba sgrol ma dang / nyi sgron/ lhag pa bcas par spun mched kyi 'du shes bzung ba yin/ yin na'ang zla ba sgrol mas nga la rang gi snying las kyang gces pa byed kyi yod pa de de ring ma gtogs tshor zub ma song / da lta bar du nga rang yang mo la lhag par dga' po yod de gnas tshul de'i thad la bsam blo rtsa ba nas 'khor ma song la/mo rang gis kyang de ring ma gtogs kha gsang ste nga la lab yod pa ma red/gang ltar yang rung zla ba sgrol ma nga gnyis mi tshe mnyam skyel byas na 'os 'bab yod dang med kyi thag gcod de khyed rang tsho nang mi tshang ma 'dzom sa/ pa lags su'ang bka' 'dri zhus te thag gcod gnang rogs gnang / khyed rang tshos thag gcod ga re gnang ba der ngas sas mazun zhu gi yin zhes brjod/ blo bzang gis de ltar bshad pa der khong tsho gsum ga yid mgu bo byung ste/ a ma sgrol mas 6‘nga tsho ma su rir slebs ma thag tu pa lags dang go bsdur byas te khyed rang la 'brel ba byed kyi yin/gtso bo sna zla ba sgrol ma khyed rang gnyis kyi thag gcod la rag lus pa red ’’ces baji+od/dus 'khor dbang chen 〈snal rjes tshang ma sdu so'i gnas su kha gyes/ a ma sgrol ma khong tsho ma su rir slebs pa dang / ba rdo rje lags su blo bzang dang zla ba sgrol ma'i gnyen sgrig gi skor la skad cha sdus skabs/ ba rdo rje lags kyis ‘6nga'i ngos la da zla ba sgrol ma dang blo bzang gnyis mnyam du byung na/ de las lhag pa'i re ba rgyag sa zhig nga la med la/ nga ma zad pa'i nga rang tsho nang mi tshang mas blo bzang la dga' bo zhe drags yod pa'ang ngas shes kyi yod/ yin na yang ngas chos shes kyi da sped de/

dus 'kho ra dbang / lha41gal te blo bzang rang nyid la grwa pa byed rgyu'i 'dun pa bcos min zhig yod na/ chos sgo bkag pa de sdig pa ha cang gi chen po min 'gro bsam gyi 'dug yin na'ang da zla ba sgrol ma khyed rang gis thag gcod byed dgos red ’rices baji+od/zla ba sgrol mas 6‘pa lags/ ngas blo bzang gi thog la bsam blo mang po btang ba yin pas tha ma der/ nga rang rang 'dod che drags pa ma gtogs/ blo bzang gi 'dod pa dang / mi tshe'i thog la bsam blo rtsa ba nas btang mi 'dug de bzhin kho'i a ne+e dang jo jo'i 'dod pa dang dmigs yul la'ang bsam blo btang mi 'dug lhag par du da lta bar du blo bzang gis nga la sbun mched kyi 'du shes bzung ba'i 'brel ba der ngas lta stangs nor ba zhig byas 'dug la/ lar nas gal te blo bzang grwa pa yag po zhig cha gas te chos mgo thon na/ 〈sna rang tsam ma zad pa'i skye 'gro mang po zhig la phan thogs 〈snang rgyu yin pa de yang ngas shes mi 'dug /byas tsang ngas pha ma gnyis dang khyed tsho tshang mar 'bod skul byed yag la blo bzang grwa pa byed du 'jug rogs gnang zhes zer rgyu yin ’’zhes mig mig chus khengs bzhin brjod pas/ nyi sgro na gyis ‘6zla ba sgrol ma khyed rang mno bsam yag po thongs/ 'di blos gtong chen bo red da/rjes su 'gyod pa chen po skye dgos pa yong mizhes brjod/ der zla ba sgrol mas ‘‘gcig gi don du gcig gis blos gtong byas pa de la dacasas 'brel gyi brtse ba zer gyi med 'gro/gzhan gyi 'dod 'dun la ma bsdun par rang nyid gcig bu'i 'dod pa khengs pa byed rgyu de sred zhen red ma gtogs brtse ba zer ba de yin sa ma red ’ ces ba1snad/ a ma sgrol mas kyang mig chu 'khomar bzhin du zla ba lha la mar bltas te/‘6a mas snyan/ 'grigs ga khyed rang gis slo ba sbyong byas pa'i 'bras bu dngos

242 mi che'i zo ba mngar skyur/gnas yag po byung 'dug de 'dra'i bsam blo rgya chen po 'khor zub dus nga tsho pha ma gnyis kyang spobs pa skyed kyi 'dug /byas na khyed rang gang mgyogs blo bzang gi sar phyin te nga tsho nang mi tshang ma'i 'dod pa la kho rang grwa pa byed dgos rgyur thag chod song lab shog ma red pas ’’zhes pa rdo rje la dris/ pa rdo rje lags kyis ‘6red red/de ga rang byas shog ’’ces smras/ de nas bdun phrag lnga tsam gyi rjes su zla ba sgrol ma dha sar 'byor/ dgong dro'i chu cedi drug pa yol tsam zhig la gangs skyid du slebs pas thad kar blo bzang gi 'dzi5 shag tu phyin/ thog mar zug pa dang gcig gis gcig la 'tham ste dga' skyo 'dres ma'i tshor ba dang bcas te gnyis ka'i mig nas mig chu sgor/ cane kyang zla ba sgro'adim dha sar ma yong gong du mo rang the ba'i nang mi tshang mas thag gcod ga re byas min gyi skor la blo bzang la yi ge zhig btang tshar bas skabs der slo bzang la gdong thug byed rgyur dka' ngal de tsam ma byung / nang du slebs pa dang zla ba sgrol mas ja 'thung zin mtshams dpung phad nag po de'i nang nas lam rim gyi phyag dbe bod sgog yin pa zhig phyung ste/ a she kha btags kyis bsgril/ de'i mnyam du hin sgor chig stong lnga brgya yig skogs zhig gi nang du blugs te yod pa de dang / gzan sham cha tshang gcig bcas blo bzang la sprod bzhin pa'i ngang nas ‘6da khyed rang gdan sar phyin te nga'i 'dod pa la yod pa nang bzhin gyi cho sa pa rnam dag cig chags pa'i smon lam dang re ba yong/ grwa pa byas tshar ba'i rjes la mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan 'dzoms pa zhig byed dgos/ de ltar byed kyi red bsam ba'i nga

dus 'khor dbang chen/ 243dang / nga'i pha ma/ de bzhin nyi sgron dang lhag pa bcas nga tsho tshang mar yid ches yod/dka' ngal ji 'dra zhig 'phrad kyang khyed rang sga nang mi dang spun mched ma su ri la sku da bsam ste lam seng yig 'brel byed rogs gyis/ khyed rang dge bshes snyan grags can zhig chags song na da gzod nga'i mi che'i re ba rdzogs pa yin ’’ zhes baji+od bzhin du bskyar spu mig chu 'khor bas blo bzang gis ‘6khyed rang tan tan nga dang bral phod sa red pas/bsam blo yag po btang ste thag gather+shad byas pas ’’zhes dris/zla ba sgrol mas rang nyid kyi mig chu 'phyis bzhin du ‘‘de ring gi mig chu 'di khyed rang la sems chags te yid skyo ba'i mig chu ma red/ rang nyid kyi chung dus nas 'dris che ba'i spun mched cig chos la 'gro dus dga' ba'i mig chu red/ byas tsang khyed rang sems pa lhod lhod byas te snod/ nga la sems khral ma byed/ yin na'ang nga khyed rang la skad cha gcig dri 'dod 'dug /dris na 'grigs kyi red pas ’’zhes brjod/blo bzang gis 66'grigs dang 'grigs/ga re red ’’ces smras/zla ba sgol mas ‘‘khyed rang grwa pa byed rgyu'i bsam blo ga 'dra byas te 'khor gared/ dge bshes lags kyi shugs rkyen byas pa red pas ’ zhes dris/blo bzang gis ‘‘dbekhobashes lags kyi shugs rkyen byas pa rtsa ba nas ma red/ de ga 'dra byas te byung ba red zer na/ ngas ldi li mtho slob tu yod skabs deb 'dra mi 'dra klog pa red/ deb de tsho'i nang du nang pa ma yin pa'i chos lugs 'dra min gyi grub mtha' dang / de bzhin dmar po'i lta ba dang / mang gatsho'i lta ba/ nub phyogs ba'i lta ba'i thog la mkhas pa snyan grags can mang pos bris bzhag pa'i deb de tsho'ang bklags pa yin/de nas lho phyogs su 'gro skabs dang lhag par du nye ba'i cha la nang pa'i dbe cha kha

lha44 mi tshe'i bro ba mngar skyur/zhas klog rgyu'i bo skabs byung / de yang thog mar chos la dad pa che drag ste bklags pa de 'dra ma red/ las ka'i ngo bor shes rig gi nang du bod yig slob deb bskyar bcos byed dgos kyi yod tsang bklags pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dbe cha'i nang du gsungs ba de tsho klog dus 'jig rten lta stangs la cha bzhag na'ang 'dra/yang na mi'i mi che'i 'gyur ldog la yin na'ang 'dra/ de bzhin las rgyu 'bras dang /tshe 'di phyi sogs ga 'dra'i lkor zhig bklags kyang bro ba kho rang so so red/ ga tshad mang ba klog pa de tsam gyis spro snang che ru 'gro mkhan zhig 'dug /de min so so'i g.yas g.yon gyi 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag la lta dus kyang snying 〈sna med pa zhig ma〈snang gi 'dug mdor na nges 'byung sbu sud cig skyes pa red/ byas tsang de 'dra'i thogo nas grwa pa byed 'dod shar ba red mi’ces brjod/ zla ba sgrol ma'i bsam par byas na nga'i thag gcod de nor mi 'dug snyam pa'i dga' tshor zhig dang bcas te bzhin 'dzum dmul te/ ‘6byas na phu la sgrab pa rgyag mkhan dang mda' la 'tsho ba sbre ra mkhan gnyis tshangs mnyam du rgyaḍā pa'i slon lam yod mi’ces brjod par khong gnyis ka gad yo sgor/zla ba sgrol ma dha sar blo bzang gi nang du nyi ma lnga bsnad rjes su ma su rir log /de nas zla ba drug phyin pa'i rjes su blo bzang gis shes rig las khyangs nas dargongs pa rtsa dahongs zhus te 'bras sbungs blo gsal gling du chos zhugs byed rgyur thag bcad/ blo bzang gis dha sar 7dong sa mchog gi sku mdun du skro rgyud rgyul ba'i rten 'brel gyi skabs su dge bshes dpal ldan lags dang / zla ba 〈snal ma'i nang mi cha
